title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva (https://jobicy.com/company/nextiva), we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

Location: While this role is open to remote candidates across the United States, team members located within 40 miles of our Scottsdale headquarters (9451 E. Via de Ventura, Scottsdale, AZ 85256) are expected to work onsite four days per week to support collaboration, speed, and execution. Specific scheduling and flexibility will be guided by your leader to support both team collaboration and individual productivity.

At Nextiva, we're building the future of customer experience through thoughtful, AI-native product design. As a Senior Product Designer, you'll shape experiences across our Unified Customer Experience platform, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to solve complex customer problems through modern design, rapid prototyping, and intelligent AI-assisted workflows. This is more than a traditional design role. You'll help define product direction, challenge assumptions, and turn ideas into production-ready experiences across desktop and mobile. If you're energized by moving quickly, embracing new AI technologies, and designing products that make a measurable impact, you'll thrive here.

What You'll Do:

• Lead end-to-end product design from discovery through delivery across desktop, mobile, and responsive experiences.

• Partner with Product Managers and Engineers as a strategic thought partner, challenging assumptions, asking the right questions, and helping define the best solution instead of simply executing requirements.

• Engage directly with customers to understand their needs, ask thoughtful questions, gather feedback, and translate insights into product decisions and improved experiences.

• Create user flows, customer journeys, wireframes, interactive prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and production-ready experiences across desktop and mobile.

• Design across multiple product domains, including onboarding, e-commerce, AI-powered product capabilities, administration, customer conversations, and emerging platform initiatives as priorities evolve.

• Build functional, high-fidelity prototypes using AI-assisted development workflows to validate ideas with customers and stakeholders quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate toward the right solution.

• Collaborate closely with Engineering by reviewing AI-generated frontend implementations, refining production code, and helping bridge design and development.

• Drive consistency across products by evolving and contributing to Nextiva's design system, reusable components (A2UI), and design standards.

• Use customer research, analytics, experimentation, and usability testing to continuously improve product experiences and business outcomes.

• Communicate design thinking clearly and confidently, presenting concepts, facilitating customer and stakeholder conversations, and explaining the rationale, tradeoffs, and customer insights behind design decisions.

• Work independently in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple initiatives while adapting quickly as business priorities evolve.

• Leverage AI-powered design, research, and development tools responsibly to improve speed, quality, creativity, and execution.

• Explore emerging AI technologies and workflows, sharing best practices that improve team productivity and elevate design quality.

About You:

Required Qualifications

• 6+ years of experience designing digital products, preferably within SaaS or enterprise software environments.

• Strong, current portfolio demonstrating exceptional product thinking, interaction design, visual design, accessibility, systems thinking, and measurable customer impact.

• Proven experience leading complex product initiatives from discovery through implementation.

• Demonstrated ability to think critically, solve ambiguous problems independently, challenge assumptions, and influence product direction rather than simply executing requirements.

• Experience designing production-ready experiences across desktop, mobile, and responsive environments.

• Experience building, maintaining, and evolving scalable design systems, reusable components, and component libraries.

• Strong understanding of user-centered design, information architecture, usability testing, experimentation, and data-informed design.

• Strong customer communication and discovery skills, with experience conducting customer conversations, asking effective questions, gathering feedback, and turning insights into actionable design decisions.

• Experience partnering closely with software engineers throughout implementation and delivery.

• Demonstrated proficiency using modern AI-powered design and development tools to accelerate design, prototyping, documentation, and frontend implementation.

• Working knowledge of modern design-to-code workflows, including AI-generated frontend development, Git-based collaboration, and component-based architecture.

• Technical fluency with HTML, CSS, modern frontend frameworks, and design systems sufficient to evaluate and refine AI-generated implementations.

• Experience building interactive prototypes that closely resemble production experiences and using them to gather feedback and validate solutions.

• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to articulate design decisions, tell a clear product story, and collaborate effectively with customers, Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders.

• Self-directed, highly adaptable, and comfortable moving between product areas and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and a continuous learning mindset, with a willingness to experiment, adapt, and share new approaches across the team.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience using AI-assisted development environments such as Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar AI-native workflows.

• Experience designing AI-powered product experiences, including conversational interfaces, copilots, intelligent assistants, or embedded AI workflows within SaaS applications.

• Experience contributing to React component libraries or collaborating on production-ready component implementations.

• Experience creating personal or side projects that demonstrate modern product design, coding, or AI experimentation.

• Experience conducting A/B testing and using experimentation to improve customer experiences.

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

• Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.

• Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work.

• Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates.

Total Rewards

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.

The expected hiring range is $91,000 - $160,000. A different level in the job hierarchy may apply to a specific candidate, resulting in a different hiring range.

• Health: Multiple health plan options to suit your needs, including medical, dental, vision, and telemedicine coverage

• Insurance: Life, disability, and supplemental indemnity plans

• ⚖️ Work-Life Balance: Flexible Time Off for salaried employees, PTO for hourly employees, Paid Sick Time, Paid Parental Bonding Leave, and holiday pay

• Financial Security: 401(k) with company match, Health Savings Accounts with company contributions, Dependent Care FSA

• ‍ Wellness: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and comprehensive wellness initiatives

• Growth: Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement

At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career!

Nextiva is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Nextiva participates in the E-Verify Program where and as required by law. For additional information about E-Verify visit USCIS (https://e-verify.uscis.gov/web/media/resourcesContents/E-Verify_Participation_Poster_ES.pdf).

title: Product Marketing Lead
description:
Description

About Bizzabo (https://himalayas.app/companies/bizzabo)

Bizzabo (https://himalayas.app/companies/bizzabo) is the Event Experience Operating System for modern enterprise organizations, and the intelligence behind every great event. Corporate event teams use Bizzabo (https://himalayas.app/companies/bizzabo) to run complex event portfolios across in-person, virtual, webinar, and field events, unify their data, and prove the business impact of every event they run.

We've powered more than 100,000 events for millions of attendees. We're a Leader in the Forrester Wave for B2B Event Management Technology and the only vendor in that evaluation named a Customer Favorite. Founded in 2011, we're headquartered in New York with offices in Montreal, Kyiv and Tel-Aviv.

The category is changing fast. Event teams are being asked to run more programs with fewer people and prove revenue impact on every one of them, and AI is reshaping what an event platform should do. We're building for that future, and we need someone to tell that story.

About the role

You'll own how Bizzabo (https://himalayas.app/companies/bizzabo) is understood: by buyers, by our sales team, by analysts, and by the AI agents our own teams now work with every day.

This is a lead role with real scope. You'll own positioning, messaging, launches, competitive strategy, sales enablement, and analyst relations for the full Event Experience OS, including the agentic capabilities we're bringing to organizers, attendees, and sponsors. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Sales, Account Management, and Marketing, and you'll report directly to our Co-founder and CMO.

We're looking for a builder. You'll have strong partners across Brand, Demand Generation, and Enablement, but no layers between you and the work. If you want to shape a category, not maintain someone else's messaging deck, this is the role.

You'll also get to work the way we work. Claude is part of everyone's day at Bizzabo (https://himalayas.app/companies/bizzabo). Our teams use Claude and Claude Cowork daily, with Skills built on our own messaging, product, and competitive knowledge, and you'll have the freedom to automate anything that slows you down.

Requirements

What you'll do

• Own positioning and messaging for the Event Experience OS. Translate new agentic capabilities into clear, provable value for enterprise event leaders, and keep the story consistent from the website to the last call before signature.

• Run launches end to end. Partner with Product on what we build and why, then own the go-to-market: narrative, pricing and packaging input, launch plan, field readiness, and customer communication.

• Help us win competitive deals. Own competitive intelligence against legacy event management platforms and newer point solutions. Build battlecards, landmine questions, and objection handling that reps actually use, and run win/loss analysis to sharpen them.

• Equip the field. Build the pitch narrative, demo storylines, one-pagers, and RFP content. Partner with Sales and Solutions leadership to train the team and make sure every new capability is sold, not just shipped.

• Lead analyst relations day to day. Own our Forrester and Gartner relationships, evaluation submissions, and briefings, plus our presence on peer review sites like G2, TrustRadius, Capterra, and Gartner Peer Insights.

• Turn customers into proof. Work with Account Management to build case studies, reference programs, and the metrics that make our claims specific.

• Drive adoption. Partner with Account Management to get existing customers using what we ship, through release communications, programs, and content for executive business reviews.

• Own the context layer. Our messaging, product, and competitive knowledge powers the Claude Skills our teams use to write, sell, and support. You'll keep that source of truth current and use AI to automate your own GTM workflows.

﻿What success looks like

In your first 90 days:

• You've listened to dozens of sales calls, interviewed customers and lost prospects, and can explain in plain words why we win and why we lose.

• You've refreshed our core competitive materials and the field is using them in live deals.

• You've taken ownership of our next analyst evaluation and our peer review strategy.

• You've shipped your first launch end to end.

In your first year:

• Our competitive win rate is measurably higher, and you can show which of your work moved it.

• Every major release goes to market with a clear story, trained reps, and customer adoption plans.

• Our analyst and peer review position reflects where the product actually is.

• The messaging that powers our people and our AI agents is sharp, current, and trusted across the company.

﻿What you need

• 5+ years of product marketing in B2B SaaS selling to mid-market and enterprise buyers, including time as the lead or sole product marketer.

• An AI-native way of working. You've used AI agents, ideally Claude, to automate real GTM workflows, and you can show us what you built.

• A track record of positioning complex platforms for both business and technical buyers, and of winning against an entrenched incumbent.

• Strong sales enablement instincts. You build narratives and assets that get used in the field, and you know how to check that they do.

• Hands-on experience with analyst relations, ideally including a Forrester Wave or Gartner Magic Quadrant evaluation.

• Excellent writing. You make complicated things simple without making them generic.

• Comfort building without a big team around you: you set your own priorities, move fast, and ship.

﻿Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with Claude Cowork, Claude Skills, or similar agentic tools in your day-to-day work.

• Experience in event technology, martech, or another platform sold to marketing teams.

• Experience marketing agentic or AI-first products to enterprise buyers.

• Experience with a three-sided value story (in our case, organizers, attendees, and sponsors).

• Fluency with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Gong, and comfort pulling your own data from them.

In accordance with the New York Pay Transparency Law, the annual salary range for the Product Marketing Lead role is $100,000 -$150,000. Additionally, we offer a comprehensive rewards package that includes generous time-off benefits, quarterly mental health days, quarterly team-building events (Bizzabreaks), and comprehensive insurance options with employer premium coverage. Other benefits include a 401(k) plan with employer matching, an equity program, paid parental leave, and sabbatical leave on milestone anniversaries (BizzaBirthdays).

title: Software Engineer, Forward Deployed
location: New York, NY (HQ); San Francisco, CA
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll solve the hardest problems standing between Ramp and the world’s largest and most complex companies — shaping and shipping the product capabilities that unlock our growth upmarket. You'll be part of our Core FDE org, which is an agent-first, high-pace, customer-facing engineering team. On FDE, you will interact directly with customers and deliver solutions end to end — understanding pain points, shaping product decisions, and building agents that autonomously expand Ramp's capabilities.

Check out our Engineering Blog https://engineering.ramp.com/ and FDE post https://engineering.ramp.com/post/forward-deployed-engineering for more context on our work!

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Deliver software end to end that meet the needs of our largest customers — understanding user pain points, scoping product specs, and building agents that autonomously implement solutions.

- Collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, and Account Management to close deals, activate customers, and expand the value Ramp provides over time.

- Drive the core product engineering roadmap through our embedding model — specializing within a core product area to develop deep domain expertise and make prioritization calls on when to build a custom solution vs. accelerate a broader initiative.

WHAT YOU NEED

- 3+ years of software engineering experience preferred

- Extensive experience building with and for agents

- Track record of shipping high-quality products at scale

- Comfort and excitement to be customer-facing

- Desire to work in a fast-paced environment, continuously grow, and master your craft

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

- Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

CANADA

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

- Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

- Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

- Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

- Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

UNITED KINGDOM

- Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

- Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

- Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice https://ramp.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
About Us:

Spreedly (https://jobicy.com/company/spreedly) is the Intelligent Payments Platform for businesses that want to own their payments strategy. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, we give merchants, platforms, and fintechs a single API to connect to 150+ payment gateways and 40+ payment methods across 100+ countries, along with the intelligence to decide where every transaction should go. We're vendor-agnostic by design. Our customers choose their providers, keep their payment data portable, and never have to rebuild their stack to adopt something new.

Payments are getting more complex, not less. Every new market, payment method, fraud tool, and now every AI agent checking out on a shopper's behalf adds another integration and another decision. Spreedly turns that complexity into an advantage. Our PCI Level 1 vault keeps cards and network tokens portable across providers. Smart routing and retries recover revenue lost to avoidable declines. Fraud and 3DS tools plug in with a single API call. And our payments intelligence turns transaction data into decisions merchants can act on. As agentic commerce moves from experiment to real sales channel, we're building the infrastructure that lets merchants accept agent-initiated payments through the providers they already trust.

For the people who work here, that means hard technical problems at real scale, billions of dollars in annual transactions, at a moment when the rules of commerce are being rewritten. If you want ownership and work that shows up directly in your customers' revenue, you'll fit right in.

About the Role:

As a Technical Account Manager, you will be a key player in our pre-sales and customer solutioning efforts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Product, and Engineering to scope technical solutions that align with customer needs and drive Spreedly's growth. This is a customer-facing, consultative role focused on understanding prospect pain points and designing solutions that connect Spreedly's platform capabilities to business outcomes.

You will also influence revenue growth, shorten time-to-close, and accelerate value realization for our customers. As Spreedly scales, this role will shape our go-to-market infrastructure through solution templates, demo assets, and mentoring, making it an ideal opportunity for impact and professional growth.

This is a US-based customer-facing role supporting primarily US customers and cross-functional teams operating within US business hours. Success in this role requires regular travel within the United States and the ability to work in alignment with US customer and internal stakeholder schedules.

Responsibilities:

• Lead technical discovery sessions with prospects and customers to identify needs and align use cases to Spreedly's capabilities

• Deliver compelling demos, architecture diagrams, and documentation that support sales conversations and technical evaluation

• Translate business and technical requirements into actionable solution proposals and implementation plans that support scalability and reuse

• Develop and maintain reusable demo environments, solution artifacts, and objection handling templates

• Work with Product and Engineering teams to provide prospect feedback and ensure solution feasibility

• Partner with Customer Success and Support teams to ensure smooth implementation handoffs

• Serve as a technical expert in RFPs, security reviews, and compliance questionnaires

• Educate internal teams on platform capabilities, integration patterns, and sales enablement materials

Requirements:

• 3+ years in a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Account Manager role within a B2B SaaS or fintech environment

• Industry experience with eCommerce, PSPs, payment orchestration, or payment platforms

• Background in payments, card-not-present commerce, fraud, or gateways preferred

• Strong knowledge of APIs, SDKs, and system integration principles (especially REST and webhooks)

• Familiarity with scripting or backend programming (Python, Ruby, or JavaScript a plus)

• Experience collaborating with Sales and Product teams on enterprise deals

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including customer-facing documentation

• Ability to simplify complex technical topics and guide customer decision-making

Additional Skills We Value:

• Comfortable owning discovery and demo stages in an enterprise sales motion

• Experience with implementation or support functions is a plus

We Offer Our US-Based Employees:

• Competitive salary + Equity

• Outstanding Medical and Dental benefits, including 100% employer-paid options

• Company-paid Life and Disability insurance

• Optional vision and supplemental insurance options, and various Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

• Open Paid Time Off policy + 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents

• Matching 401(k) plan (5% up to $5,000 yearly)

• $1,000 annual professional development stipend

• Monthly home working/digital lifestyle stipend, new MacBook, and one-time accessory reimbursement

• Access to company-paid professional coaching service

• Visits to HQ in Durham, North Carolina for remote employees

Compensation

Additional Information

#LI-AE1

Spreedly Product Offering:

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:

Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.
More Coming Soon! - Keep your eyes peeled for a new product launch by EOY '26

--

What It's Like to Work Here:

We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.

--

We champion the ethical, creative use of AI—if you’re someone who pairs human judgment with modern AI tools to work smarter and drive bigger impact, you’ll thrive here.

--

Spreedly is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We actively work to drive out even unintentional discrimination in our hiring processes via practices like blindly graded work samples, structured interviews, and diversity awareness training.

Due to the sensitive nature of what Spreedly does - handling payment data - finalist candidates must complete a successful background and reference check.

At this time Spreedly is unable to provide sponsorship for employment, and we are not set up to support remote employees who reside in New York. In order to be considered for employment, applicants must be currently legally authorized to work in the job location country and not require future sponsorship in order to continue working in that country.

We appreciate your interest in our company. Because of the high volume of resume flow, we may only respond to those candidates that we think will be a potential fit.

--

title: Senior IT Operations Engineer
description:
Who we are:

BigID (https://jobicy.com/company/bigid) is an innovative tech startup that focuses on solutions for data security, compliance, privacy, and AI data management. We're leading the market in all things data: helping our customers reduce risk, drive business innovation, achieve compliance, build customer trust, make better decisions, and get more value from their data.

We are building a global team passionate about innovation and next-gen technology. BigID has been recognized for:

• BigID named one of Forbes America's Best Startup Employers 2026 - ranked #15 overall and #1 in Security

• BigID named Hot Company in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning at the Global InfoSec Awards

• Citizens JMP Cyber 66 List of Hottest Privately Held Cybersecurity Companies

• CRN 100 list named BigID as one of the 20 Coolest Identity Access Management and Data Protection Companies (3 years running)

• DUNS 100 Best Tech Companies to Work for

• Top 3 Big Data and AI Vendors to Watch in the 2023 BigDATAwire Readers and Editors Choice Awards

• 2024 Inc. 5000 list for the 4th consecutive year!

• Shortlisted for the 2024 AI Awards in the category of Best Use of AI in Cybersecurity

At BigID, our team is the foundation of our success. Join a people-centric culture that is fast-paced and rewarding: you’ll have the opportunity to work with some of the most talented people in the industry who value innovation, diversity, integrity, and collaboration.

Senior IT Operations Engineer

Location: EST Time Zone
Compensation: $145,000-$165,000 + 13-15% bonus
Reports to: VP of IT

About the Role

BigID is hiring a Senior IT Operations Engineer to be the person teams turn to when a workflow crosses several tools, and nobody owns the gaps between them. You will build the automation that connects our systems, run the identity layer that controls access, and bring AI tooling to teams across the company.

This is an individual contributor role with a lot of room to lead. You will set your own technical direction, take projects from first request through rollout, and handle both planned project work and service desk escalations, so you will move between long builds and quick fixes.

We run internal IT with a DevOps mindset: systems are defined as code, changes ship through CI/CD, and repetitive work gets automated before it gets done by hand. Part of the global IT team is in Tel Aviv, so you will also be the North American contact for urgent requests, escalations, and production incidents when they are offline.

Most of your work happens with the Security, R&D, People, Support, Engineering, and GTM teams. You will work with them to understand a process that currently depends on someone copying data between tools, design the fix, build it, document it, and keep it running.

Example Projects

•
Connecting Claude to a team’s tools, such as adding an MCP-backed data source to a Slack channel and deciding what access it gets

•
Building an Okta Workflow that applies conditional access to strengthen our security posture

•
Writing an AWS Lambda behind API Gateway to link two systems, defined in Terraform and deployed through GitLab CI/CD

•
Diagnosing a failing Workato recipe caused by a malformed payload

•
Tracing an email bounce to its root cause in Google Workspace

What You’ll Do

Automation and integration. You will own automation in AWS (Lambda, API Gateway) and GCP, defined as code with Terraform and deployed through GitLab CI/CD. You will also own Okta Workflows, our main automation engine, along with Workato, REST APIs, and webhooks. You will write scripts in Python or Go, support the integrations around Salesforce (Auth0, Slack, Jira, and our data warehouse), and set up backups for critical systems such as Jira, GitHub, and Okta Workflows. You will also look across IT processes to find and build new automation.

AI enablement. You will own the Claude rollout, including its connectors and Claude Tag in Slack. You will host and govern MCP servers, including the Cloudflare MCP portal, and support other AI tools teams request, such as Gemini and Copilot. You will review each new connector for security and access scope, and support internal agents.

Identity and access. You will own Okta and Auth0 administration, including Auth0 Actions, SCIM, MFA, device trust, and joiner, mover, and leaver processes. You will also connect Okta to access governance tools such as Entitle or Lumos.

Security and edge. You will own DNS, PKI, WAF, and rate limiting in Cloudflare, along with email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). You will support the CloudFront sites customers use, coordinate hosting changes with web agencies, and help the security team investigate findings.

Workplace tools and support. You will own Google Workspace, Jira, JSM, Confluence, Slack, and GitLab, and work alongside the owners of Zoom, Microsoft 365, and the wider SaaS stack. You will handle Tier 2 and Tier 3 service desk escalations, troubleshoot Windows and macOS endpoints, and manage vendor support cases. You will also support device-based access policies with the team that manages Iru Kandji and Intune.

Documentation and continuous improvement. You will write runbooks, architecture notes, and handoff documents so no system depends on one person’s memory. You will document and implement processes, maintain an accurate inventory of hardware, software, and resources, and manage IT vendor and contractor relationships. You will also look for weak points in our processes and update infrastructure so it scales, repeats reliably, and stays secure.

What You’ll Bring

•
7+ years in IT operations, DevOps, cloud engineering, or IAM engineering, including 2+ years automating IT processes. Equivalent experience will be considered.

•
Hands-on Okta administration, including Okta Workflows, and experience with Auth0 custom logic such as Actions or rules

•
Working knowledge of AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront, IAM) and GCP (projects, IAM, BigQuery)

•
Experience building integrations with Workato or a similar iPaaS tool

•
Proficiency in at least one automation language (Python, Go, or Node.js) and experience with REST APIs and webhooks

•
Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or Pulumi) and CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitLab

•
Practical experience with Claude or comparable LLM tools, connectors, and MCP servers, with an understanding of their security implications

•
Experience with Cloudflare (DNS, certificates, Workers) and strong Google Workspace administration

•
A solid understanding of SSO (SAML, OIDC), MFA, SCIM, RBAC, DNS, and email authentication

•
Familiarity with an MDM such as Iru Kandji or Intune, and experience troubleshooting Windows and macOS

•
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail

•
Excellent written and verbal English, with strong documentation habits

•
Discretion with confidential information

How You Work

You lead without direct reports. You set direction, see projects through to completion, and make decisions. You think about security in every process and treat identity as the front door, so you check what an app or connector can reach before approving it. You start from what a team is trying to accomplish and design automation around that goal. You bring an employee-experience mindset, so you treat every issue, large or small, with empathy and follow through. You are a generalist who enjoys learning new tools, and in a single week you might work across Okta, Auth0, AWS, GCP, Cloudflare, and Google Workspace.

Nice to Have

•
Salesforce Apex and Flow

•
Custom MCP servers or agent frameworks

•
SQL, and experience with BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks

•
Azure or other public cloud experience

•
Access governance or SaaS security tools such as Entitle or Lumos

•
SOC 2 or ISO 27001 experience, including vulnerability management

•
HRIS-driven provisioning (for example, HiBob to Okta)

•
Relevant certifications (AWS, GCP, Okta)

We’re committed to creating a culture of inclusion and equality – across race, gender, sexuality, and disability – where innovation and growth thrive, every voice is heard, and everybody belongs. Learn more about us here (https://www.linkedin.com/company/bigid/life/1ebcf6b2-34ec-4fda-b860-8390551a5f57/?viewAsMember=true).

Job Candidate Privacy Notice (https://bigid.com/job-candidate-privacy-notice/)

Must be able to exercise independent judgment with little or no oversight.

BigID is an E-Verify Participant.

I would define the HRIS as the authoritative source, map employment events to lifecycle states, and use SCIM and Okta Workflows for account provisioning, group assignment, entitlement changes, and deprovisioning. I would include exception handling, approvals for privileged access, audit logs, retries, and regular reconciliation reports to identify failed or orphaned accounts. Describe how you would evaluate a new Claude or MCP connector before enabling it for employees. I would identify the data sources and permissions the connector can access, validate its authentication model, inspect scopes and data-handling practices, and apply least-privilege access. I would involve security and data owners for sensitive systems, pilot the connector with a limited group, document approved use cases, and establish monitoring and a revocation process. How would you troubleshoot a failing Workato recipe caused by a malformed payload? I would review the recipe job history and error details, capture the inbound payload, and compare its structure and data types to the expected schema. I would isolate the failing field, validate upstream API or webhook changes, add input validation and defensive transformations, then test with representative payloads before deploying a documented fix. What is your approach to deploying an AWS Lambda integration through Terraform and GitLab CI/CD? I would define the Lambda, IAM roles, API Gateway resources, environment configuration, logging, and alerts in Terraform. The GitLab pipeline would run formatting, validation, security scanning, tests, plan review, and controlled apply stages, with separate environments and protected production approvals. I would also ensure secrets are managed outside source code and that rollback procedures are tested. How do you balance urgent service desk escalations with strategic infrastructure work? I use clear severity criteria, service ownership, and scheduled project capacity so critical incidents receive immediate attention without allowing routine requests to consume all engineering time. I document recurring issues, automate high-volume tasks, and use backlog reviews with stakeholders to communicate tradeoffs, priorities, and delivery timelines. title: Customer Results Manager II
description:
About Tekmetric (https://jobicy.com/company/tekmetric)

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

Where We Work: At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

About the Role

The Results Manager II (RMII) is a role that owns the full customer journey from the moment a contract is signed through the first six months on the platform. As the primary point of contact for single-location auto repair shops (SMB 1), you're responsible for getting each shop live, driving meaningful product adoption, and ensuring they see real results fast enough to stay and grow. Your success is measured by two things: activations and retention.

What You’ll Do

• Become a Tekmetric Product Expert

• Guide new SMB 1 shops through the full onboarding process — from contract close to go-live — including account setup and data migration.

• Build genuine relationships with shop owners and serve as their primary point of contact throughout their first six months.

• Lead all calls and hands-on training sessions with shop stakeholders to ensure adoption of Tekmetric.

• Monitor customer product usage to drive best practices and improvement of key metrics in the system.

• Own customer risks & escalations — whether it's a stalled implementation or a customer who’s become unresponsive — you are the first line of defense.

• Ensure accurate documentation of activity & progress throughout the customer journey.

• Collaborate internally with Sales, Support, and Product teams to handle customer feedback and de-escalate when necessary.

• Reinforce Tekmetric as the industry standard for customer service and communication.

This is an exciting and rewarding role for anyone that wants to develop or kick-start their career in Onboarding or Customer Success! There are many opportunities for career development and progression.

What You’ll Bring

• 1-2 years’ in Customer Onboarding, Customer Success, or other customer facing roles.

• Project management: Proven ability to manage concurrent client onboarding timelines, track milestones, and drive product adoption without direct supervision.

• Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead customer-facing calls, explaining complex details with simplicity and clarity.

• Organization: Strong time-management skills, prioritizing tasks efficiently and maintaining documentation throughout the onboarding lifecycle.

• Adaptability: Confidence in ability to work through ambiguity or change, keeping client progress moving forward.

• Familiarity with CRM tools like Salesforce is a plus, but not required.

• Automotive industry experience or knowledge is appreciated, but not required.

• Bachelor’s Degree Preferred.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

Health & Wellness That Have You Covered:

• Enjoy the flexibility of remote work

• Competitive base salaries that reflect your value.

• Flexible PTO — No set number of days, just the trust to take the time you need. We genuinely encourage our team to disconnect and recharge.

• Support for every stage of life—with paid maternity, parental bonding, and medical leave for you or your loved ones.

• Comprehensive health benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage. For employee only, we offer plans that cover 100% of premiums and we cover 50% of costs for families.

• Prioritizing your mental health: get free, confidential counseling through our partnership with BetterHelp.

Investing in Your Future (and Present):

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% employer match on contributions up to 6% - so your future self will thank you.

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) to make your money go further.

• Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance for added peace of mind.

• Wellness on your terms: get up to $60/month toward fitness, mental health, or almost anything that helps you feel your best.

• After one year of employment, enjoy a $300 home office setup bonus to help make your space work for you.

• Keep growing with support for continuing education - we’re invested in your development.

Most importantly, we have a stellar team, a whole lot of fun, and work that actually matters to the shops and families we serve!

Tekmetric is an equal opportunity employer. We hire hard-working individuals, regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Tekmetric will never ask for your personal financial or banking information or require any financial commitment as part of our candidate search or application process. No job offers will be made without a formal interview process. All legitimate Tekmetric job postings are listed at tekmetric.com/careers (http://tekmetric.com/careers). title: Engineering Manager
description:
At NetBox Labs (https://jobicy.com/company/netbox-labs), our mission is to make it easier to build and manage complex networks. As a product company, we do that by developing innovative software for network professionals delivered on-premises and in the cloud.

We believe in the power of community and collaboration, and we are looking for a hands-on, player-coach Engineering Manager to lead one of our talented teams. These teams build our core software applications including NetBox and NetBox Add-ons, SDKs, and Plugins, and our observability suite including Diode, Diode Agents and SDKs, and Orb. Much of this development is open source and done in collaboration with our community, but also spans source-available and proprietary software. This role reports to the Director of Engineering.

In this role you will:

•
Lead a squad of engineers day-to-day while staying hands-on: reviewing code, jumping into design discussions, and occasionally shipping code yourself to unblock the team or model best practices.

•
Drive execution relentlessly — break down ambiguous problems into clear plans, set sprint goals, remove blockers fast, and hold the team accountable to deadlines.

•
Own the software development lifecycle for your team's projects, from planning and design through implementation, testing, and release.

•
Run effective sprint planning, stand-ups, and retros using GitHub and internal tools, helping engineers break work into well-scoped, executable pieces.

•
Champion modern, secure software development practices and keep quality bars high without slowing the team down.

•
Partner closely with product managers to translate customer and community problems into shippable plans, pushing back with data when scope or timelines don't add up.

•
Coach and mentor engineers individually — give direct, timely feedback, help them grow technically, and build a strong bench for future hiring.

•
Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team.

•
Act as a liaison between your team and the broader tech community, supporting open-source contributors and guiding community-facing initiatives where relevant.

•
Report progress transparently to engineering leadership, flagging risks early rather than after they've become problems.

•
Stay close enough to the code and the architecture to make credible calls on technical trade-offs, while trusting your engineers to own the details of implementation.

You will work closely with:

•
Director of Engineering to coordinate cross-functional initiatives and ensure your team's work runs smoothly in our commercial products.

•
Product team to understand customer and community problems and turn them into a stellar user experience.

•
Peer engineering managers to plan cross-functional projects, clarify ownership, surface dependencies, and clear blockers together.

Qualifications:

•
2+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager or Team Lead, ideally in a player-coach capacity where you're still writing code or reviewing PRs regularly.

•
A track record of driving projects to completion on tight timelines, with a strong bias toward action and unblocking your team over process for its own sake.

•
Strong technical background sufficient to review designs and code, and earn credibility with senior engineers.

•
Experience with Agile methodologies, DevOps, and CI/CD in a fast-moving environment.

•
Proficiency with GitHub for code management, project tracking, and collaboration.

•
Solid understanding of software security principles and practices.

•
Experience with open-source software development and community engagement is a plus.

•
Excellent, direct communication skills — comfortable giving and receiving fast feedback in a remote, async-first environment.

•
Proven ability to coach engineers and help them grow, while still being the person who rolls up their sleeves when the team needs it.

It would be fantastic if you have the following background:

•
Networking industry experience.

•
Familiarity with Python, Django, Go, gRPC, or OpenTelemetry.

•
Knowledge of cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure).

•
Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

•
Understanding of data privacy regulations and compliance requirements.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

•
We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

•
Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

•
We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

•
Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

title: Co-Brand Program Growth Manager
description:
Company Summary:

With Alviere (https://himalayas.app/companies/alviere), organizations can offer financial products to drive customer engagement, generate new revenue streams, and improve existing financial flows. The Alviere (https://himalayas.app/companies/alviere) HIVE platform offers an extensive range of configurable, branded financial products, including accounts & wallets, card issuance, streamlined payments, and global money transfers. Alviere (https://himalayas.app/companies/alviere) brings together technology and program support with the trust of a licensed financial institution to assure the safety, flexibility, and long-term viability of client programs.

Job Summary:

As Co-Brand Program Growth Manager, you are the person who makes co-brand programs work in the real world. Once a program launches inside a globally recognized brand, you own its day-to-day success ensuring it runs well, performs against plan, and consistently delivers value to the end customers whose financial lives it touches.

This is a hands-on execution role with real accountability. You develop deep fluency in co-brand debit economics, you know what healthy program performance looks like, and you're the trusted operational presence that brand partners rely on. You're not directing strategy from above you're in the details, solving problems, driving consistency, and making sure nothing slips. Within 90 days, your partners know you by name, you understand the market cold, and every program you own is running with clarity and momentum.

What You'll Own

• Own the day-to-day operational health of multiple live co-brand programs, maintaining a clear view of performance, risks, and open issues across each

• Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise brand partners post-launch, building trust through deep product knowledge, transparency, and consistent follow-through

• Run structured operating cadences — weekly syncs, monthly reviews, QBRs — and translate partner feedback into actionable inputs for product, sales, and executive leadership

• Coordinate across internal teams to keep programs moving, priorities visible, and partner commitments on track

• Monitor program KPIs — activation, engagement, transaction volume, retention — and translate data into clear business decisions and performance narratives

A successful Co-Brand Program Growth Manager will have the following:

• 5–8 years in fintech operations, B2B program management, or loyalty program operations with direct ownership of live programs end-to-end

• Experience as the primary operational contact for enterprise clients post-launch, including regular engagement with senior or executive stakeholders

• Strong business-focused analytical instincts — you connect data to outcomes, not just metrics

• Exceptional organizational discipline across multiple programs at different lifecycle stages

• Comfortable building processes in a growth-stage environment, not just following them

• Familiarity with regulated financial products (cards, accounts, payments) strongly preferred

Nice to Have: Direct Co-Brand card or debit program experience, Loyalty or rewards program background, C-suite presentation experience.

In accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the expected salary range for this position is $135,000.00 - $180,000.00 per year. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location. This position is eligible for Company bonus and equity. Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurances, unlimited paid time off, 401k plan w/company match.

For Colorado Applicants:

Applicants are not required to provide age-related information in their application materials, such as dates of graduation or years of attendance. You may redact or omit these details from your résumé or other documents submitted with your application. If age verification is necessary for legal compliance, it will only be requested after a conditional job offer is made.

We pride ourselves on developing and promoting talent as an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer - Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender, age, religion, disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. We are a true merit-based organization and work hard so there are no artificial barriers to one's potential success. Alviere (https://himalayas.app/companies/alviere) is committed to a workforce where everyone's opportunities are limitless.

Consistent with this commitment, Alviere (https://himalayas.app/companies/alviere) will endeavor to provide reasonable accommodation to otherwise qualified job applicants and employees with known physical or mental disabilities. Please contact for any assistance.

Originally posted on Himalayas (https://himalayas.app)

title: Head of Customer Operations
description:
ABOUT HAPPY MONEY (https://jobicy.com/company/happy-money)

Happy Money is a consumer finance company that empowers people to achieve their goals through simple, transparent loans funded by trusted financial institutions. Through its proprietary lending platform, Hive, Happy Money delivers a fully digital experience that simplifies borrowing for consumers and helps credit unions, banks and asset managers diversify balance sheets and scale with confidence.

Happy Money’s end-to-end loan origination and participation programs provide partners with turnkey access to high-performing assets, underpinned by disciplined credit expertise and robust risk management. Together with its lending partners, Happy Money has originated more than $7 billion in loans to help nearly 350,000 people take greater control of their financial futures. Learn more at happymoney.com. View our Employee Privacy Policy (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PlDoDVlGPfcmkNK5meAmsnFV6DVuiypG/view?usp=sharing) here.

Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed company based in the United States. Remote work doesn’t mean less work, we work full-time jobs and show up to them fully every day. To learn more about our values and the way we work, review our Happy Money Way Overview! (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1wtjH-1Y9UDgAGX_5AjcSvF3y08zf3t1M/view)

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an execution-focused Head of Customer Operations to lead our Loan Fulfillment, Customer Experience, and Collections teams. Reporting directly to the Chief Operations Officer you will have full ownership of the entire operations function, including managing operational teams, driving initiatives to enhance efficiency and effectiveness, optimizing the applicant experience, and overseeing key third-party vendor relationships.

This role is instrumental in delivering a seamless, secure, and highly efficient lending experience, with significant emphasis placed on collections effectiveness, streamlining the applicant verifications process, and driving improvements in application-to-funding pull-through rates. You’ll ensure robust risk controls, continuously improve operational processes, and collaborate cross-functionally to scale operations and implement strategies that balance growth, efficiency, customer satisfaction, and rigorous risk management.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own and Drive Operational Strategy:
Define, track, and evolve critical performance metrics across operations, prioritizing scalability, efficiency, and execution. Proactively optimize processes that enhance verification efficiency, increase pull-through rates, and elevate the applicant and borrower experience.

• Optimize Loan Application and Verification Processes:
Lead efforts to streamline and accelerate the application-to-funding journey. Implement best-in-class verification processes that reduce friction, increase conversion, and support scalable growth.

• Enhance Collections and Servicing:
Lead the development and continuous refinement of collections strategies to improve performance , reduce losses, and maintain exceptional customer interactions throughout the repayment lifecycle.

• Elevate the Customer and Applicant Experience:
Advocate strongly for the Voice of the Customer, ensuring every interaction—from initial application to loan servicing—is frictionless and supportive. Continuously measure and enhance customer satisfaction while balancing growth, risk, and operational efficiency.

• Vendor and Partner Management:
Fully own relationships with third-party service providers, ensuring vendors effectively support collections, underwriting verification processes, fraud detection, and customer service objectives. Ensure strong performance accountability with all external partners.

• Build a Culture of Operational Excellence:
Recruit, mentor, and develop operational leaders and their teams, creating a culture focused on accountability, execution, efficiency, and data driven decision making.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally:
Actively collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to align operations with broader company objectives, ensuring seamless integration and execution of strategic initiatives.

• Drive Process and Technology Improvements:
Proactively identify and implement automation, be comfortable with implementing AI agents, and advanced analytics that significantly improve operational efficiency, pull-through rates, collections effectiveness, and the overall customer experience.

• Ensure Compliance and Robust Risk Management:
Maintain rigorous compliance practices and embed strong risk controls within loan operations, verifications, servicing, and collections.

Note: This role requires quarterly in-person domestic/international travel for vendor and BPO visits.

ABOUT YOU

• 10+ years of experience in loan operations, servicing, verifications, and collections, with deep expertise in collections and proven experience optimizing verification processes and improving pull-through rates.

• 5+ years of senior leadership experience managing high-performing operational teams, demonstrating success in developing talent and fostering accountability and high performance.

• Track record of optimizing and scaling operations, specifically enhancing collections processes, verification efficiency, and application-to-funding conversion.

• Strong experience overseeing operational processes related to fraud prevention, verification, and customer support, with demonstrated capability in balancing exceptional customer experiences with risk management and operational efficiency.

• Proven ability to effectively balance growth initiatives with rigorous compliance and risk management in regulated financial environments.

• Customer-focused mindset, ensuring all applicant and borrower interactions remain efficient, supportive, and frictionless throughout their lending journey.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations Management, or related field required.

• Experience in FinTech, consumer lending, personal loans, or high-growth financial services companies.

BONUS POINTS FOR

• Proven success scaling operations and successfully implementing AI-agents, whether internally developed or through partnerships.

• Prior experience collaborating or working closely with credit unions, banks, or other financial institutions.

BENEFITS & PERKS

• Generous medical, dental, and vision insurance options

• Eligible for Annual Bonus

• 401k Plan with a matching contribution

• Generous PTO including sick leave, vacation, volunteer, and more

• 12 Weeks Paid Parental Leave

• Company-paid short & long term disability and life insurance

• Monthly tech stipend to help cover expenses for remote work

• Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed workforce within the U.S.

Base Salary Range

$200,000—$225,000 USD

title: Regional Sales Manager, Financial Services
description:
At ExtraHop (https://jobicy.com/company/extrahop), we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

ExtraHop is redefining cyber defense for the AI era. As an innovator and leader, we help organizations secure the transition to the "Agentic Enterprise" by defending against AI-powered attacks while delivering full visibility across their AI estate. We turn the network into "Decision-Grade Intelligence"—the high-fidelity context that enables security teams to detect threats, investigate faster, and respond at machine speed. If you are an experienced sales professional who thrives in the FinServ security market and can help customers navigate the transition to an Agentic SOC, we want to hear from you.

This key position requires someone who is able to learn and maintain in-depth knowledge of ExtraHop’s vision, products and technologies, and industry trends. You are primarily responsible for maintaining and increasing revenue in assigned regions/territories through identifying, recruiting and developing opportunity for generating net new logos with our channel and alliance partnerships.

This role offers significant earning potential for sales professionals who consistently deliver results. With a strong portfolio of strategic Financial Services accounts, meaningful revenue opportunities, and a performance-driven compensation structure, successful representatives have the opportunity to earn as they grow existing relationships, close new business, and expand their account footprint.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and grow a portfolio of strategic Financial Services accounts

• Identify prospects for ExtraHop products through cold calls, and lead follow-up and face-to-face meetings

• Align with senior executives to understand the business, decision-making, and financing processes of your territory; ability to align ExtraHop leadership with correct decision makers

• Demonstrate a strong understanding of the unique cybersecurity challenges facing Financial Services organizations

• Present and demonstrate ExtraHop products to customers

• Provide customer and competitor feedback and field intelligence where available and necessary

• Articulate the value of the 'Agentic Enterprise' and the need for decision-grade intelligence to drive security outcomes.

• Help customers transition from reactive, disconnected alerts to proactive, autonomous workflows within their SOC.

• Sell the platform's unique ability to provide visibility across the entire AI estate, including traffic patterns and AI-model interactions.

• Demonstrate how ExtraHop serves as the foundational 'source of truth' for both human analysts and autonomous AI agents.

• Identify opportunities to solve for modern threats, including AI-powered attacks, identity-based attacks, and shadow AI usage.

• Prepare and implement strategic sales account plans for all customers and identify business growth opportunities in assigned customer base

• Ensure resellers and field sales engineers and management are working together in the sales process, lead generation, registering opportunities, accurately forecasting revenue, and tracking to required revenue goals established by their discount tier

• Work with resellers to grow business in your territory

• Prepare and maintain an accurate sales forecast for your territory

• Network in customer and related organizations

Required Qualifications

• Four-year degree or equivalent in a related discipline (e.g., information technology, computer science, business, or engineering)

• 8-10 years experience in technology sales with a consistent track record of exceeding sales targets in the FinServ market

• 5 years security sales experience

• Existing relationships with senior level leaders within FinServ market

• Demonstrated technical acumen to articulate ExtraHop's value proposition in a differentiated and compelling manner

• Strong communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills

• Deep understanding of the modern SOC landscape, specifically the shift toward Agentic SOC and the need for run-time asset visibility.

• Proven ability to sell NDR or complex security solutions that integrate across existing infrastructure.

• Ability to articulate the risks associated with AI adoption and the importance of visibility and governance across the AI estate.

• Experience mapping sales strategy to business outcomes like reduced mean time to detect/respond and improved security ROI.

• Strong AI skills, communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills

• Demonstrated ability to secure meetings and close deals with senior level executives

• Solid understanding of enterprise networking technologies: switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers, WAN optimization technologies, and so forth is a plus

• Background in software/hardware sales and distribution with large software, hardware, and/or networking companies

• Ability to travel at least 50% of the time, with day to day job on the road but works remotely.

• Work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders.

• Work well in fast-paced, high-stress environments.

• Has predictable, reliable attendance.

The base salary range for this role is $155,000 - $175,000 with a 50/50 split + benefits

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

• Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits

• Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time

• Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan

• FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable

• Educational Reimbursement

• 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable

• Pet Insurance (US Only)

• Parental Leave (US Only)

• Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website (https://www.extrahop.com/) or follow us on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/extrahop-networks/).
