title: Director, People Operations
description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly (https://jobicy.com/company/launchdarkly) is looking for a Director, People Operations to lead the operating model, service delivery, and continuous improvement of People Operations and Talent Acquisition operations across the employee and candidate lifecycles.

Reporting to the Senior Director, People Operations, you will lead a connected portfolio spanning global People Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, employee and candidate experience, compliance-related workflows, operational governance, and team capability for a growing global company. You will translate business and People priorities into clear ownership, scalable processes, strong controls, and a reliable operating rhythm.

This role will work in close partnership with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics. The Director, People Operations will own operational outcomes, service delivery, process execution, and stakeholder partnership. The Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics will own managing the strategy and roadmap for People programs, systems, analytics, AI, data governance, and change enablement. Together, these leaders will create a practical, integrated People operating model that is trusted by employees, candidates, managers, HRBPs, and business leaders.

Responsibilities:

People Operations Leadership

• Establish the global People Operations operating model across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employee data changes, employment documentation, employee support, contingent workforce processes, international operations, and related service delivery.

• Manage the activities of the People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations teams, creating clear expectations, effective prioritization, strong collaboration, and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

• Establish service standards, escalation paths, operating rhythms, and ownership models that make it easy for employees, managers, HRBPs, and cross-functional partners to get the right support.

• Own operational readiness and execution for policies, compliance-related workflows, employment agreements, audits, immigration and mobility processes, accommodations, background checks, and other high-risk employee lifecycle activities in partnership with Legal and relevant subject-matter experts.

• Improve the consistency, quality, and equity of the employee experience across U.S. and international processes while accounting for local requirements and operational complexity.

• Build scalable documentation, self-service resources, controls, and standard operating procedures that reduce avoidable manual work and improve accuracy.

• Manage key People Operations vendors and partnerships, including service quality, contracts, issue resolution, risk management, and performance against expectations.

• Serve as an escalation point for complex People Operations issues, using sound judgment, discretion, and a strong understanding of employee trust and business risk.

Talent Acquisition Operations

• Establish the operating model for Talent Acquisition Operations, including recruiting intake, role setup, approvals, job posting workflows, interview coordination, interview loop management, candidate communications, offer process support, and recruiting operations reporting.

• Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership to improve recruiter and coordinator capacity, operating discipline, candidate experience, hiring-manager partnership, and consistency across recruiting workflows.

• Establish clear ownership and service standards across recruiting operations, including intake quality, scheduling, interview readiness, candidate handoffs, and offer-to-onboarding transitions.

• Identify opportunities to simplify and strengthen Greenhouse and connected recruiting workflows in partnership with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics and technical partners.

• Support scalable recruiting programs, vendor management, executive recruiting operations, contingent recruiting processes, and other Talent Acquisition priorities as the business evolves.

• Use recruiting and operational signals to surface bottlenecks, clarify tradeoffs, and recommend improvements to hiring velocity, quality, candidate experience, and team capacity.

Partnership with People Programs, Systems & Analytics

• Partner with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics to maintain one integrated roadmap across People Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, People programs, systems, analytics, and AI.

• Translate operational pain points and stakeholder needs into clear requirements, process improvements, system enhancements, reporting needs, and measurable outcomes.

• Jointly define operating metrics, service-level expectations, data requirements, and success measures for employee and candidate lifecycle processes.

• Ensure new systems, workflows, programs, and automation are operationally sound, documented, adopted, and supported after launch.

• Partner on data quality, process governance, access controls, reporting definitions, and responsible use of automation and AI involving employee or candidate information.

• Create a disciplined operating rhythm for prioritization, dependency management, risk review, decision-making, and communication across the People portfolio.

Cross-functional Partnership and Change

• Partner closely with HRBPs, Recruiting, Finance, Legal, IT, AppEng, TechOps, Payroll, Workplace, Internal Communications, and external vendors to deliver reliable People and Talent processes.

• Lead change adoption for operational changes, including stakeholder alignment, communications, training, readiness, issue management, and post-launch improvement.

• Bring structure to ambiguous work, identify root causes, and make practical decisions that balance employee experience, candidate experience, compliance, speed, scalability, and cost.

• Represent People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations in cross-functional planning, business reviews, and executive discussions.

• Build strong relationships with business leaders and managers so People processes are understood, usable, and aligned to business needs.

Qualifications:

• 15+ years of experience in People Operations, HR Operations, Talent Operations, shared services, or a similarly complex People function, including 5 years leadership experience across both employee and candidate lifecycle operations.

• Demonstrated success designing or scaling a global People Operations or Talent Acquisition Operations operating models at both small as well as medium-to-large sized companies.

• Experience leading and developing teams across multiple operational disciplines, with a track record of creating clarity, accountability, and strong service delivery.

• Strong understanding of employee lifecycle operations, recruiting operations, HR compliance, employee data, HR systems, recruiting systems, and cross-functional dependencies.

• Experience with Greenhouse or an equivalent recruiting system, including workflows, approvals, reporting, integrations, or process improvement.

• Experience improving operational controls, documentation, self-service, service delivery, data quality, and process consistency at scale.

• Experience designing, managing, or improving integrations across HR systems and connected People tools to support reliable data flows and scalable operations.

• Experience partnering effectively with Legal, Finance, IT, Payroll, HRBPs, Recruiting, and business leaders on sensitive or high-impact work.

• Sound judgment when handling confidential employee and candidate information, compliance-related matters, escalations, and employee experience risks.

• Strong program management, prioritization, change leadership, written communication, and executive communication skills.

• Ability to use data and operational metrics to diagnose issues, set priorities, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations.

• Willingness to remain close enough to the work to understand process details, remove barriers, and personally solve complex problems when needed.

About You:

• You are a thoughtful, service-oriented People leader who combines operational discipline with empathy and care.

• You create clarity in complex environments and are comfortable making decisions when ownership, process, or information is incomplete.

• You see the connections between People Operations, Talent Acquisition, systems, data, compliance, and employee experience.

• You are hands-on enough to understand how work gets done and strategic enough to build a model that scales.

• You build trust through sound judgment, transparency, follow-through, and respect for confidential information.

• You are collaborative and pragmatic, with a strong instinct for root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.

• You care about creating consistent, equitable, and people-centered experiences for employees, candidates, managers, and internal partners.

What Success Looks Like:

• People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations have clear ownership, service standards, escalation paths, and operating rhythms.

• Employees, candidates, managers, HRBPs, and business leaders experience more consistent, responsive, and equitable support.

• Core employee and candidate lifecycle processes are documented, measurable, scalable, and supported by appropriate controls and self-service resources.

• People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations teams are engaged, capable, and organized around the highest-value work.

• Greenhouse and connected workflows support a reliable, efficient, and high-quality recruiting experience in partnership with the People systems function.

• The People team has a clear, integrated roadmap across operational execution, programs, systems, analytics, and AI, with well-managed dependencies and decisions.

• Operational risks, data-quality issues, manual work, and process fragmentation are identified early and reduced over time.

• People leaders and business partners trust the function to deliver practical solutions, communicate clearly, and follow through on commitments.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level M4:

• Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $191,800 - $263,670**

• Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $172,600 - $237,270*

• Zone 3: All other US locations - $163,000 - $224,070**

• All Zones Inclusive of a 15% Bonus Target

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with candidate needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. Restricted Stock Units, health, vision, dental, and mental health benefits are provided in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

• Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

• Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts

• Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

• Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

• Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com.

Do you need a disability accommodation?

Fill out this accommodations request form (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdYb_7upYMtdRVXzvXGHGfQw0pU2FNma-6Rwp-I6NjKm7SYNw/viewform) and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @launchdarkly.com (http://launchdarkly.com) email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visitCareers | LaunchDarkly (https://launchdarkly.com/careers/) directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to careers@launchdarkly.com.

About the Job: LaunchDarkly is looking for a Director, People Operations to lead the operating model, service delivery, and continuous improvement of People Operations and Talent Acquisition operations across the employee and candidate lifecycles. Reporting to the Senior Director, People Operations, you will lead a connected portfolio spanning global People Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, employee and candidate experience, compliance-related workflows, operational governance, and team capability for a growing global company. You will translate business and People priorities into clear ownership, scalable processes, strong controls, and a reliable operating rhythm. This role will work in close partnership with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics. The Director, People Operations will own operational outcomes, service delivery, process execution, and stakeholder partnership. The Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics will own managing the strategy and roadmap for People programs, systems, analytics, AI, data governance, and change enablement. Together, these leaders will create a practical, integrated People operating model that is trusted by employees, candidates, managers, HRBPs, and business leaders. Responsibilities: People Operations Leadership Establish the global People Operations operating model across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employee data changes, employment documentation, employee support, contingent workforce processes, international operations, and related service delivery. Manage the activities of the People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations teams, creating clear expectations, effective prioritization, strong collaboration, and a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. Establish service standards, escalation paths, operating rhythms, and ownership models that make it easy for employees, managers, HRBPs, and cross-functional partners to get the right support. Own operational readiness and execution for policies, compliance-related workflows, employment agreements, audits, immigration and mobility processes, accommodations, background checks, and other high-risk employee lifecycle activities in partnership with Legal and relevant subject-matter experts. Improve the consistency, quality, and equity of the employee experience across U.S. and international processes while accounting for local requirements and operational complexity. Build scalable documentation, self-service resources, controls, and standard operating procedures that reduce avoidable manual work and improve accuracy. Manage key People Operations vendors and partnerships, including service quality, contracts, issue resolution, risk management, and performance against expectations. Serve as an escalation point for complex People Operations issues, using sound judgment, discretion, and a strong understanding of employee trust and business risk. Talent Acquisition Operations Establish the operating model for Talent Acquisition Operations, including recruiting intake, role setup, approvals, job posting workflows, interview coordination, interview loop management, candidate communications, offer process support, and recruiting operations reporting. Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership to improve recruiter and coordinator capacity, operating discipline, candidate experience, hiring-manager partnership, and consistency across recruiting workflows. Establish clear ownership and service standards across recruiting operations, including intake quality, scheduling, interview readiness, candidate handoffs, and offer-to-onboarding transitions. Identify opportunities to simplify and strengthen Greenhouse and connected recruiting workflows in partnership with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics and technical partners. Support scalable recruiting programs, vendor management, executive recruiting operations, contingent recruiting processes, and other Talent Acquisition priorities as the business evolves. Use recruiting and operational signals to surface bottlenecks, clarify tradeoffs, and recommend improvements to hiring velocity, quality, candidate experience, and team capacity. Partnership with People Programs, Systems & Analytics Partner with the Director, People Programs, Systems & Analytics to maintain one integrated roadmap across People Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, People programs, systems, analytics, and AI. Translate operational pain points and stakeholder needs into clear requirements, process improvements, system enhancements, reporting needs, and measurable outcomes. Jointly define operating metrics, service-level expectations, data requirements, and success measures for employee and candidate lifecycle processes. Ensure new systems, workflows, programs, and automation are operationally sound, documented, adopted, and supported after launch. Partner on data quality, process governance, access controls, reporting definitions, and responsible use of automation and AI involving employee or candidate information. Create a disciplined operating rhythm for prioritization, dependency management, risk review, decision-making, and communication across the People portfolio. Cross-functional Partnership and Change Partner closely with HRBPs, Recruiting, Finance, Legal, IT, AppEng, TechOps, Payroll, Workplace, Internal Communications, and external vendors to deliver reliable People and Talent processes. Lead change adoption for operational changes, including stakeholder alignment, communications, training, readiness, issue management, and post-launch improvement. Bring structure to ambiguous work, identify root causes, and make practical decisions that balance employee experience, candidate experience, compliance, speed, scalability, and cost. Represent People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations in cross-functional planning, business reviews, and executive discussions. Build strong relationships with business leaders and managers so People processes are understood, usable, and aligned to business needs. Qualifications: 15+ years of experience in People Operations, HR Operations, Talent Operations, shared services, or a similarly complex People function, including 5 years leadership experience across both employee and candidate lifecycle operations. Demonstrated success designing or scaling a global People Operations or Talent Acquisition Operations operating models at both small as well as medium-to-large sized companies. Experience leading and developing teams across multiple operational disciplines, with a track record of creating clarity, accountability, and strong service delivery. Strong understanding of employee lifecycle operations, recruiting operations, HR compliance, employee data, HR systems, recruiting systems, and cross-functional dependencies. Experience with Greenhouse or an equivalent recruiting system, including workflows, approvals, reporting, integrations, or process improvement. Experience improving operational controls, documentation, self-service, service delivery, data quality, and process consistency at scale. Experience designing, managing, or improving integrations across HR systems and connected People tools to support reliable data flows and scalable operations. Experience partnering effectively with Legal, Finance, IT, Payroll, HRBPs, Recruiting, and business leaders on sensitive or high-impact work. Sound judgment when handling confidential employee and candidate information, compliance-related matters, escalations, and employee experience risks. Strong program management, prioritization, change leadership, written communication, and executive communication skills. Ability to use data and operational metrics to diagnose issues, set priorities, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations. Willingness to remain close enough to the work to understand process details, remove barriers, and personally solve complex problems when needed. About You: You are a thoughtful, service-oriented People leader who combines operational discipline with empathy and care. You create clarity in complex environments and are comfortable making decisions when ownership, process, or information is incomplete. You see the connections between People Operations, Talent Acquisition, systems, data, compliance, and employee experience. You are hands-on enough to understand how work gets done and strategic enough to build a model that scales. You build trust through sound judgment, transparency, follow-through, and respect for confidential information. You are collaborative and pragmatic, with a strong instinct for root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. You care about creating consistent, equitable, and people-centered experiences for employees, candidates, managers, and internal partners. What Success Looks Like: People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations have clear ownership, service standards, escalation paths, and operating rhythms. Employees, candidates, managers, HRBPs, and business leaders experience more consistent, responsive, and equitable support. Core employee and candidate lifecycle processes are documented, measurable, scalable, and supported by appropriate controls and self-service resources. People Operations and Talent Acquisition Operations teams are engaged, capable, and organized around the highest-value work. Greenhouse and connected workflows support a reliable, efficient, and high-quality recruiting experience in partnership with the People systems function. The People team has a clear, integrated roadmap across operational execution, programs, systems, analytics, and AI, with well-managed dependencies and decisions. Operational risks, data-quality issues, manual work, and process fragmentation are identified early and reduced over time. People leaders and business partners trust the function to deliver practical solutions, communicate clearly, and follow through on commitments. At PointClickCare (https://jobicy.com/company/pointclickcare) our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.

With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.

At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.

Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. Position Summary:

PointClickCare is looking for a Content Strategist to own and execute the strategy for our owned brand content channels, including our blog, podcast, web content, long and short form content, and agency partnership brand programs. This role sits within the Brand Marketing team and is accountable for the owned brand content strategy end to end: from planning through production and performance.

This is a hands-on, executional role backed by strong strategic instincts. The ideal candidate can build a content strategy and then roll up their sleeves to deliver it. They will embed with marketing pods across the organization, translating product marketing and go-to-market strategy into brand strategy that fuels our top of funnel thought leadership engine.

This role works across multiple marketing pods and subject matter areas, requiring the ability to prioritize across a broad range of opportunities, build strong stakeholder relationships, and identify the content that will have the greatest impact on brand awareness, thought leadership, and audience engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the Owned Brand Content Strategy: Develop, manage, and execute the strategy across PointClickCare's owned channels, including the blog, podcast, web, and long and short form content, ensuring a consistent brand voice and point of view.

Execute at a High Standard: Move seamlessly from strategy to production. Plan editorial calendars, write and edit content, manage production workflows, and ship consistently against deadlines.

Translate GTM into Brand: Partner with all marketing pods to translate PMM and GTM strategy into brand content strategy, ensuring owned content supports top of funnel thought leadership objectives and business priorities.

Lead Owned Media Thought Leadership: Develop and execute thought leadership content for PointClickCare executives and subject matter experts across owned media channels, translating their expertise into compelling, differentiated content for the blog, podcast, and other owned formats where needed.

Drive Content Distribution: Develop channel and distribution strategies that extend the reach and impact of owned content, partnering with demand, social, web, and other teams to ensure content reaches priority audiences.

Manage Agency Partnership Brand Programs: Serve as the day-to-day executional lead on brand-related agency programs, managing deliverables and deadlines.

Cross-Pod Collaboration: Interface with product marketing, demand generation, and growth to align content with campaign priorities and audience needs, acting as the connective tissue between brand and the pods.

Measure and Optimize: Track content performance across owned channels, report on key metrics, and use insights to refine the strategy and editorial mix.

Content Frameworks and Best Practices: Establish guidelines for brand storytelling, content positioning, and channel strategy that raise the bar for content across the organization.

Own SUMMIT Content Strategy and Support Event Deliverables: Lead the owned content strategy for PointClickCare’s annual SUMMIT conference, developing the editorial approach and content plan across pre-event, onsite, and post-event channels, including podcast, blog, and paid media content. Support the development and review of attendee-facing deliverables, including registration and SUMMIT website copy, session titles and descriptions, presentation editing, booth messaging, wayfinding, hype videos, and other event content to ensure a cohesive and engaging experience.

Support Employer Brand Content Strategy: Partner with People, Talent Acquisition, HR, and other key stakeholders to support the employer brand content strategy. Develop and edit employee stories, recruitment campaign content, careers-focused web content, and other materials that bring PointClickCare’s culture and employee experience to life while maintaining a consistent brand voice

Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Proven experience in content strategy with a strong executional track record: this role requires someone who builds the plan and delivers the work.

• Hands-on experience managing owned channels such as blogs, podcasts, and web content, including editorial planning, writing, editing, and production.

• Experience managing agency partners and external content programs.

• Strong understanding of how brand content supports top of funnel demand and thought leadership, with the ability to translate PMM and GTM strategy into brand storytelling.

• Ability to analyze content performance metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, comfortable embedding with multiple teams and pods simultaneously.

title: Senior Engineer, Competitive Benchmarking & Performance
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead competitive benchmarking initiatives within the Elasticsearch Performance team.

You will develop representative workloads, automate reproducible experiments, and investigate how Elasticsearch compares with alternative systems. Your work will identify performance strengths, gaps, and tradeoffs, guide engineering improvements, and help customers make informed technical decisions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building benchmarks and investigating performance, with technical publishing as a shared responsibility alongside engineering and content partners.

A typical investigation might ask how Elasticsearch and an alternative system compare under concurrent ingestion and hybrid search, at comparable retrieval quality and cost, and which engineering changes would improve the outcome. This role offers the opportunity to connect deep performance analysis with product improvements and public technical work.

What You Will Be Doing

• Own prioritized competitive benchmarking initiatives across search, vector and hybrid retrieval, and analytical and observability workloads.

• Build and maintain automated benchmark harnesses, datasets, query sets, and load profiles that reflect real-world usage, including concurrent ingestion and querying.

• Design fair comparisons with documented system versions, configurations, tuning decisions, resource budgets, and functional differences.

• Evaluate latency distributions, throughput, resource consumption, and cost efficiency. For retrieval workloads, measure performance at comparable recall or relevance targets.

• Adapt and extend workload-appropriate tools such as Elasticsearch Rally, ClickBench, and vector search benchmark frameworks.

• Investigate performance differences using profiling, system metrics, and controlled experiments; collaborate with engineering teams to identify causes and validate improvements.

• Evaluate relevant self-managed and managed cloud deployments, including serverless offerings, accounting for scaling behavior and service constraints.

• Work with engineering and technical content partners to publish reproducible benchmark artifacts and clear technical reports that explain methodology, findings, limitations, and tradeoffs.

• Partner with engineering and product management to prioritize benchmark coverage and translate findings into actionable product improvements.

What You Bring

• Solid software engineering skills, with experience building maintainable automation and analysis tools in Python or another relevant programming language.

• Hands-on experience evaluating and diagnosing performance in distributed systems, databases, or search infrastructure.

• Depth in at least one relevant area (search, vector retrieval, analytical databases, or observability systems) and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

• Experience designing representative datasets and workloads, including query patterns, concurrency, and ingestion behavior.

• Sound experimental judgment, including repeated measurements, variability analysis, warm-up and cache effects, and the distinction between meaningful changes and measurement noise.

• Experience building reproducible test environments and documenting configurations, procedures, and results.

• Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings and their limitations.

• Solid collaboration skills and the ability to turn performance evidence into applicable engineering recommendations.

Bonus Points

• Experience with Elasticsearch, Lucene, Rally, ClickBench, or vector search benchmark frameworks.

• Experience measuring retrieval quality alongside latency, throughput, and resource usage.

• Familiarity with cloud performance and cost analysis, including autoscaling and serverless systems.

• Public technical writing, open-source contributions, or published benchmark studies.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary.  This role does not have a variable compensation component.

The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below.  In select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below.

These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.

An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:

$133,100—$210,600 USD

The typical starting salary range for this role in the select locations listed above is:

$159,900—$252,900 USD

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

• Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

• Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

• Generous number of vacation days each year

• Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

• Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

• Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

summary:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead competitive benchmarking initiatives within the Elasticsearch Performance team.

You will develop representative workloads, automate reproducible experiments, and investigate how Elasticsearch compares with alternative systems. Your work will identify performance strengths, gaps, and tradeoffs, guide engineering improvements, and help customers make informed technical decisions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building benchmarks and investigating performance, with technical publishing as a shared responsibility alongside engineering and content partners.

A typical investigation might ask how Elasticsearch and an alternative system compare under concurrent ingestion and hybrid search, at comparable retrieval quality and cost, and which engineering changes would improve the outcome. This role offers the opportunity to connect deep performance analysis with product improvements and public technical work.

What You Will Be Doing

• Own prioritized competitive benchmarking initiatives across search, vector and hybrid retrieval, and analytical and observability workloads.

• Build and maintain automated benchmark harnesses, datasets, query sets, and load profiles that reflect real-world usage, including concurrent ingestion and querying.

• Design fair comparisons with documented system versions, configurations, tuning decisions, resource budgets, and functional differences.

• Evaluate latency distributions, throughput, resource consumption, and cost efficiency. For retrieval workloads, measure performance at comparable recall or relevance targets.

• Adapt and extend workload-appropriate tools such as Elasticsearch Rally, ClickBench, and vector search benchmark frameworks.

• Investigate performance differences using profiling, system metrics, and controlled experiments; collaborate with engineering teams to identify causes and validate improvements.

• Evaluate relevant self-managed and managed cloud deployments, including serverless offerings, accounting for scaling behavior and service constraints.

• Work with engineering and technical content partners to publish reproducible benchmark artifacts and clear technical reports that explain methodology, findings, limitations, and tradeoffs.

• Partner with engineering and product management to prioritize benchmark coverage and translate findings into actionable product improvements.

What You Bring

• Solid software engineering skills, with experience building maintainable automation and analysis tools in Python or another relevant programming language.

• Hands-on experience evaluating and diagnosing performance in distributed systems, databases, or search infrastructure.

• Depth in at least one relevant area (search, vector retrieval, analytical databases, or observability systems) and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

• Experience designing representative datasets and workloads, including query patterns, concurrency, and ingestion behavior.

• Sound experimental judgment, including repeated measurements, variability analysis, warm-up and cache effects, and the distinction between meaningful changes and measurement noise.

• Experience building reproducible test environments and documenting configurations, procedures, and results.

• Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings and their limitations.

• Solid collaboration skills and the ability to turn performance evidence into applicable engineering recommendations.

Bonus Points

• Experience with Elasticsearch, Lucene, Rally, ClickBench, or vector search benchmark frameworks.

• Experience measuring retrieval quality alongside latency, throughput, and resource usage.

• Familiarity with cloud performance and cost analysis, including autoscaling and serverless systems.

• Public technical writing, open-source contributions, or published benchmark studies.

These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.

An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

title: CEO, AI Services - US-Based
description:
About Toptal (https://jobicy.com/company/toptal)

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce (https://www.toptal.com/remote-work-playbook).

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As the CEO of AI Services, you will lead Toptal’s AI Services business which is one of the most innovative divisions of Toptal. Our AI Services combine world-class services in data annotation, forward-deployed engineering, enterprise AI transformation, and an integrated AI software development approach — all aimed at advancing the next generation of AI and intelligence for enterprises. These are just some of the areas that you will own within Toptal’s AI Services business.

Your mindset will be that of an engineer who will work to solve business and operational problems. There will be no problem large or small for you to solve yourself. You will be the chief architect and operator of our AI Services business, constructing frameworks that enhance the operational efficiency and push the limits as to what’s possible for AI Services. You will work to build and lead the full-scale execution of Toptal’s AI Services business—including all AI-related areas such as AI-driven businesses and AI Service offerings.

This role demands a builder’s mindset and a deep sense of ownership. You will create the AI frameworks and strategy, ensure the functions are fully built out and working to perfection, and drive consistent execution across all AI Service areas of Toptal. Acting as the business owner for all AI initiatives across Toptal, both internal and external, you’ll oversee the full AI ecosystem while collaborating closely with Product and Engineering to design and scale the systems that power our AI capabilities and client solutions. Working across a high-caliber leadership group, you will bring strong AI discipline and strategic clarity to deliver world-class client outcomes and sustainable growth.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

· Own the vision, strategy, and execution plan for Toptal’s AI Services, including all AI-driven Service offerings.

· Define the organizational structure and leadership model for the AI Services teams, ensuring the right roles and capabilities are in place.

· Provide hands-on operational leadership, bringing rigor, consistency, and clear accountability to all AI Service lines and functions.

· Translate high-level AI Services strategy and business objectives into detailed operational roadmaps for all areas of responsibility.

· Establish scalable AI Services processes and systems to ensure delivery excellence, efficiency, and client satisfaction at scale.

· Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Legal to execute on strategic priorities and company-wide AI Services initiatives.

· Drive a high-performance culture across all functions and businesses, while ensuring we are tightly aligned to support evolving business needs.

In the first week, expect to:

· Onboard and integrate into Toptal.

· Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.

· Deep dive into the AI Services organization to gain clarity on current structures, key initiatives, and challenges.

· Meet key leaders and stakeholders across AI, Product, Engineering, and the Executive team to build foundational relationships and understand cross-functional dependencies.

In the first month, expect to:

· Conduct a comprehensive assessment of AI Services initiatives, including organizational structure, team capabilities, operational processes, and performance metrics.

· Engage with senior leaders and key stakeholders to validate your initial findings and gather input on critical challenges and growth opportunities.

· Begin shaping a strategic operating model and execution framework tailored to the unique needs of Toptal’s AI Services function.

· Develop a clear understanding of client expectations and feedback to align AI Services initiatives with market demands.

In the first three months, expect to:

· Begin executing a detailed operational plan that aligns with Toptal’s strategic objectives for AI Services, emphasizing scalability and efficiency.

· Sponsor and oversee initiatives that improve AI Services delivery consistency, system scalability, and client impact, ensuring cross-functional alignment and sustainable operational excellence.

· Deepen engagement with clients and internal stakeholders to anticipate future AI Services needs and proactively adapt offerings.

In the first six months, expect to:

· Achieve significant growth in AI Services-driven business initiatives and impact across Toptal.

· Drive measurable improvements in operational efficiency, client satisfaction, and delivery scalability across all AI Services.

· Refine and scale AI Services processes and systems that support seamless AI Services delivery, resource management, and cross-functional collaboration.

In the first year, expect to:

· Achieve consistent execution of AI Services strategy through a high-performing, aligned leadership team.

· Have positioned Toptal’s AI Services function as a core driver of competitive advantage through scalable operations, strong client delivery, and sustained business impact.

· Scale the operational infrastructure including technology process, to support anticipated AI Services growth.

· Champion innovation and continuous improvement initiatives that keep Toptal agile and ahead of market trends.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

· Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field preferred.

· 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in scaling complex AI, technology or service organizations and multiple business units, ideally within technology-driven environments.

· Proven track record of successfully leading multi-service or AI-driven initiatives with accountability for P&L, growth, and operational excellence.

· Demonstrated ability to develop and execute scalable AI strategies and operational frameworks that drive efficiency, client satisfaction, and sustainable growth.

· Experience at a technology, AI, or hyper-growth company is strongly preferred.

· Management consulting experience at a top-tier firm (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG) or investment banking experience is preferred but not required.

· Exceptional strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions in ambiguous environments.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of influencing stakeholders at all levels, including executives and clients.

· Experience driving cross-functional collaboration and alignment across Product, Engineering, sales, marketing, delivery, and support functions.

· Excellent organization skills and detail-oriented. You are hyper-organized, know how to work efficiently, and prioritize execution, as well as mentor others to do the same.

· Adaptable. Comfortable managing changing priorities, learning new skills, and building consensus across varied senior stakeholder groups.

· Ownership. You are a dependable leader who takes responsibility for your success as well as the success of the entire AI organization.

· Quality. You take pride in everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

· Willingness to travel to meet with clients, team members, and stakeholders.

· You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

· Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.

· Work independently with minimal supervision.

· Use all required digital collaboration tools.

· Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Account Executive - US-Based
description:
About Toptal (https://jobicy.com/company/toptal)

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce (https://www.toptal.com/remote-work-playbook).

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Want to make an impact by innovating how top global companies build teams and adapt to the Future of Work? As an Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for driving growth by acquiring new clients, re-engaging former clients, and expanding existing high-value accounts to maximize long-term growth opportunities. Success in this role comes from your ability to strategically identify and engage potential clients, uncover their key business challenges, and align Toptal’s solutions to meet their needs. This is a full-cycle sales role, which means you will take full ownership of your pipeline, including targeting ideal clients, setting your own high-quality meetings, and driving the sales process through to close.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

• Drive full-cycle sales by identifying and engaging high-potential prospects, re-engaging dormant clients, and generating new opportunities through strategic outreach.

• Conduct outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn to identify opportunities, present Toptal’s value proposition, and secure new business.

• Effectively manage the sales funnel to optimize lead progression, coordinate communication among various stakeholders, and diligently follow up on accounts to nurture leads toward conversion.

• Ensure timely and accurate CRM documentation, while providing leadership with clear sales forecasts and pipeline insights.

• As you become more comfortable in the role, contribute to evolving our demand generation strategy and tactics to expand pipeline growth and market reach.

In the first week, expect to:

• Onboard and integrate into Toptal.

• Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.

• Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.

• Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.

• Grasp the importance of the outbound function to the success of growing Toptal.

• Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

• Complete our personalized sales training program, complete with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.

• Learn how to use outreach tools (SalesLoft, Zoominfo, SalesNavigator).

• Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.

• Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

• Uncover new opportunities with existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.

• Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.

• Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.

• Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

In the first six months, expect to:

• Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.

• Assist with training and onboarding new Account Executives.

• Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnership with new and existing clients.

• Suggest, implement and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

In the first year, expect to:

• Have closed multiple net new accounts from the strategic account list, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

• Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper business development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.

• Consistently maintain a high level of success by meeting and exceeding 100% of monthly and quarterly key performance indicators and targets.

• Establish a career path for advancement.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree is required.

• Minimum 2 years sales experience, including at least 1 year in a closing role.

• Experience in B2B or SaaS sales is strongly preferred.

• Proven success in full-cycle sales, including lead generation, prospecting, running virtual sales calls, funnel management, and closing.

• Proficient with sales tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, with a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to evolving sales platforms.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

• You’re persistent in the face of setbacks, eager to understand people and problems, and motivated to go above and beyond to reach your goals.

• You thrive with autonomy and ownership. We’re looking for someone who can be held accountable for leading their portion of the business.

• You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

• Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.

• Work independently with minimal supervision.

• Use all required digital collaboration tools.

• Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

Compensation

I summarize the problem in the client’s language and connect the solution only to validated priorities before agreeing on a clear next step. Tell us about a time you recovered a stalled opportunity. I would explain how I identified the specific reason for stalled momentum, such as an unresolved stakeholder concern or unclear business case, then re-engaged with relevant insight and a focused meeting request. The key is to establish mutual next steps, document them in the CRM, and create value at each follow-up rather than simply asking for an update. How do you maintain accurate forecasts and CRM data while managing a busy sales pipeline? I update opportunity stages immediately after meaningful interactions, record verified decision criteria and next steps, and review close dates against buyer actions rather than optimism. I schedule recurring pipeline reviews to remove inactive deals, identify risks early, and ensure my forecast is evidence-based. What motivates you in a quota-carrying, remote sales role? I am motivated by measurable outcomes, the challenge of solving meaningful customer problems, and improving my process through consistent experimentation. In a remote environment, I use structured priorities, activity blocks, and proactive communication to maintain accountability and contribute reliably to the team. description:
Job Title: Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience

Location: Remote, USA

About the Company

Wheel (https://jobicy.com/company/wheel) is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visitinghttp://www.wheel.com/www.wheel.com (http://www.wheel.com).

About the Role

As a Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience at Wheel, you will own the strategy and roadmap behind the consumer-facing experience that patients use to access care through our enterprise partners. This is a B2B2C role: our patients interact with Wheel through partner brands, so you'll need to design experiences that satisfy a consumer's expectations for a modern healthcare product while also meeting the technical, brand, and compliance requirements of large enterprise partners.

You'll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. This is a builder role for a senior product leader who can set a multi-year vision for patient experience and drive it forward through close, hands-on partnership with Engineering.

What You'll Do (Job Duties/Responsibilities)

Strategy & Vision

•
Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the patient experience across Wheel's white-labeled consumer surfaces, balancing partner-specific requirements with a coherent, scalable core product

•
Establish a point of view on where the patient experience should be standardized across partners versus configured per partner, and build the frameworks to support that decision-making

•
Translate enterprise partner requirements across market segments into a unified product strategy that serves patients well regardless of the front door they came through

•
Champion design as a strategic differentiator; work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale

Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution

•
Map the patient journey end to end, from first touchpoint through clinical encounter to follow-up, and identify where friction, drop-off, or trust gaps occur

•
Partner closely with Engineering, Clinical Operations, and partner-facing teams to design solutions that hold up across a distributed network of clinicians and multiple partner integrations

•
Define the product requirements, success metrics, and evaluation criteria for AI-driven capabilities within the patient experience (for example, intake, triage support, or personalization), including partnering on model and product tradeoffs and on iteration post-launch based on real usage data

•
Break down ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear requirements and plans, and drive alignment with Engineering from concept through launch and iteration

Cross-Functional Leadership

•
Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders

•
Communicate vision, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to executive leadership, engineering teams, and non-technical partner stakeholders alike

•
Mentor and influence other product managers on systems thinking and product craft in partnership with their managers

Who You Are (Job Qualifications)

•
8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). Leveling will be based on demonstrated scope of impact in the interview process

•
Direct experience building consumer products, ideally including B2B2C or white-label models where the end user and the paying customer are different

•
Demonstrated systems thinking: experience designing products that span multiple stakeholders, technical layers, or partner integrations

•
Real, hands-on experience delivering AI-powered products and features, not just using AI tools in your work. You can speak to the tradeoffs, evaluation methods, and iteration cycles involved in bringing an AI capability to production

•
Experience navigating the tension between enterprise partner requirements and end-user needs in a B2B2C model, particularly within healthcare or other highly regulated industries, and building product decision frameworks that satisfy compliance, brand, and clinical constraints while still serving the end consumer well

•
Outstanding written and verbal communicator who can move fluidly between consumer experience detail and executive-level strategy

•
A track record as a builder: comfortable in ambiguity, willing to get hands-on with design, data, or requirements detail when needed to keep Engineering moving fast

Skills & Competencies

•
Mix of vision and execution: able to set a compelling multi-year direction and also drive the week-to-week product decisions that translate into shipped work

•
Strong product sense for consumer experience, balanced with the operational and technical judgment needed for a B2B2C model

•
Experience partnering with enterprise or channel partners on product decisions

•
Technical fluency across APIs, integration patterns (webhooks, headless architectures, MCP and other emerging protocols), and platform product design

•
Comfortable synthesizing input from clinical, engineering, data, and partner stakeholders into a clear product direction

•
Data-driven, with the judgment to know when qualitative signal matters more than a metric

•
High ownership and autonomy; thrives in a fast-moving, lean environment

Salary and Perks

Pay Range: $201,700-$301,700 plus equity

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the final level determined (Staff or Principal), scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including:

•
Medical, Dental and Vision

•
Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability

•
401K match

•
Flexible PTO

•
Parental Leave

•
Stock options

•
Additional programs and perks

Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

You’ll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution Map the patient journey end to end, from first touchpoint through clinical encounter to follow-up, and identify where friction, drop-off, or trust gaps occur Partner closely with Engineering, Clinical Operations, and partner-facing teams to design solutions that hold up across a distributed network of clinicians and multiple partner integrations Define the product requirements, success metrics, and evaluation criteria for AI-driven capabilities within the patient experience (for example, intake, triage support, or personalization), including partnering on model and product tradeoffs and on iteration post-launch based on real usage data Break down ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear requirements and plans, and drive alignment with Engineering from concept through launch and iteration Cross-Functional Leadership Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders Communicate vision, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to executive leadership, engineering teams, and non-technical partner stakeholders alike Mentor and influence other product managers on systems thinking and product craft in partnership with their managers Who You Are (Job Qualifications) 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). title: Technical Consultant, Workday Financials
description:
About Ramp (https://jobicy.com/company/ramp)

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Technical Consultants are on the frontlines working to establish partnerships with Ramp customers, and act as a liaison between customers and our internal technical teams. You'll be partnering with Customer Activation & Account Management teams to identify, prioritize and build financial solutions for new and existing customers so that Ramp continues to scale with their needs.

You will act as the technical and financial subject matter expert for our customers, and design solutions that address the customer's needs through Ramp and partner integrations. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams' roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value to the customers.

You will define the customer's financial & technical success criteria from onboarding through activation and expansion. You will represent Product, Design and Engineering externally and will operate with deep conviction and understanding of Ramp's technical capabilities. The role requires technical skills necessary to understand and educate on robust accounting features, and integrate them across all the touchpoints and surface area of a customer.

This role is specifically focused on Enterprise and Strategic Enterprise customers running Workday, supporting large, complex organizations with multi-entity environments, advanced ERP integrations, and highly customized financial workflows.

What You'll Do

•
Serve as the primary Technical Consultant for Enterprise and Strategic Enterprise accounts running Workday, supporting complex, high-impact customers with multi-entity, multi-ERP, and global financial environments

•
Act as a technical advisor to customers and Ramp's internal teams while supporting high-value implementations and expansion opportunities by guiding Workday integration, configuration, and system design

•
Partner with Customer Activation and Account Management teams to assess customer requirements and propose scalable solutions involving Workday Finance & Operations, HRIS, and API integrations

•
Collaborate with onboarding specialists and implementation leads to support technical workstreams, ensuring faster time-to-value and customer success

•
Work with customers to problem-solve technical hurdles and propose effective product implementations with a deep understanding of Workday integration and configuration options

•
Participate in technical discovery to understand customer Workday environments and workflows, and recommend best-fit Ramp architecture including when and how to use Ramp's API

•
Be a subject matter expert across Workday and Ramp's accounting integration capabilities, partnering with Sales, Product and partners to advocate for integration development aligned with customer needs

•
Troubleshoot Workday integration blockers and guide customers through complex configuration decisions

•
Contribute to internal documentation and tooling that scales Ramp's ability to support Workday integration use cases across a growing customer base

•
Influence Ramp's product roadmap by channeling Workday customer pain points and feedback to the Product and Engineering teams

What You Need

•
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, business, or a related field

•
4+ years in technical consulting, solutions engineering, implementation, or a similar customer-facing technical role, ideally in a SaaS or fintech environment

•
3+ years of hands-on experience working with Workday, including integration patterns and enterprise deployment models

•
Deep familiarity with Workday finance and accounting workflows, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, financial dimensions, and legal entity structures

•
Comfort working with APIs, integration logic, and system architecture and being able to explain those concepts to finance and operations stakeholders

•
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design on enterprise-driven gaps, influencing roadmap decisions that unlock scale across Ramp's largest customers

•
Advise on non-standard Workday implementations and edge cases, balancing customer needs with long-term platform scalability and supportability

•
Strong communication skills: able to translate complex technical solutions into business value and guide customers toward scalable approaches

•
Collaborative mindset and ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering

•
Exceptional organization and problem-solving skills, with a bias toward action and a high level of ownership

•
Thrives in ambiguity and fast-paced environments; adaptable and resourceful as we scale Ramp's upmarket motion

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

•
Flexible PTO

•
Centralized home-office equipment ordering

•
Health and wellness stipend

•
Budget for intra-office travel

•
Weekly coffee stipend

401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

•

•
Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

•
Pet insurance

•
In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

•

Canada

•
Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

•

•

•

•
Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

•
Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

•

•

Other notices

Ramp is hiring a senior customer-facing Technical Consultant to support enterprise Workday Financials customers with complex, multi-entity financial environments. The role combines technical consulting, ERP and API integration design, implementation support, and troubleshooting for high-value Workday deployments. This person will partner closely with Customer Activation, Account Management, Product, Engineering, Design, and Sales to deliver scalable customer solutions and influence the product roadmap. Success requires deep Workday Finance knowledge, strong systems-thinking, and the ability to translate technical architecture into practical business value for finance and operations stakeholders.
