Workday Financials Workday Integration ERP Implementation Financial Systems General Ledger Accounts Payable API Integration Technical Consulting Enterprise SaaS Customer Success Sample interview questions How would you approach discovery for a strategic customer implementing Ramp alongside Workday Financials? I would begin by mapping the customer’s legal entities, chart-of-accounts structure, financial dimensions, approval workflows, expense processes, and close requirements. I would then document their Workday integration landscape, data ownership, security constraints, API capabilities, and current pain points. From there, I would define success criteria, identify technical risks and dependencies, and recommend a phased architecture that achieves value quickly without creating long-term support burden. Describe how you would troubleshoot a Workday integration that is failing to create accurate accounting entries. I would first isolate whether the issue is caused by source data, mapping logic, authentication, Workday configuration, or downstream validation. I would compare failed and successful records, inspect integration logs and error messages, validate financial dimensions and ledger-account mappings, and confirm the relevant Workday business process and security permissions. After identifying the root cause, I would communicate a clear remediation plan, test the change in a controlled environment where possible, and document the resolution for future reuse. How do you explain an API or integration-architecture decision to finance leaders who are not technical? I focus on the business outcome, controls, and operational tradeoffs rather than implementation jargon. For example, I would explain that a particular integration design creates a reliable, auditable flow of transaction data into Workday, reduces manual journal work, and supports faster close processes. I would also clarify ownership, exceptions, timing, and any actions required from the finance team. Tell us about a time you had to balance a major customer’s custom request with the need for a scalable product solution. I would assess the request’s business impact, recurrence across customers, implementation complexity, and support implications. If a custom configuration can solve the need safely, I would propose it with clear boundaries; if not, I would package the evidence, customer impact, and technical requirements for Product and Engineering. The objective is to keep the customer moving while ensuring the recommendation does not introduce fragile one-off behavior. What metrics would you use to judge the success of an enterprise technical implementation? I would measure time to activation, integration completion and reliability, transaction-processing accuracy, reduction in manual accounting work, user adoption, and resolution time for technical blockers. I would also track whether the customer reaches the agreed financial workflow outcomes, such as accurate coding, dependable data synchronization, and a more efficient month-end close. For Ramp, recurring implementation issues and feature gaps would additionally inform roadmap and enablement priorities. This analysis is generated from the job description. About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role Technical Consultants are on the frontlines working to establish partnerships with Ramp customers, and act as a liaison between customers and our internal technical teams. You’ll be partnering with Customer Activation & Account Management teams to identify, prioritize and build financial solutions for new and existing customers so that Ramp continues to scale with their needs. You will act as the technical and financial subject matter expert for our customers, and design solutions that address the customer’s needs through Ramp and partner integrations. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams’ roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value to the customers. You will define the customer’s financial & technical success criteria from onboarding through activation and expansion. You will represent Product, Design and Engineering externally and will operate with deep conviction and understanding of Ramp’s technical capabilities. The role requires technical skills necessary to understand and educate on robust accounting features, and integrate them across all the touchpoints and surface area of a customer. This role is specifically focused on Enterprise and Strategic Enterprise customers running Workday, supporting large, complex organizations with multi-entity environments, advanced ERP integrations, and highly customized financial workflows. title: Seasonal Customer Love Associate - (Remote - TX based)
description:
Who We Are:

Being naked is the #1 most sustainable option. We're #2.

Since 2009, we've been on a mission to bring sustainable fashion to everyone. Named one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter (https://www.fastcompany.com/91235976/brands-that-matter-2024)and winning a Best Carbon Footprint (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/reformation_we-won-the-award-for-best-carbon-footprint-activity-7069721913526255617-Fz9M/)award, we have big goals like being Climate Positive by 2025 (https://www.thereformation.com/sustainability/climate-positive-roadmap.html?srsltid=AfmBOorhdm3aft0gzf4GzVF8U8qS_eZIefxpuPmL2UPkMg2hjMzTla6f), Circular by 2030 (https://www.thereformation.com/circularity.html), and pushing the whole industry forward along the way.Our work has gotten love in Drapers (https://www.drapersonline.com/insight/analysis/reformations-award-winning-circularity-ambitions)and Sourcing Journal (https://sourcingjournal.com/sustainability/sustainability-news/reformation-sustainability-rivet-it-girl-los-angeles-spending-sensitivity-recycling-ref-529521/), andTIME (https://time.com/7023465/hali-borenstein/)wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.

We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our ownsustainable factory in LA (https://www.thereformation.com/sustainability/we-are-reformation.html). We innovate across categories like accessories (https://wwd.com/accessories-news/handbags/reformation-accessories-expansion-shoes-bags-1236447322/), swimwear (https://www.elle.com/fashion/shopping/a60229509/reformation-swimwear-launch-2024/), and sleepwear (https://hypebae.com/2025/4/reformation-good-in-bed-pyjama-collection-campaign), and we reach millions of people with campaigns like this (https://www.vogue.co.uk/article/laura-harrier-reformation),this (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1EsJTIttah8), and this (https://www.elle.com/fashion/a46873554/monica-lewinsky-reformation-voting-campaign-interview-2024/).

None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.

And starting right now, we want to do all that with you.

What You’ll Do:

• Provide consistently magical customer service across all customer service channels

• Deliver an excellent customer experience through a customer-first mindset to build long-term, loyal client relationships

• Consistently meet and exceed performance goals

• Be able to wear many hats (stylist, friend, personal assistant) when helping our customers shop for their next favorite item

• Know our shipping, fulfillment, and returns procedures inside and out to help process all customer orders as efficiently as possible

• Share customer and product feedback with internal teams such as Merchandising, Operations, and Product Development

• Get to know the ins and outs of all aspects of the business and gain exposure to different teams

Who You Are:

• Smart, incredibly organized, and driven towards excellence

• Passionate about Reformation (https://jobicy.com/company/reformation)’s mission and products

• An incredibly friendly person who loves interacting with people and never loses their cool

• Possess a high degree of empathy, judgment, patience, and level-headedness to communicate and apply our policies

• Positive and willing to take on any task, big or small

• Strong communication skills across all customer service channels, including email, text, and chat

• Able to meet deadlines consistently while juggling multiple tasks; excellent with time management

• Flexible and able to work in a constantly changing environment

• Productive, focused work style to successfully meet case volume expectations

Extra Credit:

• Prior experience on an e-commerce customer service team

• Proficiency with Kustomer and Google Suite

Availability:

We’re currently hiring for Seasonal roles with part-time availability needed in June. Candidates must have flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to support our customers when demand is highest.

Top-performing Seasonal employees may be asked to extend their contract and join us for the next season. They may also be considered for permanent roles on our core team, based on business needs and individual performance.

• Part-Time: 8–29 hours/week, with occasional weekend shifts required

Flexible availability is especially important—we’re looking for team members who can help us deliver exceptional service when our customers need us most.

Compensation:

At Reformation, we believe in transparency and equity when it comes to compensation. For this role, the anticipated wage for this position is $17.60 - $18.65 per hour, depending on a variety of factors, including but not limited to location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal compensation equity.

This role may also be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a range of factors, including company performance, department goals, and individual contributions. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and are determined at the company’s discretion.

Please note that compensation decisions are made thoughtfully and may vary from the listed range to reflect individual circumstances and evolving business needs. Our total rewards package also includes benefits, perks, and opportunities for growth that contribute to overall compensation.

Benefits & Perks:

• Eligible employees get employer-sponsored private medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as commuter benefits to help support your travel to and from work.

• We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays for eligible employees.

• We offer retirement planning support for eligible employees, including the option to invest in Environmental Social Governance-aligned (fancy way to say sustainable) funds.

• We’re a mission-based company with offices in LA, NYC and London, as well as a global retail team, which means you’ll get to collaborate with people all around the world.

• You’ll get access to fertility care support through Carrot (https://www.get-carrot.com/), and up to a $5,000 USD reimbursement for related fertility expenses after 1 year of employment.

• We care about the causes our employees care about so we donate to community efforts on a yearly basis.

• We offer a clothing discount, culture events (like our annual Ref Values week and Volunteer Time Off), you know, all the meaningful and fun stuff!

Reformation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the world we want to live in. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status—in accordance with applicable international, federal, state, and local laws.

If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We’re here to ensure you have what you need to show up as your best self.

Still don’t know if you should apply? We get it—studies (https://hbr.org/2014/08/why-women-dont-apply-for-jobs-unless-theyre-100-qualified) show that many women and individuals from historically underrepresented communities hold back from applying unless they meet every single requirement. At Reformation, we’re all about growth, not gatekeeping. If you’re passionate about the role and excited about making fashion more sustainable, we’d love to hear from you. If this role doesn’t totally excite you, consider applying to our general application. (https://www.thereformation.com/career-listing.html?gh_jid=6749039)

Want some more?! -Sustainability (https://www.thereformation.com/sustainability.html), Forbes (https://www.forbes.com/sites/eshachhabra/2019/02/21/why-this-la-fashion-brand-went-carbon-neutral-and-wants-customers-to-as-well/#4563df3e37e6),Fast Company (https://www.fastcompany.com/90815341/reformation-doubling-down-sustainability)

title: Manager, Customer Activation, Mid-Market
location: New York, NY (HQ); San Francisco, CA
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will be a front-line manager to a group of 6-8 CSMs, who each manage ~60 Activations at a given time in Ramp’s Mid Market portfolio. You will be responsible for developing and standardizing implementation best practices, 1:1 coaching and mentoring, building a repeatable and scalable customer activation motion that enables growth without proportional increases in team size, and working closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Risk, and Product to drive positive outcomes for this segment. As a key member of the Mid Market CSM leadership team, you will have the opportunity to help build and refine Ramp’s customer success and onboarding motion.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Set and maintain a high-performing culture and morale by managing a group of exceptional CSMs to drive thorough and efficient onboarding and product activation for Ramp’s medium/large customers

- Oversee the daily activities and quota performance management of individual CSMs to ensure team exceeds product onboarding and spend activation goals, while maintaining strong CSAT

- Refine best practice playbooks for the CSM team, and improve team output and efficiency over time by optimizing systems and processes

- Develop and execute career development and leadership plans for direct reports; inclusive of but not limited to daily 1:1 mentoring, coaching on sales skills, enhancing product knowledge, providing call feedback, and running enablement sessions

- Act as a voice of the customer and key contributor retaining and expanding Ramp’s Mid Market segment

- Build and leverage internal AI tools and Salesforce dashboards to monitor the success of our customers and the performance of the team

- Report on team performance and forecast to senior leadership

- Represent the CSM team cross-functionally with leaders of other departments

WHAT YOU NEED

- 5+ years of implementation, CSM or AM experience as an individual contributor, with a proven, consistent track record exceeding goals

title: Software Engineer (Engineer III to Principal) - Formal Methods
description:
Why us?

Blockchain technology is enabling a rapidly-growing era of innovation for the digital world. It is crucial that blockchain code such as protocols and smart contracts are provably secure and correct. Once deployed, they are public and cannot be changed. Vulnerabilities and bugs in such programs regularly put millions of dollars at stake. This is where CertiK (https://jobicy.com/company/certik) comes in. We are the leading blockchain security company. Our goal is to secure the cyber world by applying cutting edge techniques from academia to secure blockchain code. Come and join this ambitious mission as a research software engineer to work on automated analyses for provably secure and correct blockchain applications!

What you will do

You will design and develop tools that automatically ensure the correctness of smart contracts or identify security issues and bugs in smart contracts. We have software engineer positions available at all levels of seniority. Title and responsibilities will be commensurate with experience and background.

As part of our multinational team of programming language experts, you will participate in the development of tools that rest upon techniques such as symbolic model checking, SAT/SMT solving, abstract interpretation, data flow analysis, and deductive verification. You will have the opportunity to work on all stages of tool development from idea generation to implementation and iterative improvements. Our team is highly supportive and collaborative with great opportunities to learn and grow.

About you

You have a background in programming language theory and automated reasoning and love to work on the forefront of applying results from theoretical computer science. You love to tackle computationally hard problems and have a proven track record of achieving results, where results are people using your tool to do their jobs. You are collaborative: you share ideas, love to brainstorm with peers, and give and receive feedback. You are comfortable with the unknown and understand that #startuplife means that you will be wearing multiple hats.

Responsibilities

• Extend the scope and depth of our automated program verification tools and brainstorm, design, and implement new tools.

• Adapt and improve algorithms for symbolic software model checking. Examples include bounded model checking (BMC), counterexample-guided abstraction refinement (CEGAR), and property directed reachability (IC3/PDR).

• Build and extend translators from different input languages into intermediate representations, optimizing the generated models for automated analysis.

• Identify new classes of security properties of smart contracts and formalize properties for use in our automated verification tools.

• Closely collaborate with other software engineers in developing tools and set technical direction for solving problems in consultation with your team and management.

• Work on all aspects of delivering working software that meets customer needs, including analysis, design, automated testing, operations, CI/CD, measuring results, incorporating customer feedback, and support.

Required Qualifications

• Master's Degree in Computer Science or a related field or 5 years of equivalent experience.

• Minimum of 4 years of software development experience (includes internships, software developed during research, and open-source development).

• Minimum of 2 years of experience with one or more of the following: model checking, formal verification, SAT/SMT solving (Z3, CVC4, Yices, MathSAT, SMTInterpol), abstract interpretation, or closely related disciplines.

• Demonstrated knowledge of fundamental computer science concepts such as data structures, algorithms, mathematical logic, and automata theory.

Preferred Qualifications

• PhD in the broader field of automated reasoning.

• Publication record in conferences like POPL, CAV, TACAS, FMCAD, FM, etc.

• Experience in functional programming (OCaml or Haskell).

• Strong and creative problem-solving skills; always willing to learn and embrace new technologies and to collaborate.

• Prior experience in a professional software development environment.

Compensation

Additional Information

About the Company

Founded in 2018 by professors of Yale University and Columbia University, CertiK is a pioneer in blockchain security, utilizing best-in-class technology to secure and monitor blockchain protocols and smart contracts. CertiK’s mission is to secure the cyber world. Starting with blockchain, CertiK applies cutting-edge innovations from academia into enterprise, enabling mission-critical applications to be built with security and correctness.

Compensation

Target annual base salary for this role performed in the US is $115,000 - $230,000.

The exact compensation at which this job is filled will be determined by the skills and experience of qualified candidates.

CertiK also offers a variable commission program for business development sales roles.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

CertiK is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of age, race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, medical condition, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status or civil partnership/union status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth, genetic information, military and veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state or local law.

CertiK will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.

How would you choose between bounded model checking, CEGAR, and PDR/IC3 for a smart-contract property? I would begin with the property, state-space characteristics, and desired completeness guarantees. BMC is useful for bounded bug finding, CEGAR can control abstraction complexity through refinement, and PDR/IC3 is strong for inductive safety proofs when an effective invariant can be discovered. What makes translating source languages into an intermediate representation challenging for verification? The translation must preserve semantics relevant to the target properties while creating a model that solvers can analyze efficiently. Important concerns include control flow, storage and memory behavior, arithmetic semantics, external calls, nondeterminism, and traceability from counterexamples back to source code. How would you balance research exploration with the need to ship reliable tools to customers? I would define measurable hypotheses, prototype promising ideas behind clear interfaces, and validate them on realistic workloads early. Productionization would include regression tests, soundness documentation, observability, staged rollout, and feedback loops with users so research value translates into dependable outcomes. title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments Intelligence
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Payment Intelligence is comprised of multiple product teams building AI-first solutions to some of our customers’ biggest challenges, including fraud/abuse (Radar (https://stripe.com/au/radar)), payment optimizations (AuthBoost (https://stripe.com/authorization-boost)), Disputes, Authentication, and merchant analytics. We’re a mix of machine engineering engineers and full-stack software engineers impacting ~every Stripe transaction, creating revenue opportunities for Stripe and our customers, and helping protect the broader ecosystem.

We have the benefit and privilege of working on cutting edge technologies with incredible scale and reach while also working directly with our merchants every day to build the right products for their needs.

What you'll do

As a Staff Engineer on Payment Intelligence, you’ll work across our product portfolio to ensure we’re building in a consistent, efficient, and effective manner. Experience with large, distributed systems on the critical path will help candidates succeed, as will comfort working across the stack and interacting with ML teams and models.

Responsibilities

• Define technical strategy for multiple experiences across the Payment Intelligence portfolio, with a focus on quality and performance

• Champion a quality-first engineering culture - establish standards, tooling, and processes that make it easy to ship high-quality code at scale

• Partner with some of Stripe’s largest merchants to co-build the future of payment-centric intelligence

• Partner cross-functionally with product, design, and ML colleagues to ship the very best software possible

• Work across the stack - contributing to infrastructure and foundational systems, but also FE, API, and ML-adjacent work.

Minimum requirements

• 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years of experience in a strategic technical leadership role

• Experience leading engineering team(s) working on Distributed systems, API design, and user facing products

• Proven track record of delivering pragmatic solutions that accelerate business growth

• Ability to drive projects at a high-level while also being hands on and contributing directly to technical solutions as necessary

• Effective communication skills and a proven ability to work cross-team, cross-org, and cross-functionally.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with payments systems and/or fraud detection

• Familiarity with ML systems in production: model serving, training pipelines, observability, and evaluation

• Prior experience with 0-1 product builds: you've started with a blank page and ended with a production system, and you have clear opinions about what makes that process go well or poorly

• Experience across a range of software languages and frameworks; our stack includes Java, Ruby, Python, TypeScript, Kafka, Flyte, Airflow, and Mongo.

• Experience navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving organization - you can make confident technical decisions with incomplete information and update gracefully when new constraints emerge

title: Chief Technology Officer - US-Based
description:
About Toptal (https://jobicy.com/company/toptal)

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce (https://www.toptal.com/remote-work-playbook).

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering

• Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.

• Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.

• Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.

• Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability

• Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.

• Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.

• Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution

• Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.

• Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

In the first week, expect to:

• Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.

• Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

In the first month, expect to:

• Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.

• Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

In the first three months, expect to:

• Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.

• Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

In the first six months, expect to:

• Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.

• Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

• Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.

• Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.

• 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.

• Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.

• Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.

• Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.

• Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.

• Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.

• You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.

• Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.

• Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.

• Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.

• Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.

• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

• Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.

• You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

• Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.

• Work independently with minimal supervision.

• Use all required digital collaboration tools.

• Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Position Description: As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it. You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down. You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence. You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency. Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards. You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal. This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details. This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction. AI and agentic engineering Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against. Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for. Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed. Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you. Team, resourcing, and accountability Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product. Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments. Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows. Platform and execution Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend. In the first week, expect to: Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services. Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO. In the first month, expect to: Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down. Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for. In the first three months, expect to: Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented. Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result. In the first six months, expect to: Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it. Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most. In the first year, expect to: Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering. Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan. Qualifications and Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred. 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale. Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up. Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work. Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence. Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers. Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for. You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI. Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar. Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale. Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield. Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself. You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do. Essential Job Functions Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera. Work independently with minimal supervision. Use all required digital collaboration tools. Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines. title: Head of Market Growth
description:
The Role We Need

PadSplit (https://jobicy.com/company/padsplit) is entering new markets faster than ever, and we need a leader who can build the repeatable system that turns every new launch into a thriving, self-sustaining marketplace. As our Head of Market Growth, you'll own the strategy and execution behind taking a market from launch to scale by creating exceptional experiences for hosts and members, building a powerful local vendor ecosystem, and establishing the growth flywheel that fuels long-term expansion.

The Person We Are Looking For

You're equal parts builder, operator, and strategist. You love creating order from ambiguity, know how to launch new markets from the ground up, and have a track record of building partnerships and systems that continue producing results long after you've stepped away. You're energized by ambitious growth goals, thrive in cross-functional environments, and enjoy developing teams while solving complex marketplace challenges.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day

• Launch Markets – Lead the strategy and execution for every new PadSplit market, ensuring each reaches 250 active units within six months while maintaining high quality standards.

• Build Playbooks – Design and continuously improve the repeatable systems, processes, and launch playbooks that allow markets to scale beyond the initial launch phase.

• Grow Ecosystems – Build national and local partnerships with brokers, lenders, contractors, property managers, photographers, and other vendors that help hosts succeed.

• Drive Referrals – Create referral engines that encourage members, hosts, and vendors to become active advocates who fuel organic growth.

• Improve Outcomes – Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Member Experience, and Host Experience to improve occupancy, NPS, move-in quality, and host success.

• Analyze Performance – Use data to evaluate launch performance, identify growth opportunities, reduce customer acquisition costs, and optimize every market.

• Lead Teams – Hire, coach, and develop Market Account Executives and ecosystem leaders while aligning multiple departments around successful launches.

• Test & Learn – Run structured experiments, evaluate results, and continuously improve how PadSplit enters and scales new markets.

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful

• Market Leadership – 10+ years leading marketplace, growth, partnerships, or operations teams, including significant ownership of a business, market, or P&L.

• Launch Experience – Proven success launching or scaling new markets for a marketplace, franchise, or multi-location business.

• Partnership Expertise – Experience building vendor, channel, or partner ecosystems that create measurable business value.

• Growth Mindset – Demonstrated success improving customer experience, retention, referrals, or other organic growth drivers.

• Systems Thinking – Ability to design scalable operating models instead of solving problems one market at a time.

• Analytical Skills – Comfortable making decisions using metrics such as CAC, LTV, occupancy, funnel conversion, referrals, and NPS.

• People Leadership – Experience building, leading, and developing high-performing distributed teams.

• Executive Influence – Strong communicator who can align executives and cross-functional partners around ambitious growth initiatives.

The Interview Process:

• Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.

• If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone call with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Chief Growth Officer for one (1) hour.

• If warranted, the next step would be a video panel interview with members of our leadership team for one (1) hour.

• The panel interview will require a candidate to work on an assessment where you will showcase your market launch skills to the panel for discussion.

• If warranted, the final interview would be with our President.

• If warranted, then we move to offer!

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks:

• Fully remote position - we swear!

• Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity

• National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans

• Company provided life insurance policy

• Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits

• Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays

• 401(k) plan

• Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents

• The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis

Compensation

Compensation is based on the role's scope, national market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals. In addition to base compensation, there is potential for up to a $50,000 bonus based on growth targets.

Additional Information

Please note: Although the job posting says it's in Atlanta, Georgia, this is a fully remote position. This is a result of our Applicant Tracking System requiring a location to post the role on LinkedIn.

Notice to Applicants:

PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.

PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Senior Director, Agentic Engineering
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by

We’re looking for a Senior Director, Agentic Engineering to build and lead the platform, capabilities, and operating model that enable Lightspeed’s Product & Technology teams to work effectively with AI agents across the full product development lifecycle.

Reporting to the SVP, Engineering, this is a foundational leadership role with company-wide impact. You will turn rapidly evolving agentic technology into secure, reliable, and reusable capabilities that help teams discover, design, build, test, ship, and operate better products faster. Success will be measured not by experimentation alone, but by adoption and sustained improvements in product quality, engineering velocity, developer experience, and business outcomes.

Please note this role is based in the United States.

What you’ll be doing

•
Define the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for agentic engineering at Lightspeed, translating business and product priorities into a platform investment plan.

•
Build and lead the teams responsible for shared agentic platform capabilities, including reusable agents, workflow orchestration, context and knowledge access, tool integrations, evaluation, observability, and governance.

•
Create an extensible platform and paved-road experience that allows Product, Design, Engineering, Quality, and Operations teams to adopt agentic workflows without rebuilding core capabilities independently.

•
Partner with Retail, Hospitality, Payments, and platform leaders on highest-value product development use cases, launch them with early teams, and scale proven patterns across Lightspeed.

•
Establish a rigorous evaluation system for agent performance, output quality, reliability, security, cost, and human oversight so teams can use agents with confidence in production workflows.

•
Work closely with Security, Privacy, Legal, Data, and Architecture leaders to embed responsible AI, access controls, data protection, auditability, and risk management into the platform by design.

•
Define the operating model for agentic development, including standards, reusable patterns, ownership boundaries, enablement, support, and mechanisms for sharing learning across teams.

•
Drive adoption and change across a global organization by helping leaders redesign workflows, build team capability, and move from tool usage to measurable operating-model change.

•
Own outcome metrics for the platform, including adoption, active usage, developer and product experience, cycle-time improvement, quality, reliability, cost efficiency, and demonstrated business impact.

•
Hire, coach, and develop a strong leadership and technical bench, while building an inclusive, high-performing organization with high standards for execution and learning.

What you need to bring:

We’re looking for a senior engineering leader who can combine platform depth, AI fluency, product judgment, and enterprise change leadership. You should have experience with the following:

•
Leading leaders and senior technical talent in a software engineering organization, with a record of building high-performing teams through managers and staff-plus engineers.

•
Defining and scaling internal platforms, developer platforms, shared engineering capabilities, or infrastructure products in a complex, multi-product environment.

•
Building or deploying AI-enabled and agentic systems, including model and tool orchestration, retrieval and context systems, evaluation frameworks, automation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.

•
Partnering effectively with senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business functions.

•
Leading organizational change across distributed teams, including workflow redesign, enablement, communication, and adoption at scale.

•
Establishing high standards for architecture, engineering quality, operational resilience, responsible AI, security, and cost management.

•
Communicating complex technical and strategic concepts clearly to executives, technical leaders, and cross-functional teams.

•
15+ years of experience and Bachelor’s degree in CS or related field.

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Be a changemaker

You’ll enjoy:

•
A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

•
A culture that celebrates performance

•
The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

•
Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

•
Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

•
Equity options, because this is your company too

•
Contributions to your 401k. Your future matters

•
Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

•
Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

•
Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

•
Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

•
Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

•
Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skillset, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $300,000 to $360,000 USD, depending on the candidate’s location. Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, 401K plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off.

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within the United States, and refers to the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting, which may vary depending on the candidate’s actual location. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here (https://www.lightspeedhq.com/careers/).

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement (https://www.lightspeedhq.com/legal/applicant-privacy-statement/).

title: Senior Ecosystem Operations Manager
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI) as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Ecosystem Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll own the technology, processes, and operational infrastructure behind our channel, distribution, original equipment manufacturer (OEM), global systems integrator (GSI), and managed service provider (MSP) partnerships. You'll shape how our partners go to market, serving as the primary process owner for deal registration, partner programs, partner quote-to-cash, and partner attribution. You'll combine operational strategy with hands-on execution, using artificial intelligence (AI) to automate workflows and help ecosystem operations scale.

What you'll do

• Design and govern end-to-end partner processes, including deal and referral registration, service attach, two-tier distribution, rules of engagement, and quote-to-cash. Partner with Deal Desk and Billing on resale, distribution, OEM, GSI, and MSP transaction workflows, and resolve complex registration, quoting, and billing escalations.

• Own operational execution of partner tiering, onboarding, certification compliance, not-for-resale (NFR) licenses, rebates, and incentives, including eligibility tracking, approval routing, and payments.

• Own and administer the partner technology ecosystem, including Impartner partner relationship management (PRM), Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) partner objects, deal registration, and partner portals. Maintain system health and data integrity, and co-manage vendor roadmaps, renewals, and service-level accountability.

• Partner with Revenue Technologies and Systems to maintain integrations across partner platforms, Salesforce, enterprise resource planning (ERP), quoting, billing, and financial systems, including partner attribution and compensation data flows. Lead prioritization and user acceptance testing (UAT) for implementations, migrations, and platform enhancements with IT and Enterprise Applications.

• Own the ecosystem data model and work toward one standard partner attribution record across the customer lifecycle. Serve as a resource for Ecosystem Sales, partners, and internal teams on attribution, territory, and compensation-impacting data, and maintain reporting and dashboards as a single source of truth for partner pipeline, registration activity, and program performance.

• Lead ecosystem month-end close with Deal Desk, Compensation, Accounts Receivable, and Finance, covering opportunity corrections, partner splits, territory review, and reconciliation.

• Identify, build, and deploy AI agents to automate workflows such as deal registration routing, NFR provisioning, partner data quality checks, and reporting. Evaluate processes for opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and shorten cycle times.

• Maintain the authoritative ecosystem process map, runbooks, and training materials. Support tool configuration, testing, and end-user training. Own channel price files and partner quoting for product launches and stock keeping unit (SKU) changes. Coordinate improvements with operational peers, IT, Finance, Product, and Legal through GitLab Work Items.

What you'll bring

• Experience in business-to-business software-as-a-service channel or partner operations, with direct ownership of ecosystem workflows and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Hands-on experience with Impartner or an equivalent PRM platform, including deal registration and partner portal administration.

• Strong working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, including partner objects, opportunity management, Flow, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.

• Deep familiarity with resale, two-tier distribution, deal registration, rules of engagement, partner discounting, and partner quote-to-cash, plus an understanding of OEM, GSI, and MSP transaction structures and operational requirements.

• Direct experience operating partner programs, including tiering, certification compliance, rebates, and incentives, with responsibility for execution and compliance.

• Experience designing and documenting complex operational processes for distributed teams, translating business needs into detailed system requirements and configuration, and leading user acceptance testing through release.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools and building agents to automate operational workflows, from evaluating opportunities to delivering working solutions.

• Experience resolving ambiguous operational escalations across systems, teams, and partner relationships, and aligning Deal Desk, IT, Finance, Compensation, Legal, and Sales around operational changes.

About the team

Our Ecosystem Operations team works closely with Systems, Revenue Technologies, Deal Desk, Ecosystem Programs, Enablement, Finance, Compensation, and Legal. We enable consistent execution across Ecosystem Operations Specialists and cross-functional partners. You'll also partner with the Senior Hyperscaler Operations Manager, who owns Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud operations, on shared systems, the ecosystem data model, and month-end close.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/) and equity (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/). Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

$104,800—$176,400 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/)

• Flexible Paid Time Off  (https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto)

• Team Member Resource Groups (https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/)

• Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan (https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/)

• Growth and Development Fund (https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/)

• Parental Leave (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave)

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, New Grad - Warp Speed
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Warp Speed
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. FDSEs on Warp Speed work directly with customers from the factory floor to the board room to understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions using data.
 
As Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the most important industries and institutions globally!
 
The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer 
At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.
 
FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
As an FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. You’ll work in small, agile teams and own the end-to-end execution and implementation of high-stakes projects, including:
 
• Collaborating with fellow engineers on architecture and design decisions
• Wrangling massive-scale data and using AI to accelerate and enhance critical operations
• Developing custom applications tailored to customer needs
• Engaging directly with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives
• Shaping team strategy and driving projects from ideation to deployment, increasing your pain threshold to deliver real value

title: Senior Manager, Solution Engineering - DocV
description:
Why Socure (https://jobicy.com/company/socure)?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

About the Role

DocV Solution Engineering is part of the Product Engineering organization and plays a critical role in accelerating customer adoption, enabling the field, and improving system reliability. We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead the DocV Solution Engineering team and partner closely with Customer Success, Commercial, Product, and Engineering teams.

This role focuses on short-term, high-impact technical work that enables revenue, accelerates rollout of new DocV features, and improves platform stability—while core backend and frontend teams remain focused on long-term product roadmap delivery.

What You’ll Do

•
Build and lead a Solution Engineering team embedded within Product Engineering.

•
Partner closely with Customer Success and Commercial teams to unblock implementations and accelerate customer outcomes.

•
Deliver short-term technical initiatives that enable field teams and support active customer engagements.

•
Collaborate directly with customers on complex DocV integrations and deployment challenges.

•
Develop targeted features, prototypes, and integrations that accelerate adoption of new DocV capabilities.

•
Identify and address integration-related technical debt to improve reliability, stability, and operational robustness.

•
Establish a strong feedback loop between customers, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams.

•
Collaborate with Backend and Frontend teams to transition validated solutions into the core product roadmap where appropriate.

•
Anticipate recurring customer and field needs and drive scalable, repeatable solutions.

What You Bring

•
8+ years of engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting experience.

•
At least 3 years of experience leading customer-facing or hybrid engineering teams.

•
Strong understanding of APIs, SDKs, and enterprise integration patterns.

•
Ability to deliver production-quality solutions in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

•
Strong communication skills and experience working across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.
