title: AI Engineer - Agentic Systems
description:
Headquarters:

Summary

We are seeking a highly hands-on AI Engineer with a proven track record of shipping agentic AI systems into production for enterprise environments. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy production-grade AI agents capable of multi-agent orchestration, complex tool execution, and dynamic context management. You will implement robust safety guardrails and integrate frontier models using leading agent frameworks and cloud infrastructure. This position is remote within the US (East Coast time zone slightly preferred) with minimal travel required.

Tasks and Deliverables

Design and deploy autonomous and multi-agent orchestration workflows capable of executing complex, multi-step enterprise processes.

Implement structured tool-use frameworks and integrate external APIs and services using protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Engineer advanced prompt strategies, dynamic context management, and memory layers to optimize model performance and reasoning accuracy.

Implement production-grade guardrails, schema enforcement, latency optimization, and defensive exception handling across all agentic workflows.

Deploy, scale, and maintain agentic microservices on cloud infrastructure using modern containerized and serverless platforms.

Required Experience

Production Agent Experience: Demonstrated, hands-on software engineering experience building, testing, and shipping autonomous agent systems and tool-calling workflows into production environments.

Framework & Model SDK Expertise: Strong proficiency in at least one major model ecosystem: Anthropic (Claude Agent SDK, Model Context Protocol), OpenAI (OpenAI Agents SDK, Responses API, File Search), or GCP Vertex AI (Gemini, Google ADK / Vertex AI Agent Engine).

Cloud Infrastructure (GCP): Experience building and deploying distributed applications on Google Cloud Platform, using services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery.

Core Software Engineering: Strong foundation in software design patterns, API integrations, structured outputs (Pydantic/JSON schemas), and microservices architecture.

Location: Based in the US (East Coast time zone slightly preferred).

Engagement Highlights

Enterprise Production Scale: Move beyond proof-of-concept builds to deploy actual, living agent systems that automate mission-critical enterprise processes.

Frontier Tech Stack: Work directly with state-of-the-art agent SDKs, Model Context Protocol, and multi-model ecosystems across Anthropic, OpenAI, and GCP.

Remote Autonomy: Enjoy a fully remote US-based role with high execution agency and low friction.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-ai-engineer-agentic-systems

title: Manager, Global Pipeline Strategy & Sales Development Planning
description:
SLSQ427R609

The Global Pipeline Strategy & Execution team sits at the heart of Databricks’ GTM engine. We set the pipeline targets the company runs on, monitor global pipeline health, evaluate performance, and architect the future top-of-funnel operating model.

We are seeking a strategic, high-leverage Manager / Senior Strategy Lead to serve as the central strategic spine for global pipeline strategy, executive pipeline governance, and long-term Sales Development (xDR) capacity and talent planning.

In this role, you will lead the global pipeline strategy narrative, architect executive Cross-Functional Pipeline Councils, and drive capacity, coverage, compensation, and target-setting frameworks across our global Sales Development organization. As AI and automation transform routine prospecting tasks, you will redefine how our Sales Dev org operates - pairing AI-native capabilities with specialized human roles to unlock optimized coverage ratios while powering our enduring engine for Account Executive talent development.

You will bridge high-level corporate strategy with operational execution - ensuring executive leaders have clear visibility, aligned targets, and structured strategic choices to maximize pipeline generation across all channels.

The Impact You'll Have

1. Executive Pipeline Governance & Strategic Spine

• Executive Pipe Councils Framework: Architect, scale, and orchestrate Executive & Cross-Functional Pipeline Council frameworks, operating cadences, and executive communications alongside senior leadership.

• Central Pipeline Strategy Narrative: Own the global pipeline strategy narrative, synthesizing complex, multi-workstream performance insights into coherent executive presentations and leadership decision frameworks.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Foster seamless alignment across Sales, Sales Development, Marketing, Partner, Programs, and Product GTM teams to ensure leadership remains unified behind top strategic growth bets.

2. Next-Gen Sales Development (xDR) Strategic Planning & Talent Engine

• Capacity & Coverage Modeling: Design and implement scalable xDR capacity and coverage models that integrate automation to optimize territory coverage, improve rep productivity, and drive deeper strategic account engagement.

• Evolving Role Archetypes: Shape the long-term vision and pilot frameworks for specialized Sales Dev role archetypes aligned directly with company-wide growth, product expansion, and sales productivity targets.

• Future AE Talent Architecture: Partner with Sales Dev leadership to design in-seat career progression architecture. Establish target-setting philosophies, compensation structures, and performance gates that develop xDRs into technically credible, high-performing Account Executives.

3. AI-Native Workflows & Operating Rigor

• Operating Frameworks: Install repeatable cadences, standardized review frameworks, and governance models that increase velocity, eliminate friction, and improve cross-functional decision-making.

• AI Builder Mindset: Proactively deploy AI tools (e.g., LLMs, conversational analytics, custom agents) to improve strategy team workflows, automate strategic reporting, and raise the bar for AI capabilities across the GTM strategy org.

What We Look For

• Radical ownership and speed: You own outcomes at pace, not just tasks. You are measured on the impact you deliver, not on effort.

• Run-the-business operator: You want to own a business end-to-end and operate on the leader's behalf, not support from the sidelines. You earn trust through immersion and reliability, you're a doer as much as a designer, and you bring structure to ambiguity.

• Technical and analytical horsepower: You want your hands in the data and to build, not just direct it - modern data & AI tools (advanced Excel, SQL, BI platforms, conversational analytics, custom agents), and you pick up new tools fast.

• AI-fluent, and on the frontier: AI is part of your daily workflow as a multiplier, and you proactively keep up with the latest tools and trends. You enjoy being an early adopter, learn new technology fast, and turn it into enterprise-quality work while offloading operational load to it.

• Proactive strategic instinct: You don't wait for the question; you spot the pattern, form a point of view, and bring the recommendation, framed around the leader's decisions.

• Zero-defect operational rigor: Accurate, on-time, exec-ready output. You trace discrepancies to the root cause and won't ship something you can't defend. Strategy and operations are equally weighted.

• Connective tissue, with sound judgment: You run toward cross-functional partnership, understand other teams' incentives, and make it easy to say yes. You see the org as a system rather than silos - with high honesty, integrity, and judgment. You document and teach what you build.

• Executive presence and excellent communication: Command in front of Senior Directors, VPs, and BU leadership; you synthesize complex data into leader-ready decks, exec summaries, and quantitative business cases.

• Relevant Experience & GTM Depth: Prior experience in GTM Strategy, Strategy & Operations, Sales Operations, or Management Consulting at a high-growth technology company, with deep understanding of capacity planning, coverage ratios, and top-of-funnel mechanics.

What This Role Isn't

• Not a pure strategy role: If you want to think but not execute, this isn't the right role. The operational parts of the job aren't optional - strategy and execution are equally weighted, and you are expected to build and run what you design.

• Not an arm's-length role: This job rewards deep immersion in the business: the accounts, the team, the numbers. If you prefer to stay at the analytical surface or delegate execution from the sidelines, this isn't the right fit.

summary:
SLSQ427R609

The Global Pipeline Strategy & Execution team sits at the heart of Databricks’ GTM engine. We set the pipeline targets the company runs on, monitor global pipeline health, evaluate performance, and architect the future top-of-funnel operating model.

We are seeking a strategic, high-leverage Manager / Senior Strategy Lead to serve as the central strategic spine for global pipeline strategy, executive pipeline governance, and long-term Sales Development (xDR) capacity and talent planning.

In this role, you will lead the global pipeline strategy narrative, architect executive Cross-Functional Pipeline Councils, and drive capacity, coverage, compensation, and target-setting frameworks across our global Sales Development organization. As AI and automation transform routine prospecting tasks, you will redefine how our Sales Dev org operates - pairing AI-native capabilities with specialized human roles to unlock optimized coverage ratios while powering our enduring engine for Account Executive talent development.

You will bridge high-level corporate strategy with operational execution - ensuring executive leaders have clear visibility, aligned targets, and structured strategic choices to maximize pipeline generation across all channels.

The Impact You'll Have

1. Executive Pipeline Governance & Strategic Spine

• Executive Pipe Councils Framework: Architect, scale, and orchestrate Executive & Cross-Functional Pipeline Council frameworks, operating cadences, and executive communications alongside senior leadership.

• Central Pipeline Strategy Narrative: Own the global pipeline strategy narrative, synthesizing complex, multi-workstream performance insights into coherent executive presentations and leadership decision frameworks.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Foster seamless alignment across Sales, Sales Development, Marketing, Partner, Programs, and Product GTM teams to ensure leadership remains unified behind top strategic growth bets.

2. Next-Gen Sales Development (xDR) Strategic Planning & Talent Engine

• Capacity & Coverage Modeling: Design and implement scalable xDR capacity and coverage models that integrate automation to optimize territory coverage, improve rep productivity, and drive deeper strategic account engagement.

• Evolving Role Archetypes: Shape the long-term vision and pilot frameworks for specialized Sales Dev role archetypes aligned directly with company-wide growth, product expansion, and sales productivity targets.

• Future AE Talent Architecture: Partner with Sales Dev leadership to design in-seat career progression architecture. Establish target-setting philosophies, compensation structures, and performance gates that develop xDRs into technically credible, high-performing Account Executives.

3. AI-Native Workflows & Operating Rigor

• Operating Frameworks: Install repeatable cadences, standardized review frameworks, and governance models that increase velocity, eliminate friction, and improve cross-functional decision-making.

• AI Builder Mindset: Proactively deploy AI tools (e.g., LLMs, conversational analytics, custom agents) to improve strategy team workflows, automate strategic reporting, and raise the bar for AI capabilities across the GTM strategy org.

• AI-fluent, and on the frontier: AI is part of your daily workflow as a multiplier, and you proactively keep up with the latest tools and trends. You enjoy being an early adopter, learn new technology fast, and turn it into enterprise-quality work while offloading operational load to it.

• Proactive strategic instinct: You don't wait for the question; you spot the pattern, form a point of view, and bring the recommendation, framed around the leader's decisions.

• Zero-defect operational rigor: Accurate, on-time, exec-ready output. You trace discrepancies to the root cause and won't ship something you can't defend. Strategy and operations are equally weighted.

• Connective tissue, with sound judgment: You run toward cross-functional partnership, understand other teams' incentives, and make it easy to say yes. You see the org as a system rather than silos - with high honesty, integrity, and judgment. You document and teach what you build.

• Executive presence and excellent communication: Command in front of Senior Directors, VPs, and BU leadership; you synthesize complex data into leader-ready decks, exec summaries, and quantitative business cases.

• Relevant Experience & GTM Depth: Prior experience in GTM Strategy, Strategy & Operations, Sales Operations, or Management Consulting at a high-growth technology company, with deep understanding of capacity planning, coverage ratios, and top-of-funnel mechanics.

title: Staff Product Manager, Search and AI Visibility - US
description:
Luxury Presence (https://jobicy.com/company/luxury-presence) is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own how our clients get found in search and AI: more than 20,000 real estate websites, each competing in its own market, with a real business depending on the outcome. This is a platform product, where one good product decision reaches thousands of businesses at once.

Search is being rebuilt in real time. Our clients are evaluated by Google, by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and by every prospective seller who asks an assistant which agent they should call. The best people in this job design for three constituencies at once: the people who visit these sites, the crawlers and AI agents that read them, and the real estate business whose revenue depends on both.

This is a product leadership role. You'll run this area like a business: set the strategy, ship with your own engineering team, and work across design, client success, and sales to make it land. It is not a job for someone who runs audits and hands recommendations to other people. Most real estate professionals will never hire a technical SEO of their own. Our platform is how they get one.

What You'll Do

• Own the product strategy, roadmap, and results for organic discovery and AI visibility across every site on the platform, including what clients can see, control, and get credit for

• Spend real time with clients and the teams who serve them, and turn what you learn into a clear point of view on what to build next

• Build the business case for your roadmap and tie it to retention, revenue, and client outcomes

• Make our clients' brands, listings, and expertise legible to AI assistants, and define how we measure citations and visibility across answer engines

• Own the technical foundations every client site depends on, partnering with engineering and the team building our next-generation website platform so recurring problems get solved once through better defaults, automation, or safeguards

• Prove changes on representative groups of sites, establish real impact, then scale what works

• Ship with your own engineering and design partners, writing requirements clear enough that the team moves without waiting on you

• Partner with client success, sales, and marketing so launches land and clients understand the value we deliver

Who You Are

• 7+ years of product management, including owning a product line end to end where you were accountable for adoption, client outcomes, and revenue

• You run your area like a business. You build the case before you build the product, tie your roadmap to retention and revenue, and own the result

• Close to your customers. You talk to them often, understand their business, and can explain why something matters in their terms, not just in rankings

• You create momentum in ambiguity. You narrow the problem, make a call, and move before every question is answered

• Strong opinions, honestly tested. You form a point of view, go looking for the counterargument, and change your mind when the evidence says so

• You make complex things simple for non-technical users, favoring smart defaults and guardrails over configuration

• A communicator who can get a room excited, from engineers to executives to client success, and who earns trust across teams you don't manage

• Hands-on experience with SEO or organic growth and a current point of view on AI search, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers and to know which details actually move results

• Rigorous about measurement. You test before you scale and can tell a result from a coincidence

• Fluent with AI as a working tool, using it to investigate, prototype, and unblock yourself

Preferred Qualifications

• Product experience at a company serving small businesses or solo operators, where customers are busy, non-technical, and judge you on results, such as Shopify, Squarespace, Mailchimp, Square, Yelp, or Thumbtack

• You've owned a marketing product that customers use to grow their own business, such as websites, email, local listings, reviews, or social

• You've made slow or uncertain results visible and credible to customers, in a category like SEO or advertising where impact takes months to show up

• You've worked on a platform where a single change reaches many customers' sites or accounts at once

• You've shipped LLM-powered products to production, especially ones that generate content

• A background in content, editorial, or brand work, and a feel for how a business's voice should change depending on who it's trying to reach

• Founder, GM, or P&L experience

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Product strategy Product roadmap management Technical SEO AI search optimization Organic growth Platform product management Customer discovery Experiment design Data analysis Business case development Cross-functional leadership LLM product development Product requirements writing Sample interview questions How would you define and prioritize a roadmap for AI visibility across thousands of customer websites? I would begin with customer research, technical-site diagnostics, and an assessment of the answer-engine ecosystem to identify high-impact problems. I would prioritize opportunities by expected customer outcome, platform-wide leverage, confidence, implementation effort, and revenue or retention impact. I would then validate the roadmap through representative cohorts before scaling proven capabilities. How would you measure whether a product change improves AI-search visibility rather than reflecting normal ranking volatility? I would establish a baseline and use treatment and control cohorts that are comparable in market, site maturity, and content profile. I would track leading technical indicators alongside outcome metrics such as qualified traffic, citations, impressions, leads, and retention. Statistical testing, sufficient observation windows, and documented confounders would help separate causal impact from coincidence. Describe how you would make SEO results understandable for busy, non-technical real-estate professionals. I would translate technical activity into business-oriented outcomes, such as listing discovery, seller leads, local market authority, and visibility in AI answers. The product should favor safe defaults, clear progress indicators, concise explanations, and actionable recommendations rather than exposing unnecessary configuration. Role Overview We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to own how our clients get found in search and AI: more than 20,000 real estate websites, each competing in its own market, with a real business depending on the outcome. This is a platform product, where one good product decision reaches thousands of businesses at once. Search is being rebuilt in real time. Our clients are evaluated by Google, by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and by every prospective seller who asks an assistant which agent they should call. The best people in this job design for three constituencies at once: the people who visit these sites, the crawlers and AI agents that read them, and the real estate business whose revenue depends on both. This is a product leadership role. You’ll run this area like a business: set the strategy, ship with your own engineering team, and work across design, client success, and sales to make it land. It is not a job for someone who runs audits and hands recommendations to other people. Most real estate professionals will never hire a technical SEO of their own. Our platform is how they get one. title: Presales Consultant
description:
About Us

Ada (https://jobicy.com/company/ada) is an AI customer service company whose mission is to make customer service extraordinary for everyone. We're driven to raise a new standard of quality customer service at scale, enabling enterprise companies to deliver experiences that people love–instant, proactive, personalized, and effortless.

Ada is an AI transformation platform and partner—combining strategic expertise with powerful AI agent management technology to accelerate businesses’ AI maturity to keep them ahead of the curve. With Ada, 83% of customer conversations—and counting—are effortlessly resolved through automation, giving teams more time back, companies more resources to focus on growth, and customers more life to focus on what matters most to them.

Established in 2016, Ada is a Canadian company that has powered over 5.5 billion interactions for leading brands like Square, YETI, IPSY, and Monday.com (http://monday.com/), saving millions of hours of human effort. Backed with over $250M in funding from tier-one investors including Accel, Bessemer, FirstMark, Spark, and Version One Ventures, Ada is a pioneer in the management and application of AI in customer service.

At Ada, we see growth as a reflection of each individual owner’s personal growth. That’s why our values are rooted in driving progress and continuous improvement. If you’re ambitious and eager to grow, Ada could be the place for you.

Learn more at www.ada.cx (http://www.ada.cx).

About the Role

We're seeking a Presales Consultant to join our North American Solutions Consulting team and be the technical voice in some of Ada's most important deals. You'll partner with our Account Managers and Account Executives to run discovery with customer service leaders, uncover what's really holding their operations back, and show them, with working demos built in Ada, what an AI agent can do for their customers across chat, email and voice.

This is a hands-on role. You'll design automation-first solutions for complex deals, help clients see where generative AI fits their business, and bring what you hear in the field back to our Product and Engineering teams so it shapes what we build next.

Outcomes

• Take full technical ownership of a North American book of Account Managers and Account Executives within your first quarter, from first discovery call through technical scoping

• Win deals with custom, prospect-branded demos of Ada across chat, email and voice, and build reusable demo assets the whole team can use

• Lead technical evaluations and proofs of concept that turn interested buyers into confident ones

• Set every closed deal up for a fast launch with a clear technical scoping handoff to our Professional Services team

• Own the technical answers to RFPs and security questionnaires on your deals

• Grow technical win rate, influenced pipeline and closed ARR across your book, and turn recurring product gaps from the field into input for Product and Engineering

About You

• 3-5 years in presales, solutions consulting, or presales engineering

• Proven track record of winning deals by communicating value and differentiation

• Strong understanding of AI technologies, including LLMs and generative models, and their business applications

• Technical proficiency with APIs, SaaS platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Shopify, Zendesk, HubSpot), and integration methodologies

• Exceptional communication, storytelling, and relationship-building skills

#LI-NS1

Benefits & Perks

At Ada, you’ll not only build extraordinary products but also thrive in an environment designed for your success. We prioritize your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Here’s what we offer:

Benefits

• Unlimited Vacation: Recharge when you need to.

• Comprehensive Benefits: Extended health coverage, dental, vision, travel, and life insurance.

• Wellness Account: Empowering you to invest in your overall well-being and lifestyle.

• Employee & Family Assistance Plan: Resources to support you and your loved ones.

Perks

• Flexible Work Schedule: Balance your work and personal life.

• Remote-First, In-Person Friendly: Options to work from home or at our local hub.

• Learning & Development Budget: Invest in your long-term growth goals and skills.

• Work from Home Budget: Equipping you with the tools and support for a seamless remote work experience.

• Access to Cutting-Edge AI Tools: Work with the best AI tech stack in the industry.

• Hands-On with LLMs: Enhance your expertise in leveraging large language models.

• A Thriving Industry: Join the forefront of innovation in AI, shaping the future of technology.

The above Benefits and Perks only apply to full-time, permanent employees.

As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI enabled tools to support certain aspects of hiring, such as interview note-taking. All hiring decisions are made by our team.

Thank you for your interest in joining us at Ada. Due to the high volume of applications, we will only contact candidates whose qualifications match closely to the requirements of the position. We appreciate the time you have invested in learning more about us.

title: Senior Director, Dedicated Infrastructure & Platforms
location: Remote, Canada; Remote, United Kingdom; Remote, United States
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI) as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As the Director of Dedicated Infrastructure Engineering & Platforms, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for GitLab Dedicated, GitLab's premium single-tenant SaaS offering for enterprise customers in regulated industries, and public sector.

You will lead a high-performing organization of managers and engineers who own the entire lifecycle of dedicated and cellular platforms, from orchestration, integrations, resilience, and incident response to switchboard APIs, public sector compliance, and enterprise customer migrations. Your mission is to scale GitLab Dedicated from its current trajectory toward an aggressive growth target, ensuring enterprise customers experience full platform capabilities with dedicated infrastructure, compliance certifications, and enterprise-grade SLAs in an isolated environment.

As a high-impact executive leader, you will define the strategy for single-tenant and public sector SaaS platforms, drive critical infrastructure investments, ensure FedRAMP/compliance operational readiness, and build the switchboard and migration capabilities that allow enterprise customers to seamlessly transition to and scale on Dedicated. You will succeed by cultivating a culture of operational excellence, closing key business and roadmap gaps, and leading distributed engineering teams to deliver high-availability, highly secure platform experiences.

What you'll do

• Own the strategy and roadmap for GitLab Dedicated, and ensure the platform scales with customer growth and converges with GitLab's cellular architecture.

• Partner with Product and executive leadership to deliver on growth targets, with a focus on platform reliability, faster customer onboarding, infrastructure cost efficiency, and self-service administration.

• Lead the engineering teams that build and run the platform: tenant orchestration and integrations, resilience and incident response, the Switchboard control plane, public sector platforms and compliance, and enterprise migrations and import tooling. Uphold enterprise-grade SLAs across every tenant.

• Deliver GitLab Dedicated for Government: AWS GovCloud infrastructure, FedRAMP operations and audit readiness, air-gapped isolation, and public sector feature delivery.

• Make enterprise migrations to Dedicated predictable, repeatable, and low-disruption through self-service tooling and guided workflows.

• Hire, coach, and scale engineering managers across distributed teams, and bring practical AI-enabled workflows into how the organization works.

• Partner with Product, Security, and Customer Support to keep customer commitments, architecture, and investments aligned.

What you'll bring

• You have led engineering organizations that run enterprise single or multi tenant SaaS infrastructure and cloud platforms at scale.

• You have measurably improved production reliability, reduced toil, or lowered infrastructure cost on a platform you owned.

• You have deep expertise in cloud-native and cellular architectures, Infrastructure as Code, and modular services that deploy and scale independently across cloud environments.

• You have delivered and operated enterprise offerings under strict compliance regimes such as FedRAMP and AWS GovCloud.

• You have led organizational changes, including adopting AI enabled workflows that raise engineering system efficiencies.

• You translate financial targets into engineering investments, headcount plans, and execution roadmaps.

• You lead with ownership, speed with quality, and a focus on customer outcomes.

About the team

The Dedicated Infrastructure & Platforms organization builds and runs GitLab Dedicated, our single-tenant enterprise SaaS offering, for GitLab's most strategic enterprise and public sector accounts. It is organized into five focus areas:

• Platform Orchestration & Integrations: orchestration, deployment, and environment automation for Dedicated tenants and cellular environments, plus integrations with external products.

• Core Features, Resilience & Response: compliance and operations driven features, disaster recovery, automated failover, rate limiting, and incident response automation.

• Switchboard & Control Plane: the APIs, tenant change automation, and operator and customer interfaces that make Dedicated self-service.

• Public Sector Platforms & Compliance: AWS GovCloud infrastructure, FedRAMP compliance operations, air-gapped isolation, and Geo replication for GitLab Dedicated for Government.

• Enterprise Migrations & Import Tooling: customer migration programs and playbooks, Geo-based migration tooling, Direct Transfer, and self-service guided import workflows.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/) and equity (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/). Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range

$279,000—$349,000 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/)

• Flexible Paid Time Off  (https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto)

• Team Member Resource Groups (https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/)

• Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan (https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/)

• Growth and Development Fund (https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/)

• Parental Leave (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave)

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups (https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups) are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. (https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/) Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy) and EEO is the Law (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices). If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation), please let us know during the recruiting process (https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process).

title: Staff Software Engineer, Radar
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Radar helps businesses prevent payments fraud and abuse while enabling legitimate customers to transact with confidence. We combine machine learning and AI with the intelligence of Stripe’s global network to make sophisticated fraud prevention accessible to businesses of all sizes.

Our work spans payments fraud detection, protection against abuse beyond the payment, enterprise APIs that bring Radar’s capabilities into businesses’ own systems and payment flows, and the platform that powers it all. We build everything from reliable, low-latency infrastructure to intuitive tools that help users understand threats and control how they respond.

Fraud evolves constantly, and so do we. We work directly with users to understand emerging attacks, turn advances in ML and AI into effective defenses, and build products that protect and grow their revenue.

What you’ll do

As a software engineer on Radar, you’ll build products and infrastructure that help businesses understand and stop fraud and abuse. Your work will span backend services, enterprise APIs, and user experiences that put sophisticated prevention capabilities into our customers’ hands.

You’ll own problems from investigation through launch, partnering with  product managers, designers, and data scientists. You’ll have opportunities to scale systems that make real-time decisions across Stripe’s global payments network, bring advances in ML and AI into production, and build new products from scratch. Every improvement can have a direct impact on the revenue our users retain and the legitimate customers they serve.

Responsibilities

• Build and operate reliable, low-latency services that detect and prevent fraud and abuse at scale

• Design APIs and dashboard experiences that help businesses investigate threats, configure defenses, and understand how Radar protects them

• Develop the shared platform and infrastructure that enable teams to build and launch new Radar capabilities

• Work directly with users to understand emerging threats and turn those insights into broadly useful products

• Partner with ML engineers and data scientists to bring new signals, models, and AI capabilities into production

• Own projects end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and iteration

• Uphold a high bar for engineering quality, reliability, and product craft while moving quickly as threats evolve

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 10+ years of backend and/or full-stack software development experience, with a track record of owning large, ambiguous systems end-to-end.

• Strong coding skills in any programming language, with experience building and maintaining production software

• Demonstrated technical experience leading the design and delivery of large, complex software projects from early definition through production launch.

• Experience leading and unblocking a group of engineers on a substantial project as a senior individual contributor.

• Significant hands-on coding as a senior IC leader in the last year.

• Ability to work across systems and technologies, learn unfamiliar codebases, and make thoughtful technical trade-offs

• Ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity environments: framing problems, making durable technical decisions, and creating an actionable path forward.

• Excellent cross-functional and cross-organizational collaboration skills, with the ability to align teams with different systems, priorities, and constraints.

• Understanding of basic data science concepts, like linear models, precision, recall, and more

• Experience building consumer products at scale, particularly products that require a high degree of user trust.

• Experience working closely with fast customers, including leading upsell calls

Preferred qualifications

• Track record of working closely with data science and ML teams to ship products to users

• Experience working on 0→1 products or taking new capabilities from concept through launch and iteration.

• Experience with Java, Ruby, and/or TypeScript. We care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn than expertise in a particular language or framework.

• Experience building payments, money-movement, fintech, or other regulated financial products.

• Experience building consumer products at scale, particularly products that require a high degree of user trust.

• Familiarity with stablecoins, digital assets, or the infrastructure that enables global financial products.

Our work spans payments fraud detection, protection against abuse beyond the payment, enterprise APIs that bring Radar’s capabilities into businesses’ own systems and payment flows, and the platform that powers it all. We build everything from reliable, low-latency infrastructure to intuitive tools that help users understand threats and control how they respond. Fraud evolves constantly, and so do we. We work directly with users to understand emerging attacks, turn advances in ML and AI into effective defenses, and build products that protect and grow their revenue. What you’ll do As a software engineer on Radar, you’ll build products and infrastructure that help businesses understand and stop fraud and abuse. Your work will span backend services, enterprise APIs, and user experiences that put sophisticated prevention capabilities into our customers’ hands. You’ll own problems from investigation through launch, partnering with product managers, designers, and data scientists. You’ll have opportunities to scale systems that make real-time decisions across Stripe’s global payments network, bring advances in ML and AI into production, and build new products from scratch. Every improvement can have a direct impact on the revenue our users retain and the legitimate customers they serve. Responsibilities Build and operate reliable, low-latency services that detect and prevent fraud and abuse at scale Design APIs and dashboard experiences that help businesses investigate threats, configure defenses, and understand how Radar protects them Develop the shared platform and infrastructure that enable teams to build and launch new Radar capabilities Work directly with users to understand emerging threats and turn those insights into broadly useful products Partner with ML engineers and data scientists to bring new signals, models, and AI capabilities into production Own projects end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and iteration Uphold a high bar for engineering quality, reliability, and product craft while moving quickly as threats evolve Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 10+ years of backend and/or full-stack software development experience, with a track record of owning large, ambiguous systems end-to-end. Strong coding skills in any programming language, with experience building and maintaining production software Demonstrated technical experience leading the design and delivery of large, complex software projects from early definition through production launch. Experience leading and unblocking a group of engineers on a substantial project as a senior individual contributor. Significant hands-on coding as a senior IC leader in the last year. Ability to work across systems and technologies, learn unfamiliar codebases, and make thoughtful technical trade-offs Ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity environments: framing problems, making durable technical decisions, and creating an actionable path forward. Excellent cross-functional and cross-organizational collaboration skills, with the ability to align teams with different systems, priorities, and constraints. Understanding of basic data science concepts, like linear models, precision, recall, and more Experience building consumer products at scale, particularly products that require a high degree of user trust. Experience working closely with fast customers, including leading upsell calls Preferred qualifications Track record of working closely with data science and ML teams to ship products to users Experience working on 0→1 products or taking new capabilities from concept through launch and iteration. Experience with Java, Ruby, and/or TypeScript. We care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn than expertise in a particular language or framework. Experience building payments, money-movement, fintech, or other regulated financial products. Experience building consumer products at scale, particularly products that require a high degree of user trust. Familiarity with stablecoins, digital assets, or the infrastructure that enables global financial products. In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams. title: Compensation & Total Rewards
description:
About ElevenLabs (https://jobicy.com/company/elevenlabs)

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

•
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

•
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

•
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

•
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

•
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

•
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

•
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

•
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

•
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

•
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

•
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

•
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

•
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

•
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

The Role

ElevenLabs is scaling globally at extraordinary speed, growing from 400 to 1,000+ by the end of 2026. We operate across 46+ countries, with a highly distributed workforce spanning researchers, engineers, GTM teams, operators, creatives, and frontier AI specialists. Compensation and total rewards are core to how we attract and retain the best builders in the world.

This environment is inherently complex. Different regulatory frameworks. Different talent markets. Different role archetypes. High volatility in frontier AI compensation benchmarks. That complexity is not a constraint, it’s the challenge.

We are looking for someone to own and evolve our global compensation and total rewards strategy, designing systems that are competitive in frontier AI markets, internally consistent, globally scalable, and built for long-term sustainability.

You will operate as the single point of accountability for compensation architecture across the company, partnering closely with Operations, Legal and Finance.

If you’re energized by solving hard global compensation problems, building clarity across diverse markets, and designing systems that scale globally without slowing the company down, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Compensation Strategy & Philosophy

•
Own and continuously refine ElevenLabs’ global compensation philosophy.

•
Ensure pay, equity, and incentives reinforce attraction, retention, and performance.

•
Balance market competitiveness with internal equity and financial discipline.

•
Serve as a trusted advisor on complex, high-impact compensation decisions.

Job Architecture & Leveling

•
Design systems that introduce rigor without slowing the company down.

•
Evolve our structure intentionally to match our scale: mature enough to support 46+ countries and a diverse set of roles, but not over-engineered or bureaucratic.

•
Drive clarity and consistency in job architecture, leveling frameworks, and compensation bands globally.

Equity & Long-Term Incentives

•
Design equity programs that reflect a core ElevenLabs belief: employees should be genuine owners in the company and invested in our long-term ambition.

•
Own our equity philosophy, structure, and grant strategy.

•
Partner with Finance and Legal on equity design, refresh cycles, and promotion grants.

Compensation Cycles & Governance

•
Assist annual compensation reviews end-to-end.

•
Design clear off-cycle governance and decision frameworks.

•
Build calibration rigor and tooling that scales globally.

•
Introduce AI-enabled workflows where appropriate to improve speed and consistency.

•
Act as the final escalation point for leveling and pay consistency decisions.

Benefits & Total Rewards

•
Own global benefits strategy across a distributed workforce.

•
Balance standardisation with regional relevance.

•
Ensure benefits are competitive in frontier talent markets while remaining operationally scalable.

What We’re Looking For

Experience

•
5+ years in Compensation or Total Rewards, ideally in high-growth technology companies that operate across multiple countries

•
Ownership of equity programs

•
Strong track record of building compensation systems that scale

•
Experience designing and evolving job architectures and leveling systems

•
Experience operating in fast-scaling, ambiguous environments

Skills & Attributes

•
First-principles thinker: approach problems without bias

•
Hands-on builder: comfortable designing systems from scratch

•
Strong analytical skills: the ability to translate data into clear, strategic recommendations

•
Comfortable partnering with senior leaders and influencing decisions in complex, fast-moving environments

•
Excellent communication skills

•
High standards and high ownership

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Global compensation strategy Total rewards Job architecture Job leveling Equity program design Long-term incentives Compensation benchmarking Pay equity Benefits strategy Compensation governance Annual compensation reviews Financial analysis Stakeholder management HR analytics Employment regulations Sample interview questions How would you create a global compensation philosophy for a rapidly scaling company operating in dozens of countries? I would begin by aligning leadership on the talent strategy, business stage, affordability constraints, and desired market position. I would then define consistent principles for base pay, equity, incentives, location approach, and internal equity, supported by clear decision rights and country-specific implementation guidance. The framework would be simple enough to operate quickly while allowing documented exceptions for genuinely different markets or talent profiles. Describe your approach to designing job architecture and leveling without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. I would start with the role families and decisions that most need consistency, then establish a limited set of levels defined by scope, impact, complexity, autonomy, and leadership expectations. I would validate the framework with functional leaders using real roles and compensation data, publish practical guidance, and embed it into hiring, promotion, and compensation processes. Regular calibration would keep the structure useful as the organization evolves. How would you manage equity design and refresh grants in a high-growth private technology company? I would assess the existing equity pool, grant history, dilution model, market benchmarks, and retention risks by role and level. From there, I would establish a transparent grant philosophy covering new-hire grants, promotion grants, refresh cycles, and exceptional cases, in partnership with Finance and Legal. I would also create governance and communication materials so employees understand ownership while leaders can make consistent decisions. What metrics would you use to assess whether a total rewards strategy is working? I would monitor offer acceptance, regretted attrition, pay-position-to-market, pay-equity indicators, promotion outcomes, equity utilization, benefit participation, and compensation-cycle exception rates. I would segment results by role family, level, geography, and relevant demographic groups where legally appropriate. These indicators would be paired with qualitative feedback from managers and employees to identify where policy or communication needs improvement. How do you influence senior leaders when compensation data conflicts with a leader’s preferred decision? I would present the relevant market data, internal comparators, retention considerations, budget implications, and risks in a concise decision framework. Rather than simply rejecting the request, I would explain available options and their trade-offs, including when an exception is justified and how it should be governed. This approach protects consistency while helping leaders make informed, commercially grounded decisions. This analysis is generated from the job description. title: Partner Business Manager
description:
About DevRev (https://jobicy.com/company/devrev)

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

About the role

We're looking for a Channel Partner Manager with a startup mindset and a builder's instinct. You'll own the full lifecycle of partner relationships end to end — from acquisition through business outcomes — with no hand-offs and no waiting for someone else to figure it out. You'll identify and recruit high-potential partners, onboard them effectively, build joint business and channel plans, develop co-created solutions, and relentlessly measure and drive results. This isn't a maintain-the-program role. It's a build-the-program role — high-impact, high-visibility, and central to DevRev's go-to-market expansion across the United States.

Location: North East (NY, PA, NJ) or Chicago only.

Background and experience

•
Currently a solo marketer covering marketing, events, SDR, and pipeline follow-up — broad, high-autonomy scope.

•
Mentors junior field marketers and founders on event strategy.

•
Previously partnered with Christopher Martin on ~3 sponsored events via Startup Grind, so she comes with an existing tie into DevRev's network.

Business acumen

•
Demonstrated strong judgment: turned down a misaligned Dreamforce partnership because the partner was targeting enterprise rather than her ICP — prioritizes pipeline quality over volume.

•
Bias to action: when SDRs produced zero invites for an upcoming dinner, she personally stepped in and invited 12 guests.

•
Frequently mistaken for the CEO at events — executive-level presence and ownership.

Network

•
Self-described "super connector" in the Bay Area startup scene.

•
Strong relationships with Startup Grind and similar organizations, which approach her to recruit sponsors rather than the reverse.

Fit for the role

•
Comfortable with the dual scope of field marketing plus events and understands how the two connect.

•
Bay Area based — aligns with the West Tier-1 city requirement.

•
Strong communication and rapport; described her first call with Laura as a "tête-à-tête, not an interview."

Areas to validate in later rounds

•
Metrics rigor: how she attributes events/campaigns to sourced vs. influenced pipeline.

•
Handoff discipline: how she passes engagements into sales/SDR follow-up and retargeting so momentum compounds.

•
AI and tooling: where she uses AI to speed up research and personalization.

What you'll do

•
Drive partner acquisition — Identify, prospect, and recruit high-value channel partners (VARs, resellers, SIs, and technology alliances) aligned with DevRev's ICP and growth strategy.

•
Own partner onboarding end to end — Design and execute a structured onboarding experience that gets partners productive fast — including technical readiness, sales alignment, and go-to-market activation.

•
Build and drive business plans — Co-develop joint business plans and channel plans with each partner, setting clear revenue targets, pipeline commitments, and milestones.

•
Measure and drive business outcomes — Define partner KPIs, track pipeline contribution, revenue attainment, and deal velocity. Hold partners accountable and course-correct when results fall short.

•
Develop joint solutions — Work with partners and DevRev's product team to co-create integrated solutions, use cases, and offerings that differentiate in the market and accelerate customer adoption.

•
Enable continuously — Deliver ongoing training, certifications, and enablement programs that deepen partner expertise and independence.

•
Align with direct sales — Collaborate closely with DevRev's sales organization to coordinate on accounts, avoid channel conflict, and maximize co-sell impact.

•
Advocate internally — Be the voice of your partners inside DevRev, working with marketing, product, and customer success to ensure partner needs are met.

•
Represent DevRev externally — Attend partner events, QBRs, and industry conferences to strengthen relationships and build brand presence.

What we're looking for

•
4–7 years of experience in channel sales, partner management, or alliances — ideally in SaaS or enterprise software.

•
Startup mindset — you operate with urgency, resourcefulness, and zero entitlement. You don't wait for playbooks; you write them.

•
Builder at heart — you've created something from scratch before (a partner program, a territory, a team) and you're energized by ambiguity, not paralyzed by it.

•
End-to-end owner — you take full accountability from strategy through execution through outcomes. No "that's not my job" in your vocabulary.

•
Proven track record of acquiring partners and scaling those relationships into measurable revenue.

•
Experience building joint business plans and holding partners to outcome-based metrics.

•
Strong understanding of the SaaS go-to-market landscape and partner ecosystem dynamics.

•
Excellent communicator — comfortable presenting to C-level stakeholders at partner organizations.

•
Based in or willing to work from New York or Texas.

Nice to have

•
Experience co-developing joint solutions or integrations with channel partners.

•
Background in CRM, customer support, or DevOps tooling.

•
Existing relationships with SIs or resellers in the mid-market or enterprise space.

What we offer

•
Competitive base salary + commission structure.

•
Equity participation.

•
Full benefits package.

•
Opportunity to shape DevRev's partner program from the ground up.

This role can be based in NY, PA, NJ and Chicago only.

How do we work?
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

title: Sr. Marketing Designer
description:
Who We Are

Imprint (https://jobicy.com/company/imprint) helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com (http://Booking.com), H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

About the Role

We're looking for a talented, multi-disciplinary Designer to join Imprint's marketing team. Imprint powers co-branded credit card programs for 14+ retail, travel, and lifestyle partners, and this role is at the center of how those brands show up across every customer touchpoint.

This role is for an experienced marketing designer who thrives in high-velocity, multi-stakeholder environments and can manage competing priorities without losing the details.

Key Responsibilities

As a member of the Design Team, you will work collaboratively with Marketing, Product, and Commercial teams across a variety of strategic campaign and lifecycle needs:

•
Design marketing assets across digital, physical, and performance channels for multiple co-branded partner programs, including:

•
Digital: emails, web banners, in-app promotions, push notifications, social posts

•
Performance: landing pages, paid media creatives, promotional campaigns

•
Physical: direct mail pieces, in-store signage, mailers, flyers, postcards — including print production, prepress, and vendor-ready file preparation

•
Brand: partner collateral, presentation templates, co-branded materials

•
Work fluently across multiple partner brand systems and translating creative briefs through each partner's unique guidelines, visual identity, and brand voice

•
Design acquisition landing pages

•
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on product and marketing initiatives, managing feedback from both internal stakeholders and external partners

•
Navigate partner review and compliance approval workflows, incorporating feedback from legal, compliance, and partner brand teams

•
Uphold a high bar and own the quality of everything that goes out the door maintaining standards across every partner program

•
Contribute to and maintain design systems and libraries to ensure consistency and scalability across multiple brands

•
Support production workflows including content packaging for translation, asset prep and output, deeplink setup, QR code and UTM generation

Skills and Qualifications

Essential:

•
5+ years of experience in graphic design and production, ideally supporting multiple brands or product lines simultaneously

•
Strong visual design skills and portfolio of work

•
Deep experience working within and across multiple brand guidelines — comfort managing the cognitive load of switching between distinct brand systems

•
Proficient in Figma (primary design tool), Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop)

•
Solid understanding of responsive web and mobile design, UX principles, email design, digital advertising, and social media

•
Strong print design and production skills and experience preparing direct mail, signage, and collateral for print, including prepress file preparation and vendor specifications

•
Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple concurrent projects

•
Clear, proactive communicator who provides regular updates without prompting and can navigate multi-stakeholder feedback loops (internal teams, external partners, compliance)

•
Extremely responsive working independently in a remote environment

•
Attention to detail, high-quality execution, and ability to prioritize in a fast-moving, high-volume production environment

•
Experience with accessibility standards for web and email (WCAG)

Preferred:

•
Experience in fintech, banking, credit cards, or other regulated industries where legal and compliance review is part of the creative process

•
Familiarity with lifecycle marketing concepts and understanding how design supports acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and retention

•
Experience with or interest in AI-assisted design workflows and maintaining brand quality standards for AI-generated content

•
Experience working with Braze

YipitData (https://jobicy.com/company/yipitdata) is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace (https://www.inc.com/profile/yipitdata) for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

• Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes

• Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months

• Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure

• Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

Growth Product Manager

About This Role

We’re hiring a Growth Product Manager to build a product-led growth motion for YipitAgent, our company's latest flagship product.

You’ll own the customer journey from first impression through paid conversion: how prospects discover YipitAgent, understand its value, start a trial, become deeply engaged, and convert into paying customers. Your work may span our SEO/AEO strategy, trial UX, in-product engagement, lifecycle communications, and pricing/packaging. You’ll collaborate closely with core product, design, engineering, data, marketing, and customer-facing teams.

What Success Looks Like

• Organic inbounds become our primary channel for new customer acquisition.

• More visitors start trials and reach meaningful value quickly.

• Trialists engage deeply and consistently throughout their trials.

• More trialists convert into paying customers.

• Measurable increases in active users per account

Key Responsibilities

• Optimize our SEO/AEO by leveraging our proprietary data and the latest technologies & tactics

• Own and improve the growth funnel from acquisition through trial activation, engagement, conversion, and re-engagement.

• Define and measure clear goals and success metrics for each stage of the customer journey.

• Discover ‘aha’ moments through interviews, behavioral data, funnel analysis, and experimentation and incorporate those moments into the UX appropriately.

• Design and optimize trial onboarding, in-product education, activation moments, and upgrade experiences.

• Develop engagement and re-engagement tactics, including proactive and personalized lifecycle touchpoints.

• Incorporate growth tactics into the core product experience so engagement reinforces itself and spreads to other users

• Explore and test pricing, packaging, and trial structures that improve conversion while preserving customer trust.

• Partner with designers and engineers to prototype, launch, measure, and iterate on new experiences.

• Build a disciplined experimentation practice that balances rapid learning with a coherent customer experience.

• Communicate insights, priorities, results, and tradeoffs clearly across the company.

Qualifications & Skills

• 5+ years of growth product management, product marketing, or similarly relevant experience.

• A track record of improving acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, or conversion.

• Strong product and UX judgment, with the ability to turn ambiguous problems into intuitive experiences.

• Highly analytical and comfortable working with funnel metrics, cohorts, experiments, and behavioral data.

• Strong customer discovery skills and the ability to combine qualitative insight with quantitative evidence.

• Experience with product-led growth, self-serve trials, or B2B SaaS products.

• Familiarity with SEO/AEO, lifecycle communications, and pricing or packaging experimentation.

• Comfortable moving between strategy and execution—from defining the growth model to reviewing a trial screen or drafting an email.

• Excellent collaborator and communicator across design, engineering, data, marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

• We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!

• Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Base Salary + Performance-Based Bonus: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $170,000, with eligibility for an annual performance-based bonus of up to 10%. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.
