• Drive Net Revenue Retention by increasing product adoption depth, seat expansion, and multi-threaded engagement.

• Build and manage an accurate renewal forecast 90–120 days in advance.

Strategic Customer Leadership

• Develop multi-threaded relationships across decision-makers, economic buyers, and operational leaders.

• Enable internal champions with structured success plans, ROI articulation, and executive-ready materials.

• Develop deep domain fluency in accounting firm operations and translate Karbon capabilities into strategic business outcomes.

• Operate as a trusted advisor, diagnosing root causes of workflow inefficiencies and aligning product capabilities to measurable firm-level improvements.

• Create and maintain structured Success Plans tied to customer KPIs and long-term growth objectives.

• Conduct executive-level business reviews to measure progress and unlock next best actions.

Risk & Retention Excellence

• Proactively identify churn indicators through behavioral data, health metrics, and qualitative insight.

• Develop structured save plans with clear ROI articulation and executive alignment when risk emerges.

• Contribute to scalable retention methodologies as Karbon grows.

Cross-Functional Influence

• Partner with Sales to support expansion strategy and complex renewal negotiations where needed.

• Collaborate with Implementation, Support, and Education teams to ensure seamless customer experience across the lifecycle.

• Translate customer insights into structured, data-backed feedback for Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap priorities.

• Collaborate with Marketing to inform industry-specific messaging and thought leadership grounded in real customer outcomes.

• Drive cross-functional alignment to remove friction and deliver measurable customer outcomes.

• Leverage AI-driven tools and usage analytics to identify expansion opportunities, risk signals, and productivity gains.

title: Senior Linux System Administrator
description:
Who We Are

Vultr (https://jobicy.com/company/vultr) is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

•
100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.

•
401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

•
Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

•
11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan

•
Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

•
$500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

•
Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

•
Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

•
Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Linux Administrator to handle challenging issues and support our ever-expanding global customer base. The ideal candidate is technology driven, detail oriented, and a team player. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

•
Mentor and train Junior System Administrators and System Administrators to develop technical expertise and operational best practices.

•
Lead technical projects from planning through implementation, ensuring timely and successful delivery.

•
Manage incident response activities for escalated issues, coordinating resolution and communication as needed.

•
Perform the setup, configuration, and ongoing management of internal infrastructure virtual machines (VMs) and services.

•
Plan, stage, and deploy platform upgrades and updates across the server fleet.

•
Provision and configure software on new nodes to support production and development environments.

•
Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis for platform and customer-reported issues.

•
Install, configure, and commission servers by deploying required operating systems, software, and services.

Qualifications

•
5+ years of experience administering enterprise Linux environments (CentOS, Debian, Ubuntu, or similar).

•
Advanced knowledge of Linux system administration, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and security best practices.

•
Proficiency in Bash, Python, or other scripting languages used for automation and infrastructure management.

•
Experience deploying and managing virtualization platforms and containerized workloads, including Kubernetes and Libvirt.

•
Familiarity with networking technologies, including routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing, and DNS.

•
Experience configuring and supporting web servers, databases, caching solutions, and distributed storage platforms such as Ceph.

•
Working knowledge of Cumulus Linux, PHP routing, and related infrastructure technologies is a plus.

•
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex platform and customer-facing issues.

•
Excellent communication, documentation, and mentoring skills with the ability to collaborate across technical teams.

Compensation

$80,000 - $100,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy (https://www.vultr.com/legal/privacy/).

title: AI Product Manager, Growth Marketing
location: New York, New York; San Francisco, California
description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Truly unique opportunity to shape and scale self-optimizing paid marketing systems for Growth. This role exists to turn our performance marketing experimentation program from a prototype into the operating system. The opportunity calls for deep paid-growth expertise and a strong grasp of how channel mechanics, audiences, creative, measurement, experimentation, and automation fit together. You’ll set the strategy and operating model, and guide the agentic infrastructure that brings it to life. You’ll partner with BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing across Meta, LinkedIn, Google, and ChatGPT, interpreting always-on geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

- By day 90:

- Map how geo, audience, creative, spend, measurement, experimentation, and platform constraints interact; establish an operating model that turns those signals into hypotheses, tests, and clear kill/scale decisions, with agents supporting execution.

- Build a deep understanding of onboarding and activation, and how paid acquisition connects to downstream user quality; partner with Growth PM and Ecosystems PM on meaningful improvements.

- Establish how AI and agents can strengthen the end-to-end decision system—from analysis and hypothesis generation to creative and audience development, experiment QA, and reusable workflows—improving decision quality, not only execution speed.

- By the end of year one:

- Graduate the program from managing the experimental budget to managing the majority of paid spend, while maintaining efficiency and Notion’s quality bar for ad creative.

- Establish stronger measurement and a clear, connected view of which experiments move which metrics, why they work, and how results vary by user cohort; use that understanding to shape more personalized experiences.

- Turn the system into a repeatable model for Demand Generation, raising the standard for experimentation, measurement, and agentic marketing infrastructure across the organization.

SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

- Strong systems fluency across APIs, automation pipelines, and agentic systems. You can see how platform integrations, data, measurement, workflows, and constraints fit together; shape sound architecture and tradeoffs; and partner credibly with technical teams to make the system reliable.

- Deep paid-growth subject matter expertise across platforms such as Meta, LinkedIn, and Google. You understand how channel mechanics, budgets, audiences, creative, and performance interact, and can connect those dynamics to real marketing outcomes.

- Expert measurement and performance-analysis judgment: you can interpret geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context, identify meaningful patterns, understand what is driving them, and make clear kill/scale decisions.

- Strong product and systems judgment across technical and marketing domains, with the ability to connect the parts into a coherent strategy and translate an ambiguous frontier into a system with a high quality bar.

- High-agency cross-functional ownership: you can work across BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing to align decisions and deliver the full loop from strategy through operating model and infrastructure to outcomes.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $191,000 - $225,000 per year.

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

summary:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Truly unique opportunity to shape and scale self-optimizing paid marketing systems for Growth. This role exists to turn our performance marketing experimentation program from a prototype into the operating system. The opportunity calls for deep paid-growth expertise and a strong grasp of how channel mechanics, audiences, creative, measurement, experimentation, and automation fit together. You’ll set the strategy and operating model, and guide the agentic infrastructure that brings it to life. You’ll partner with BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing across Meta, LinkedIn, Google, and ChatGPT, interpreting always-on geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

- By day 90:

- Map how geo, audience, creative, spend, measurement, experimentation, and platform constraints interact; establish an operating model that turns those signals into hypotheses, tests, and clear kill/scale decisions, with agents supporting execution.

- Build a deep understanding of onboarding and activation, and how paid acquisition connects to downstream user quality; partner with Growth PM and Ecosystems PM on meaningful improvements.

- Establish how AI and agents can strengthen the end-to-end decision system—from analysis and hypothesis generation to creative and audience development, experiment QA, and reusable workflows—improving decision quality, not only execution speed.

- By the end of year one:

- Graduate the program from managing the experimental budget to managing the majority of paid spend, while maintaining efficiency and Notion’s quality bar for ad creative.

- Establish stronger measurement and a clear, connected view of which experiments move which metrics, why they work, and how results vary by user cohort; use that understanding to shape more personalized experiences.

- Turn the system into a repeatable model for Demand Generation, raising the standard for experimentation, measurement, and agentic marketing infrastructure across the organization.

SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

- Strong systems fluency across APIs, automation pipelines, and agentic systems. You can see how platform integrations, data, measurement, workflows, and constraints fit together; shape sound architecture and tradeoffs; and partner credibly with technical teams to make the system reliable.

- Deep paid-growth subject matter expertise across platforms such as Meta, LinkedIn, and Google. You understand how channel mechanics, budgets, audiences, creative, and performance interact, and can connect those dynamics to real marketing outcomes.

- Expert measurement and performance-analysis judgment: you can interpret geo, cohort, creative, and spend signals in context, identify meaningful patterns, understand what is driving them, and make clear kill/scale decisions.

- Strong product and systems judgment across technical and marketing domains, with the ability to connect the parts into a coherent strategy and translate an ambiguous frontier into a system with a high quality bar.

- High-agency cross-functional ownership: you can work across BizOps, Strat Fin, Growth, Ecosystems, and Marketing to align decisions and deliver the full loop from strategy through operating model and infrastructure to outcomes.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. title: Account Manager | Growth
location: New York, NY (HQ); San Francisco, CA
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a member of the Growth Account Management team, you will deliver value to our customers and revenue for our business by owning expansion and retention of a scaled portfolio of current Ramp customers. You will help identify growth opportunities within your portfolio and operate a set of scaled touch-points to engage with these customers. As an early member of the team, you will have the opportunity to help build and refine Ramp’s scaled account management motion.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Identify expansion opportunities within a scaled portfolio of Ramp customers and own the entire sales process through close

- Develop and execute upsell/cross-sell strategies and maintain a robust expansion pipeline

- Develop a deep understanding of Ramp customer personas and act as a trusted advisor and consultant to help them achieve their goals with Ramp

- Leverage sales methodologies to uncover customer needs and pain points

- Gather and provide customer feedback to directly inform Ramp’s product roadmap & customer communication strategy

- Collaborate with cross-functional partners to continuously improve operational efficiencies while also advocating for your customers

WHAT YOU NEED

- Minimum 2 years of customer-facing or direct sales experience

- Proven track record of achievement in a high velocity business environment

- Prior CRM experience (preferably Salesforce)

- Experience with outbound prospecting and conducting product demonstrations, with a high level of comfort with sales tools & processes

- Consultative sales approach and comfortable leveraging analytical & quantitative skills, with a deep interest in understanding business challenges

- Ability to discuss Ramp's value proposition with C-level executives, finance teams, and decision makers

- Consistent track record of hitting or exceeding sales targets in a fast-paced and metrics-driven environment

- Dedication to tracking and improving performance and efficiency on a daily basis

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to deliver compelling sales pitches and presentations

- Organizational, project management, and time management skills

- Sense of entrepreneurship: a self-starter with a high sense of urgency and ability to work within undefined processes

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university

- Experience with financial services sales

- Experience at a high-growth startup

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

- Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

CANADA

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

- Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

- Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

- Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

- Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

UNITED KINGDOM

- Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

- Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

- Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice https://ramp.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice

title: Inside Account Executive (Hunter)
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role
As a Hunter Inside Sales Representative, you will be a pivotal part of Elastic’s growth focusing on selling, managing, and growing net new accounts within our Commercial segment. Our Hunter Virtual Sales Reps are individual contributors, focused on building new business, within a set of net-new accounts. Within this role you will have the opportunity to engage and partner with large Commercial accounts solving critical business needs for those customers while positioning our suite of products across (Search, Observability, and Search). Are you someone who is a go-getter that has to drive to excel in a fast-growing segment of new accounts? If so, we’d love to hear from you!

What You Will Be Doing

• Develop and build a territory plan for accounts that you will actively own, call, and manage in a defined territory

• Focusing primarily on Whitespace Accounts

• Create a strategic prospecting strategy that you will execute daily to gain introductions, solve business challenges, and effectively position our technology

• Identify and qualify new opportunities leveraging your own creativity, inbound lead flow, personal prospecting efforts, contacts, existing accounts and partners

• Work cross-functionally with our sales development, marketing, partner, product and customer service teams to deliver outstanding results

• Negotiate pricing and contractual terms as required to close the sale

• Accurately forecast profitable and predictable territory performance and required resources through adherence of our sales process

What You Bring

• 2+ years of experience in sales roles, that are defined as hunting or creating new accounts

• Strong ability to plan and execute strategies related to driving pipeline in whitespace accounts

• A collaborative and inventive approach to problem-solving

• The desire and ability to operate and thrive in an ambitious, self-starting environment

• Technologically adept and business acumen focused with outstanding communication both written and oral, negotiation and presentation skills

Bonus Points

• Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.

• Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.

If you’re driven to build your own pipeline, master complex deal cycles, and help customers unlock the power of Search AI, we’d love to talk. Apply today!

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary plus a variable component, that together comprise the On-Target Earnings (OTE).  On-Target Earnings (OTE) are based on a 50/50 pay mix (base salary / target variable).

The typical starting OTE range for new hires in this role is listed below.  This range represents the lowest to highest OTE we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future.

An employee's position within the OTE range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:

$65,600—$103,700 USD

The typical starting Target Variable range for this role is:

$65,500—$103,600 USD

The typical starting On-Target Earnings (OTE) range for this role is:

$131,100—$207,300 USD

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

• Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

• Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

• Generous number of vacation days each year

• Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

• Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

• Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

title: Public Sector Field Enablement Manager
location: Northeast - United States; Southeast - United States; United States
description:
FEQ227R339

The Public Sector Field Enablement Manager builds the enablement strategy that helps Databricks win new public sector customers, deepen account engagement, and grow platform consumption with a focus on Federal and National Security. This role partners with Sales and Field Engineering leadership to translate public sector priorities into measurable improvements in field readiness, pipeline, ramp, and consumption outcomes.

The Impact You Will Have

• Within the first 12–18 months, establish a prioritized public sector enablement roadmap supporting approximately 75 account executives and the field engineers aligned to their accounts, with progress and business impact reviewed in regular leadership business reviews.

• Improve public sector field readiness by establishing and increasing adoption of role-specific certifications, skills, and selling behaviors for account executives and solutions architects.

• Reduce time to productivity for new public sector account executives and solutions architects by establishing repeatable ramp outcomes tied to procurement, compliance, buyer, and Databricks platform knowledge.

• Increase enablement-influenced pipeline and public sector consumption attainment by equipping field teams to apply segment-specific account strategies, value narratives, and sales plays in active opportunities.

• Improve deal execution in public sector accounts by enabling teams to navigate government procurement vehicles, security requirements, compliance considerations, and competitive positioning.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States; San Francisco, California, United States

About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List (https://www.forbes.com/lists/cloud100/) and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company (https://www.ycombinator.com/blog/yc-top-companies-2024).

About the Role

Truework, recently acquired by Checkr, provides access to crucial employment, income information and asset information needed for mortgage loans, apartment rentals, background checks, and more. We are disrupting a $5B+ industry, dominated by legacy incumbents and outdated processes, with a better product and intense customer focus. Within Checkr, Truework operates independently, allowing rapid iteration while also being able to leverage the strengths and assets from our core business. Think of it like joining a startup within a startup!

As a Strategic Account Executive on the Truework team, you’ll help scale our impact across large national and regional lenders, with a primary focus on acquiring new clients to Truework Verification services. As automated verification services become a more common practice for lenders in how they run their operation, you’ll lead the charge in building and executing a more repeatable playbook to drive new customers who will grow with us for years to come. By deeply understanding their unique company challenges and goals, you will pair them with solutions that will help them reach their business objectives and innovate within their organizations.

This role is ideal for a proven sales professional who:

• has experience selling transformational solutions to customers, where you can quickly identify and pattern map where and how the Truework solution can drive impact in a customer’s operation

• has experience identifying and building relationships with decision makers, business and technology influencers and users, closing 6- and 7-figure pursuits

• who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment— ready to help close the gap between the legacy solutions and processes lending teams are leaning on and their plans and intentions to deliver competitive and streamlined processes for consumers

You will be an important part of an elite, professional, and rapidly growing cross-functional team that succeeds through collaboration, grit, and learning.

What you’ll do

• Deliver Sales Excellence:

• Consistently achieve pipeline and revenue targets by applying modern sales techniques and processes to efficiently manage top of funnel engagement tactics and deal strategy and close processes

• Think outside-the-box to cultivate awareness of the Truework vision. Plan and execute targeted campaigns for your territory working with the marketing and partner teams to scale your coverage and build pipeline

• Partner with and guide the efforts of our internal team to support your accounts in pre-sales activities and in the deployment to execute on agreed upon account goals, strategies and tactics for growth

• Leverage analytics, case studies, past performance, and market intelligence to create a territory plan and craft your own target account strategies.

• Manage Account Relationships:

• Have an understanding of the lender’s operation and an ability to identify the varying use cases where verification services can drive impact

• Exhibit deep and up-to-date knowledge of our product portfolio in order to communicate the benefits of new features and enhancements

title: Integrated Marketing Lead, UCAN Programming & Industry
description:
Headquarters: New York, NY, US; Remote, US

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility (https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-life/pinflex/) to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here (https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-philosophy-on-ai-in-hiring/).

Pinterest's Global Business Organization partners with advertisers, agencies and the wider industry to grow Pinterest's business. This role owns how Pinterest shows up with key industry associations and on the industry's biggest stages, from 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA to marquee moments like CES and POSSIBLE. You'll be the connective tissue between Pinterest's leaders and the external industry across the U.S. and Canada, shaping visibility, influence and reputation across the advertising and marketing landscape.

What you'll do:

• Serve as Pinterest's day-to-day contact for key industry associations — including 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA — leading memberships and commitments, delivering against contractual obligations, and finding new ways to grow Pinterest's visibility and influence within these organizations.

• Know the industry and these associations inside and out: ensure Pinterest is getting the most value out of each membership, and recommend where to deepen, sustain or exit a relationship when it's no longer earning its keep.

• Partner with Sales leadership to make sure membership benefits (introductions, visibility, data, access) are actually being used and translating into value for the business.

• Inform Pinterest's speakership strategy and lead execution across key U.S. and Canada industry moments — including CES and POSSIBLE — sourcing, pitching and securing speaking opportunities that match the right Pinterest voices to the right stages and ladder up to business priorities.

• Develop programming — talking points, fireside chats, client panels and more — for Pinterest's owned events and industry events across the U.S. and Canada.

• Support programming for occasional agency events (e.g., WPP Stream) and large client moments, such as an executive panel at a major client's company-wide gathering or a top-five agency holding company event.

• Prepare and support internal spokespeople and executives for speaking engagements, developing briefs, talking points and narratives in partnership with Comms to establish a consistent, compelling Pinterest story across every stage moment.

• Partner with senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing and Comms to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities and reconcile competing perspectives.

• Track, measure and report on the value and impact of memberships, event investments and speaking engagements, and use those insights to recommend where to deepen, sustain or exit commitments.

• Use AI to accelerate research, speaker briefing prep, event planning and reporting, while applying judgment and verification to establish correctness and quality.

What we're looking for:

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in integrated marketing, industry relations, communications or event marketing, with expertise in sourcing and shaping speaking opportunities at major industry events.

• Experience managing industry association memberships or similar external relationships, including evaluating their value and making recommendations on where to invest or pull back.

• Experience preparing spokespeople and executives for stage moments, including developing briefs, talking points and narratives in partnership with communications teams.

• Experience leading the end-to-end delivery of events and activations, including sponsorships, panels, logistics, budgets and timelines across multiple moments at once.

• Experience building effective relationships with senior stakeholders, including Sales leadership, and reconciling perspectives to prioritize the highest-impact work with limited guidance.

• Expertise in written and verbal communication, with the ability to represent a company credibly to external organizations, clients and agency partners.

• Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate research, briefing and reporting, with a clear approach to validating accuracy and quality.

• Strong track record of critical evaluation and verification of AI-assisted work, with high integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables.

• Willingness to travel for key industry events, client events and speaking engagements as needed.

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as marketing or communications, or equivalent experience.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/month and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

#LI-REMOTE
#LI-JH4

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here (https://www.pinterestcareers.com/pinterest-life/).

US based applicants only

$120,321—$247,718 USD

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form (https://forms.gle/sS24D4WboEKUZMQK6) for support.

By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pinterest-integrated-marketing-lead-ucan-programming-industry

title: Brand Partnerships Lead
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility (https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-life/pinflex/) to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here (https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-philosophy-on-ai-in-hiring/).

Pinterest is looking for a Brand Partnerships Lead to shape and lead high-impact client partnerships and pop-up programs that connect brands with our platform in creative, meaningful ways. You’ll work across creative, production, experiential, sales and operations partners to bring integrated programs from concept through launch. This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, creative development, and execution, with clear visibility into business impact and room to grow your influence over time.

What you’ll do:

• Lead end-to-end marketing strategy and execution for mid-to-large client partnership and pop-up programs from concept through launch.

• Establish program frameworks, planning rhythms and decision points that align business priorities, partner needs and Pinterest brand standards across multiple high-visibility initiatives.

• Lead cross-functional collaboration across creative, production, experiential, sales, and operations teams to keep high-visibility programs moving forward.

• Manage communication and expectations across assigned programs, building strong relationships and ensuring alignment on timelines, deliverables, feedback, and overall program execution.

• Establish goals, track milestones, and measure performance against KPIs tied to program success, package volume, and incremental revenue.

• Turn program learnings into strategic recommendations that influence future partnership offerings, operating models and market-facing opportunities.

• Use AI to speed early planning, briefing and concept development, while applying judgment and verification to maintain quality.

• Use AI to summarize learnings, streamline repeatable reporting and help identify opportunities to improve future programs.

What we’re looking for:

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in integrated marketing, brand partnerships, experiential marketing or program leadership.

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, a related field or equivalent experience.

• Experience in leading complex partnership or pop-up programs from planning through launch, with clear ties to business and revenue goals.

• Experience in partnering across creative, production, experiential, sales, and operations to move cross-functional work forward.

• Experience in translating business priorities into clear plans, timelines, and integrated go-to-market approaches.

• Experience ideating on and reviewing creative work, upholding brand standards, and giving clear feedback that strengthens ideas and execution.

• Experience in using performance insights and business context to recommend changes that improve future partnership strategy, planning and execution.

• High integrity and ownership in handling sensitive information, avoiding over-reliance on AI and staying accountable for final decisions and deliverables.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6 months and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

#REMOTE #LI-JH4

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here (https://www.pinterestcareers.com/pinterest-life/).

US based applicants only

$120,321—$247,718 USD

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form (https://forms.gle/sS24D4WboEKUZMQK6) for support.

By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.

title: Senior Product Manager, Platform
description:
Who We Are

Vultr (https://jobicy.com/company/vultr) is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

•
100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.

•
401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

•
Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

•
11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan

•
Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

•
$500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

•
Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

•
Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

•
Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Product Manager to own the Platform product suite — the foundational capabilities, control plane, and developer tools that customers use to provision, manage, automate, and govern their infrastructure. This includes Vultr's REST APIs, Console, CLI, SDKs, Terraform provider, Billing, Account Activity, Audit Logs, Regions, IAM, Sub Accounts, Admin, Instance Templates, Custom Images, Startup Scripts, SSH Keys, and Support Tickets. Together these products form the platform layer that every Vultr customer interacts with and that every infrastructure product depends on to reach customers. The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency in platform engineering, API design, and developer experience, combined with a strong product instinct for building tools that make infrastructure feel effortless. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require close partnership with Compute, Network, Storage, Security, and AI teams to ensure every new infrastructure launch is programmable, governed, and intuitive from day one. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of independent cloud infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

•
Own the end-to-end Platform product suite roadmap — covering developer surfaces (REST APIs, Console, CLI, SDKs, Terraform provider, ISOs) and account-level capabilities (Billing, Account Activity, Audit Logs, Regions, IAM, Sub Accounts, Admin, Instance Templates, Custom Images, Startup Scripts, SSH Keys, and Support Tickets)

•
Define Vultr's platform and developer experience strategy aligned to infrastructure roadmap, reliability goals, and the needs of both digital-native builders and enterprise customers adopting the cloud

•
Drive the customer-facing platform surface across APIs, Console UI, CLI, SDKs — ensuring consistency, completeness, and a coherent experience across all touchpoints

•
Own the API as a product — define versioning strategy, deprecation policy, rate limiting, pagination, error handling, and authentication flows that make Vultr's API a first-class developer experience

•
Own the Console as a product — drive the web-based control plane experience, working with design and frontend engineering to make complex infrastructure operations intuitive and efficient

•
Own the Terraform provider, CLI, and SDKs — ensure our infrastructure-as-code and programmatic tooling stays current with API changes and represents best-in-class developer tooling practices

•
Own the account management and governance product surface — Billing, IAM, Sub Accounts, Audit Logs, and Admin tools that give customers control over access, spending, and compliance posture

•
Own the operational product surface — Regions, Instance Templates, Custom Images, Startup Scripts, SSH Keys, and Support Tickets that customers use daily to manage and automate their infrastructure at scale

•
Work closely with engineering on technical tradeoffs across API design, authentication flows, rate limiting, caching strategies, SDK generation, CLI architecture, and Console frontend performance

•
Build products for two customer profiles — digital-native builders who want speed and simplicity, and enterprise adopters who need IAM, audit trails, sub-account governance, and programmatic control

•
Ensure new infrastructure and platform launches are API-first and Console-ready by design through strong partnership with compute, network, storage, security, and AI teams

•
Define and measure platform health metrics — API availability, latency, error rates, SDK adoption, Console task completion rates, CLI active usage, and developer satisfaction

•
Stay current on modern platform engineering trends, including API design patterns, SDK generation, developer portals, infrastructure-as-code, identity and access management, and the evolving state of cloud developer experience

Qualifications

•
7+ years of product management experience in cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, infrastructure-as-code, or API products

•
Deep understanding of platform engineering — you've designed, shipped, or maintained APIs, CLIs, SDKs, or developer tools at scale

•
Experience defining product strategy and roadmaps for platform or developer-facing products at scale

•
Experience with cloud account management and governance products — billing, IAM, audit logging, sub-accounts, or equivalent enterprise access control systems

•
Strong technical background — ability to engage with engineering on API design, authentication flows, rate limiting, SDK architecture, and frontend performance

•
Experience with infrastructure-as-code ecosystems — Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or similar

•
Track record of shipping developer-facing products with measurable impact on adoption, task completion time, or developer satisfaction

•
Experience with cloud provider platforms — you've worked on or extensively used AWS, GCP, Azure, DigitalOcean, Linode, or similar. You know what good and bad cloud UX feels like

•
Experience with API lifecycle management — versioning, deprecation, backward compatibility, and developer communication

•
Experience working across cross-functional teams (engineering, design, marketing, sales) in a fast-paced environment

•
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for diverse audiences

•
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Compensation

$180,000 - $200,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy (https://www.vultr.com/legal/privacy/).

title: Full-Time LSAT Tutor
description:
About Inspira Education (https://jobicy.com/company/inspira-education)

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We are looking for an experienced full-time LSAT Tutor to provide one-on-one LSAT preparation to students. You will teach all sections of the LSAT, develop individualized study plans, and track student progress throughout their preparation.

This is a full-time, remote role that can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. The 40-hour workweek includes 5–10 hours of preparation time, with tutoring scheduled around student availability, including weekday afternoons, evenings, and weekends.

Responsibilities

• Tutor students one-on-one across all sections of the LSAT

• Develop and adapt LSAT study plans based on each student's needs and performance

• Track and analyze student progress

• Create and maintain project trackers to monitor LSAT preparation progress

• Keep students' families up to date on academic progress and milestones

• Participate in additional opportunities as they arise, such as leading webinars or training other tutors

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or higher

• Previously taken the Law School Admission Test (LSAT); official score report required

• LSAT score in the 99th percentile

• 2+ years of LSAT tutoring or LSAT test-preparation experience

• Able to provide LSAT test preparation across all sections of the exam

• Available to tutor during weekday afternoons, evenings, and weekends

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple students and priorities

• Comfortable teaching and coaching in a fully remote environment

Why you'll love Inspira

• Mission-driven team focused on student success

• Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe

• Health, dental, and vision insurance, with base plans 100% employer paid

• Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)

• Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

• 401(k) with company match

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group (https://www.inspiraeducationgroup.com/).

Inspira Education Group does not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in providing employment opportunities and benefits.

title: Full-Time MCAT Tutor
description:
About Inspira Education (https://jobicy.com/company/inspira-education)

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We are looking for an experienced MCAT Tutor to provide one-on-one MCAT preparation to students. You will teach all sections of the MCAT, develop individualized study plans, and track student progress throughout their preparation.

This is a full-time, remote role that can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. Your 40-hour workweek will include tutoring and preparation time, with tutoring scheduled around student availability, including weekday afternoons, evenings, and weekends.

Responsibilities

• Tutor students one-on-one across all sections of the MCAT

• Develop and adapt MCAT study plans based on each student's needs and performance

• Track and analyze student progress and performance

• Create and maintain project trackers to monitor MCAT preparation progress

• Keep students' families up to date on academic progress and MCAT milestones

• Provide guidance on MCAT content, strategy, and test-taking skills

• Participate in additional opportunities as they arise, such as leading webinars or training other tutors

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or higher

• Previously taken the Medical College Admission Test (MCAT); official score report required

• MCAT score of 521+

• 2+ years of MCAT tutoring or MCAT test-preparation experience

• Able to provide MCAT test preparation across all sections of the exam

• Available to tutor during weekday afternoons, evenings, and weekends

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple students and priorities

• Comfortable teaching and coaching in a fully remote environment

Why you'll love Inspira

• Mission-driven team focused on student success

• Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe

• Health, dental, and vision insurance, with base plans 100% employer paid

• Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)

• Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

• 401(k) with company match

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group (https://www.inspiraeducationgroup.com/).

Inspira Education Group does not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in providing employment opportunities and benefits.

title: BS/MD Admissions Consultant
description:
About Inspira Education (https://jobicy.com/company/inspira-education)

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We are seeking a BS/MD Admissions Consultant with prior admissions committee experience and a strong understanding of the BS/MD, direct medical, and competitive undergraduate admissions process. This role is ideal for physicians who are passionate about mentorship, education, and helping high-achieving students navigate BS/MD applications. This is a part-time, remote, 1099 contract role that can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

Responsibilities

• Guide prospective BS/MD and direct medical program applicants through the admissions process, including school selection, application strategy, essays, resumes, recommendations, timelines, and interviews

• Help students strengthen their academic and extracurricular profiles and develop compelling application materials

• Support students in researching and evaluating best-fit BS/MD, pre-med, and undergraduate programs aligned with their goals and interests

• Provide guidance and feedback on personal statements, supplemental essays, and interview preparation while helping students maintain an authentic voice

• Support students with project planning, application timeline management, and progress tracking through internal organizational tools

• Stay up to date on BS/MD, direct medical, pre-med, and undergraduate admissions trends to provide timely and strategic guidance

Qualifications

• MD or DO degree required

• Prior admissions committee experience at the undergraduate or medical school level

• Experience mentoring high school students, particularly in academic advising or college application support

• Familiarity with BS/MD, direct medical, and pre-med admissions processes, including school selection, application strategy, and interview preparation

• Proven success guiding students through competitive undergraduate admissions

• Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple students and timelines

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group (https://www.inspiraeducationgroup.com/).

Inspira Education Group does not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in providing employment opportunities and benefits.

title: Engineering Manager, Sandboxes
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Testability has long been a priority for Stripe. Before users trust code with their money, they need to verify that it’s safe and correct. This need drove Stripe to build test mode and, more recently, Sandboxes, which enables safe, isolated, and scalable testing.

As businesses build with AI and agents, their testing needs are evolving. Stripe customers use claimable sandboxes to add Stripe capabilities to prototypes before business registration. Once onboarded, they provision isolated test environments to support agents’ exploration. These capabilities help developers and agents build and test their integrations with Stripe.

The Sandboxes team defines, builds, and operates these testing capabilities. We work across Stripe to make our products testable, helping businesses develop with confidence and shaping the future of Stripe’s developer platform.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead and grow the Sandboxes engineering team, setting technical direction and operating critical systems. You’ll build a culture of operational excellence and thoughtful product development.

You’ll work directly with users to understand their needs and partner with Product, Design, and Data Science to shape and deliver the team’s strategy. The role combines building reusable testing capabilities across Stripe with attention to the details that make developer tools effective and easy to use.

Responsibilities

• Lead engineering planning and execution, partnering with Design to build clear, useful testing experiences.

• Shape the team’s strategy and roadmap, aligning partners across Product, Design, Infrastructure, Marketing, and Operations.

• Own delivery from problem definition through rollout and ongoing operation, improving both system performance and the user experience.

• Uphold high engineering standards across the team’s codebases and development practices.

• Partner with Recruiting to hire engineers and build a diverse, high-performing team.

• Coach and mentor engineers, provide candid feedback, and support career development tailored to their goals.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, we encourage you to apply.

Minimum requirements

• 4+ years of engineering management experience, directly managing and growing teams of 5+ engineers building and shipping products at scale.

• 8+ years of full-time software development experience.

• Experience building reusable, extensible software that supports a range of user needs, with strong user empathy and a commitment to high-quality user experiences.

• Strong problem-solving skills, with a track record of finding practical solutions to complex challenges.

• Experience turning ambiguous goals into clear priorities and delivering multiple high-impact workstreams.

• A track record of building a supportive environment with candid feedback and high expectations.

• Technical depth to guide architecture and product design discussions and help engineers make informed tradeoffs.

• Experience taking ownership of initiatives and moving work forward independently.

Preferred qualifications

• Strong product and design judgment, including the ability to simplify complex user experiences.

• Experience making decisions and building strong working relationships across teams.

• Experience building and leading a distributed team across multiple locations and time zones.

• Experience building developer tools or platform capabilities.

• Experience building testing tools or capabilities that help users test within a product.

• Experience building AI agent systems or tools that support agent-driven development.

title: Director, Strategic Finance - Planning Systems
description:
Hims & Hers (https://jobicy.com/company/hims-hers) is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about (http://hims.com/about) and hims.com/how-it-works (http://hims.com/how-it-works) . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals (http://www.hims.com/careers-professionals).

About the Role

Hims & Hers is looking to hire a Director, Strategic Finance - Planning Systems lead to join our Strategic Finance organization. Reporting to the VP, FP&A, you will own the architecture behind the company's consolidated planning and reporting cycles, designing how inputs from across the FP&A pillars flow into a coherent, system-based corporate view that informs decisions made by senior leadership, the executive team, and the Board.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who pairs strong financial and business acumen with deep experience in planning tools and finance transformation. You will own end-to-end workstreams, set the standard for how planning and reporting scale, and act as a force multiplier for the brocader FP&A team. We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment and gets energy from building durable infrastructure.

You Will

•
Own the consolidated planning and reporting engine behind the annual operating plan, long-range plan, and monthly/quarterly forecast cycles, covering data intake, consolidation, and on-time delivery of the outputs reviewed by senior leadership, and lead its evolution into a scalable, system-based architecture

•
Serve as the functional and technical owner of the financial planning platform (e.g. evaluating EPM tools), leading design, implementation, enhancement, administration, and team enablement

•
Own the planning systems roadmap end-to-end, including prioritization, UAT, governance, and change management

•
Drive finance transformation projects that improve automation, standardization, and simplicity across planning and reporting workflows, including embedding AI where it raises analytical quality and reduces manual effort

•
Design data flows and integrations connecting the planning platform to the ERP, data warehouse, and BI stack, partnering with Accounting, Data Engineering, and Analytics on architecture

•
Produce executive-facing financial deliverables, including the Weekly Business Review, monthly OpEx review, and quarterly Board and Audit Committee materials, and build dashboards and reporting that surface KPIs and business insights with minimal manual assembly

•
Partner with category, marketing, and ops finance counterparts to standardize how their inputs are gathered, pressure-tested, and consolidated into a single corporate view

•
Establish best practices across systems controls, data governance, and planning process documentation

You Have

•
B.S. in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or equivalent experience

•
12+ years of progressive experience spanning strategic finance / FP&A and finance systems or finance transformation roles

•
Strong financial and business acumen, including command of P&L mechanics, budgeting, forecasting, and the consolidation mechanics behind a company-wide planning cycle

•
Hands-on experience implementing, administering, or owning an EPM / planning platform (Anaplan, Pigment, Adaptive, Planful, or similar), including model design and integrations

•
Demonstrated success leading a finance transformation initiative end-to-end, standing up or materially scaling planning systems and automated reporting, not just contributing components

•
Ability to manipulate large datasets and translate them into clear, structured, decision-ready outputs

•
Strong project management instincts, with the ability to run multiple workstreams simultaneously

•
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical audiences, from system administrators to the executive team

•
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a bias toward action in ambiguous, fast-changing environments

•
Track record of leveraging AI and automation to improve finance workflows

Nice to Have

•
Proficiency with SQL and experience with BI tools (Looker, Amplitude); NetSuite or similar ERP integration experience

•
Experience at a high-growth public company (recent IPO) or late-stage startup (Series C+) that has scaled through significant revenue and organizational growth

•
Exposure to a public company's external reporting cycle (Board, Audit Committee, earnings/guidance)

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

•
Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

•
Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

•
Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

•
Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

•
401k benefits with employer matching contribution

•
Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address.

To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement (https://www.hims.com/global-candidate-privacy-statement).
