title: Trust & Integrity Specialist
description:
About Solace (https://jobicy.com/company/solace)

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-02-10/vcs-give-solace-health-1-billion-valuation-for-patient-advocacy-tech?accessToken=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzb3VyY2UiOiJTdWJzY3JpYmVyR2lmdGVkQXJ0aWNsZSIsImlhdCI6MTc3MDczMDg4MywiZXhwIjoxNzcxMzM1NjgzLCJhcnRpY2xlSWQiOiJUQThVUzhLR0NURzEwMCIsImJjb25uZWN0SWQiOiJBRDYxODI0MTc0ODM0MTk0QTRENUZFNzkwMzNGMDJGNSJ9.TE2pFUAOQAPMUXFlzoQ7zeJvctq7cSibbZqtIwhW-2U&leadSource=uverify+wall).

About the Role

We're looking for a Trust & Integrity Specialist to protect the integrity of the patient experience and the Solace platform. Sitting within the Customer Experience team, you'll serve as a dedicated resource for identifying, investigating, and resolving situations that pose risk to the patient or advocate experience.

This role sits at the intersection of patient safety, conduct oversight, and operational risk. You'll own the review of flagged cases, monitor for emerging patterns, manage complaints with care and urgency, and ensure that the people and systems patients interact with are operating within Solace's protocols and standards. Reporting to the T&I Manager, you'll work closely with QA, operations, and internal stakeholders to maintain a trustworthy, safe, and high-quality experience for every patient we serve.

Today this work centers on advocate-facing cases; as Trust & Integrity expands, the same function will extend to other patient-facing groups (CX, physicians, and beyond).

What You'll Do

Patient Safety & Complaint Management

•
Serve as the primary point of escalation for patient safety concerns, complaints, and adverse experience reports

•
Investigate and resolve complaints in a timely, thorough, and empathetic manner, documenting findings and outcomes with precision

•
Identify when a patient situation requires urgent intervention and coordinate an appropriate response across CX and operations

•
Ensure patients feel heard and supported throughout any complaint or escalation process

Conduct & Risk Oversight

•
Review flagged reports from internal stakeholders regarding the behavior or conduct of any patient-facing individual or team

•
Assess whether conduct aligns with Solace's ethical guidelines and engagement standards, distinguishing conduct/trust issues from process-conformance issues

•
Maintain accurate, confidential records of all investigations and outcomes

Risk Monitoring & Pattern Analysis

•
Monitor patient feedback, escalation data, and operational signals to identify emerging risk patterns before they become systemic

•
Track complaint trends, root causes, and repeat issues; surface insights to CX leadership with recommended mitigations

•
Contribute to risk reporting cadences and flag high-priority issues in real time

•
Support the development of internal playbooks and response protocols for common risk scenarios

Cross-Functional Partnership

•
Act as a trusted point of contact for internal stakeholders (operations, clinical, product) who surface risk or safety concerns

•
Partner with QA to distinguish systemic quality issues from individual trust and safety incidents, ensuring each is handled appropriately

•
Contribute to policy and SOP updates that reduce risk and strengthen the patient-advocate relationship

What You Bring to the Table

•
Experience in trust and safety, patient advocacy, healthcare operations, compliance, or a related field

•
A calm, methodical approach to high-stakes or sensitive situations. You don't rattle easily and you know how to de-escalate

•
Strong investigative instincts: you ask the right questions, follow the evidence, and reach sound conclusions

•
Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to document cases clearly and handle sensitive topics with discretion

•
Familiarity with complaint management, incident review processes, or risk frameworks

•
Comfort navigating ambiguity and making judgment calls when situations don't fit neatly into a playbook

•
Collaborative by nature: you work well across functions and build trust quickly with stakeholders

•
A deep commitment to patient welfare and a clear sense of what's at stake

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com (http://ashbyhq.com). Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

I would first assess whether there is an immediate patient-safety concern and ensure the patient receives appropriate support. I would gather relevant records and accounts, document facts objectively, interview the necessary parties, and apply the established conduct standards. I would then communicate the outcome and next steps with empathy while escalating systemic or urgent findings to the appropriate stakeholders. How do you distinguish an individual trust-and-safety incident from a broader quality or process problem? I assess whether the core issue is harmful or unethical individual behavior, an isolated judgment failure, or a repeatable breakdown in process, training, tooling, or policy. I review case evidence alongside similar complaints and operational data. Individual conduct concerns require fair investigation and accountability, while recurring patterns should also result in QA, operations, or policy improvements. Describe how you would identify emerging risk patterns before they become systemic. I would maintain structured case data, including issue type, severity, involved workflow, root cause, recurrence, and resolution time. I would review this information regularly for clusters, repeated signals, and changes in severity, then combine quantitative trends with frontline feedback. For material risks, I would promptly share a concise recommendation outlining the evidence, patient impact, and proposed mitigation. How do you communicate with a patient who is distressed during an escalation? I would listen without interruption, acknowledge the impact of their experience, and explain clearly what I can do next without making unsupported promises. I would use plain, respectful language, confirm their immediate needs, and provide realistic timing and follow-up expectations. title: Trust & Integrity Manager
description:
About Solace (https://jobicy.com/company/solace)

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-02-10/vcs-give-solace-health-1-billion-valuation-for-patient-advocacy-tech?accessToken=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzb3VyY2UiOiJTdWJzY3JpYmVyR2lmdGVkQXJ0aWNsZSIsImlhdCI6MTc3MDczMDg4MywiZXhwIjoxNzcxMzM1NjgzLCJhcnRpY2xlSWQiOiJUQThVUzhLR0NURzEwMCIsImJjb25uZWN0SWQiOiJBRDYxODI0MTc0ODM0MTk0QTRENUZFNzkwMzNGMDJGNSJ9.TE2pFUAOQAPMUXFlzoQ7zeJvctq7cSibbZqtIwhW-2U&leadSource=uverify+wall).

About the Role

We're looking for a Trust & Integrity Manager to lead the function that protects the integrity of the patient experience and the Solace platform. Sitting within the Customer Experience team, you'll build and manage the team responsible for identifying, investigating, and resolving situations that pose risk to patients, advocates, or Solace's operations.

This role sits at the intersection of patient safety, advocate accountability, and operational risk. You'll own the strategy and standards for case review, oversee a team handling escalations and investigations, monitor for emerging patterns at a portfolio level, and ensure advocates are operating within Solace's protocols and standards. Reporting to CX leadership, you'll work closely with QA, operations, CX, and senior internal stakeholders to build a trustworthy, safe, and high-quality experience for every patient we serve and to scale that trust as Solace grows.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership & Development

•
Coach and manage a team of Trust & Integrity Specialists, setting clear expectations and learning paths

•
Establish and refine workflows, SLAs, and quality standards for complaint handling, investigations, and advocate oversight

•
Conduct case reviews and calibration sessions to ensure consistency and rigor across the team

•
Build a culture of empathy, precision, and accountability within the team

Patient Safety & Complaint Management

•
Own escalation paths for the most complex or high-severity patient safety concerns and adverse experience reports

•
Ensure the team investigates and resolves complaints in a timely, thorough, and empathetic manner, with clear documentation standards

•
Define criteria for urgent intervention and coordinate cross-functional response for the highest-risk situations

•
Serve as final escalation point for patients or stakeholders when a case requires manager-level judgment

Advocate Oversight & SOP Compliance

•
Uphold the process by which advocate behavior, conduct, and quality concerns are reviewed

•
Partner with QA and team leads to adjudicate cases requiring formal performance review or corrective action

•
Own the integrity and confidentiality of investigation records and reporting

•
Drive continuous improvement of SOPs and ethical guidelines based on case learnings

Risk Strategy & Pattern Analysis

•
Build and own risk monitoring practices across patient feedback, escalation data, and operational signals

•
Identify systemic risk patterns and lead root-cause analysis, translating findings into concrete mitigations

•
Own the risk reporting cadence to CX and cross-functional leadership, including prioritization of high-severity issues

•
Lead development of internal playbooks and response protocols for known and emerging risk scenarios

Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategy

•
Act as the primary point of contact and thought partner for operations, clinical, product, and legal/compliance stakeholders on trust and integrity matters

•
Partner with QA leadership to define how systemic quality issues are distinguished from individual trust and integrity incidents

•
Represent Trust & Integrity in policy and SOP development, ensuring risk considerations are built into how Solace scales

•
Contribute to org-wide risk and safety strategy as a subject matter expert

What You Bring to the Table

•
Experience managing or leading a team in trust and safety, patient advocacy, healthcare operations, compliance, or a related field

•
A track record of building or scaling processes, SOPs, or playbooks in a high-stakes environment

•
A calm, methodical approach to high-stakes or sensitive situations, with strong judgment under ambiguity

•
Strong investigative instincts and the ability to coach others to develop the same

•
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting findings and recommendations to leadership

•
Deep familiarity with complaint management, incident review processes, or risk frameworks

•
Demonstrated ability to build trust quickly across functions, including with senior stakeholders

•
A deep commitment to patient welfare and a clear sense of what's at stake

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

title: Product Manager, Radar - Fraud and Abuse Prevention
location: San Francisco, Seattle, New York, US-Remote
description:
About the team

Radar helps businesses prevent fraud and abuse without getting in the way of legitimate customers. We combine machine learning powered by Stripe’s global network with intuitive dashboard experiences and developer APIs, to give our users comprehensive controls and insights to protect their business against threats ranging from payment fraud and card testing to bot and free trial abuse.

Fraud doesn’t stand still, and it isn’t limited to checkout. As businesses launch new products and business models, attackers find new ways to exploit them. We obsess about understanding those attacks, identifying defenses that work, and making sophisticated fraud prevention simple for the businesses that depend on us to help them protect and grow their revenue with confidence.

What you’ll do

As a product manager on the Radar team, you’ll work directly with customers to understand the novel fraud and abuse attacks they face, identify the most important problems to solve, and turn those insights into product strategy and a roadmap.

You’ll work at the intersection of customers, engineering, data science, design, and commercial teams to shape what we build and bring it to market. Your work will span the fraud and abuse detection and control capabilities at the heart of Radar and the user and developer experiences that put those capabilities into our customers’ hands.

This role requires both urgency and taste. You’ll move quickly as threats evolve, without compromising on reliability, craft, or the details that make complex products feel beautifully simple.

Responsibilities

• Develop a deep understanding of the fraud and abuse landscape.

• Investigate emerging attacks with customers, assess their financial and operational impact, and distinguish isolated incidents from opportunities to build broadly useful defenses.

• Translate findings into a product strategy and roadmap, prioritizing the defenses that deliver the greatest customer and business impact.

• Partner with engineering, data science, and design to explore signals, shape solutions, and rapidly turn effective defenses into scalable, reliable products.

• Set the pace for the team by scoping the product thoughtfully, prioritizing ruthlessly, and executing with high rigor.

• Work with sales, marketing, and customer-facing teams to validate demand, coordinate launches, and help customers adopt and maximize the value they get from new capabilities.

• Own product performance, user experience, and business metrics to guide iteration and communicate progress.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 8+ years of Product Management experience

• Highly analytical, with a rigorous approach to quantitative and qualitative evidence. You’re comfortable digging into data, writing SQL when needed, and defining metrics that connect product decisions to user outcomes.

• Scrappy and resourceful, with experience taking products from zero to one. You find ways to test ideas quickly, learn from real users, and turn early solutions into products that scale.

• Strong commercial and business acumen. You understand how customer problems translate into willingness to pay, adoption, and durable business value.

• Proven cross-functional leadership, including experience partnering with B2B sales teams on customer discovery, product positioning, and adoption.

• Experience shipping Dashboard and API products, with empathy for both end users and developers and an understanding of their different workflows.

• Comfort with substantial ambiguity. You can set direction with incomplete information, make thoughtful trade-offs, and adapt as new evidence emerges.

• Technical fluency to go deep with engineering and data teams on complex systems, understand constraints, and evaluate alternative approaches.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for distilling complex customer problems into precise, actionable framing.

• An ownership mindset and a high bar for product quality. You do what it takes to solve user problems and care deeply about the details of the experience.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building fraud prevention, risk, security, or ML powered products.

• Experience developing machine learning powered products and evaluating trade-offs between detection effectiveness and customer friction.

• Experience building tools for fraud analysts or risk teams, or developer products that support real-time decisions.

• Software engineering, data science, or similar technical experience.

title: Product Manager, Radar
location: San Francisco, Seattle New York, US - Remote
description:
About the team

Radar helps businesses prevent fraud and abuse without getting in the way of legitimate customers. We combine machine learning powered by Stripe’s global network with intuitive dashboard experiences and developer APIs, to give our users comprehensive controls and insights to protect their business against threats ranging from payment fraud and card testing to bot and free trial abuse.

Fraud doesn’t stand still, and it isn’t limited to checkout. As businesses launch new products and business models, attackers find new ways to exploit them. We obsess about understanding those attacks, identifying defenses that work, and making sophisticated fraud prevention simple for the businesses that depend on us to help them protect and grow their revenue with confidence.

What you’ll do

As a product manager on the Radar team, you’ll help customers, developers, and partners bring fraud prevention naturally into the systems and workflows they rely on. You’ll shape products that make fraud management feel effortless, connecting Radar’s capabilities to the tools and experiences our users build and run.

You’ll work at the intersection of customer needs and commercial opportunities to shape what we build and how we bring it to market. Working closely with engineering, data science, design, and go-to-market teams, you’ll build products and relationships that deliver lasting value to customers and partners. You’ll connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes while maintaining a high bar for reliability, craft, and the details that make complex products feel simple.

Responsibilities

• Develop a deep understanding of the payments and fraud landscape, how businesses manage risk, and the systems and workflows they rely on.

• Work directly with customers, developers, and partners to uncover unmet needs, understand integration challenges, and identify opportunities to build broadly useful products.

• Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and roadmap, prioritizing opportunities based on user impact, technical feasibility, and business value.

• Partner closely with engineering and data science to turn sophisticated fraud control and monitoring capabilities into reliable APIs, intuitive tools, and well-crafted developer experiences.

• Drive product development from ideation through launch, setting the pace, scoping thoughtfully, prioritizing ruthlessly, and executing with rigor.

• Collaborate deeply with sales, marketing, and partnerships teams to identify opportunities, validate demand, and drive the adoption of new experiences.

• Work with customers and partners through early implementations, using hands-on feedback to improve documentation, onboarding, and the path from initial evaluation to production use.

• Own metrics for integration success, adoption, retention, revenue, and user value; use results to guide product and commercial decisions and communicate progress.

• Communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders about priorities, trade-offs, progress, and results, building alignment across teams you don’t directly manage.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 8+ years of Product Management experience

• Highly analytical, with a rigorous approach to quantitative and qualitative evidence. You’re comfortable digging into data, writing SQL when needed, and connecting product decisions to user and business outcomes.

• Scrappy and resourceful, with experience taking products from zero to one. You thrive in early-stage environments, test ideas quickly, and turn what you learn into products that scale.

• Strong commercial and business acumen. You understand how customer needs, market dynamics, and product differentiation translate into adoption and durable business value.

• Proven cross-functional leadership, including experience partnering with B2B sales teams on customer discovery, technical evaluation, and commercialization.

• Experience shipping Dashboard and API products, with empathy for end users and developers alike.

• Experience developing pricing and monetization models for B2B products.

• Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on APIs, system architecture, and integration trade-offs, and to explain those decisions clearly to customers.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for distilling complex user problems into precise, actionable framing.

• An ownership mindset and a high bar for product quality. You do what it takes to solve user problems and care deeply about the details of the experience.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building fraud prevention, risk, security, or ML powered products.

• Experience building developer platforms and working with integration partners, including navigating technical dependencies and high-stakes external relationships.

We combine machine learning powered by Stripe’s global network with intuitive dashboard experiences and developer APIs, to give our users comprehensive controls and insights to protect their business against threats ranging from payment fraud and card testing to bot and free trial abuse. Fraud doesn’t stand still, and it isn’t limited to checkout. As businesses launch new products and business models, attackers find new ways to exploit them. We obsess about understanding those attacks, identifying defenses that work, and making sophisticated fraud prevention simple for the businesses that depend on us to help them protect and grow their revenue with confidence. What you’ll do As a product manager on the Radar team, you’ll help customers, developers, and partners bring fraud prevention naturally into the systems and workflows they rely on. You’ll shape products that make fraud management feel effortless, connecting Radar’s capabilities to the tools and experiences our users build and run. You’ll work at the intersection of customer needs and commercial opportunities to shape what we build and how we bring it to market. Working closely with engineering, data science, design, and go-to-market teams, you’ll build products and relationships that deliver lasting value to customers and partners. You’ll connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes while maintaining a high bar for reliability, craft, and the details that make complex products feel simple. Responsibilities Develop a deep understanding of the payments and fraud landscape, how businesses manage risk, and the systems and workflows they rely on. Work directly with customers, developers, and partners to uncover unmet needs, understand integration challenges, and identify opportunities to build broadly useful products. Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and roadmap, prioritizing opportunities based on user impact, technical feasibility, and business value. Partner closely with engineering and data science to turn sophisticated fraud control and monitoring capabilities into reliable APIs, intuitive tools, and well-crafted developer experiences. Drive product development from ideation through launch, setting the pace, scoping thoughtfully, prioritizing ruthlessly, and executing with rigor. Collaborate deeply with sales, marketing, and partnerships teams to identify opportunities, validate demand, and drive the adoption of new experiences. Work with customers and partners through early implementations, using hands-on feedback to improve documentation, onboarding, and the path from initial evaluation to production use. Own metrics for integration success, adoption, retention, revenue, and user value; use results to guide product and commercial decisions and communicate progress. Communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders about priorities, trade-offs, progress, and results, building alignment across teams you don’t directly manage. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 8+ years of Product Management experience Highly analytical, with a rigorous approach to quantitative and qualitative evidence. You’re comfortable digging into data, writing SQL when needed, and connecting product decisions to user and business outcomes. Scrappy and resourceful, with experience taking products from zero to one. You thrive in early-stage environments, test ideas quickly, and turn what you learn into products that scale. Strong commercial and business acumen. You understand how customer needs, market dynamics, and product differentiation translate into adoption and durable business value. Proven cross-functional leadership, including experience partnering with B2B sales teams on customer discovery, technical evaluation, and commercialization. Experience shipping Dashboard and API products, with empathy for end users and developers alike. Experience developing pricing and monetization models for B2B products. Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on APIs, system architecture, and integration trade-offs, and to explain those decisions clearly to customers. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for distilling complex user problems into precise, actionable framing. An ownership mindset and a high bar for product quality. You do what it takes to solve user problems and care deeply about the details of the experience. Preferred qualifications Experience building fraud prevention, risk, security, or ML powered products. Experience building developer platforms and working with integration partners, including navigating technical dependencies and high-stakes external relationships. In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual US base salary range for this role is $178,600 - $268,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends. title: Senior Staff Data Scientist
description:
Headquarters: Remote

About the Team:

Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives customer and business outcomes.

We’re hiring a Senior Staff Data Scientist to deepen how data shapes our product and growth strategy. You’ll develop an end-to-end understanding of the PLG journey, proactively identify opportunities, and turn complex data into hypotheses, experiments, and recommendations that influence where we invest and what we build. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who can move from identifying an important question to shaping the approach, defining success, and driving toward an answer.

What You'll Do:

• Own the analytical understanding of Netlify’s PLG performance across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention, identifying opportunities before they become requests

• Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn behavioral insights into product bets, defining what to test, how to measure it, and what the results mean

• Lead experimentation from hypothesis through decision, including study design, methodology, success metrics, guardrails, analysis, and recommendations

• Apply statistical rigor where it matters while recognizing when there is enough signal to make a decision and move forward, and help teams develop that same judgment

• Build scalable analytical systems like semantic models, trusted metrics, proactive monitoring, and AI-powered agents  that surface opportunities without waiting to be asked

• Use AI to investigate faster, automate recurring analytical work, and test more hypotheses without sacrificing the judgment that makes the output useful

• Identify gaps in measurement, event instrumentation, and metric definitions, and partner with Data and Product Engineering to close them

• Serve as a trusted analytical partner to PLG leadership, using evidence and product judgment to influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities

• Influence product strategy through evidence, product instincts, and a clear point of view, without relying on formal authority to do it

What You'll Bring:

• 8+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with a track record of high ownership and measurable impact on PLG or consumer product outcomes

• Deep understanding of product and growth dynamics across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention

• Demonstrated ability to turn behavioral data into product hypotheses and carry them from insight through experimentation and measured outcomes

• Deep experimentation expertise: study design, statistical reasoning, causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment has told you what you need to know

• Experience building analytical systems such as metrics layers, monitoring frameworks, or semantic models that teams can rely on over time

• An AI-native approach to analysis: you use AI tools actively to accelerate investigation, automate repetitive work, and surface patterns faster

• A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and product direction through analytical reasoning, clear recommendations, and sound judgment

• Comfort operating with significant autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, including determining which questions are most important to answer

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in distributed environments, with the ability to make complex findings clear and recommendations actionable

This Role is a Great Fit If:

• You're energized by finding the opportunity before anyone thought to ask - proactive discovery is how you naturally work, not a mode you shift into

• You think like a product person who happens to be exceptionally rigorous with data, not a data person who occasionally weighs in on product

•  You thrive when the problem isn't handed to you - you'd rather define the question worth asking than answer the one that landed in your queue

• You get excited about building systems that keep working after you've moved on to the next problem

• You're comfortable making a call with imperfect information and can articulate clearly why you made it

• You enjoy being a thought partner to senior leaders - shaping how they think about investment and opportunity, not just supporting decisions already made

• You work well in a remote-first, async environment where written clarity and self-direction matter more than proximity

• You're drawn to roles where the measure of success is outcomes, decisions made, bets tested, metrics moved, not volume of output produced

Applying

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

When applying please include:

A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.

Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com.

About Netlify

Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable.

We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you!

At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $204,000 - $275,000 for most US-based locations.  Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-senior-staff-data-scientist

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Paoli, Pennsylvania

URL: https://duckduckgo.com

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac (https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/), Windows (https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/), iOS (https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/), and Android (https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/), our search engine (https://duckduckgo.com/), and the DuckDuckGo subscription (https://duckduckgo.com/pro). We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai (https://duck.ai/), which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

Our culture (https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work) of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Backend Functional Team, you'll lead complex projects across key company-wide objectives. Using Perl (Version 5), Go, and Node.js, you’ll write pragmatic, performant, testable code that works consistently, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

•
Implementing AI-assisted answers and integrating them into our Search product while maintaining our privacy-first approach

•
Delivering improvements to Duck.ai to help us make it a competitive AI chat alternative for both free and paying users

•
Implementing sophisticated data processing pipelines that maintain search relevancy

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll collaborate remotely with your peers and take responsibility for solving product issues impacting our all-in-one privacy solution, whether large or small. In time, you'll formally mentor other engineers, supporting their career growth and the growth of the Backend Team at DuckDuckGo.

About You

•
7+ years of professional experience, primarily focused on backend systems that power consumer-facing products

•
Product acumen to reason about technical tradeoffs in terms of user impact

•
Familiarity with AI agent tooling: evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines and prompt engineering

•
A fundamental understanding of complex data structures and algorithms — you can develop and apply new solutions and confidently navigate and improve existing code.

•
Data-driven analytical skills for decision-making, stakeholder alignment, and experiment-oriented delivery

•
Solid project management abilities

•
Excellent written and verbal communication to validate and articulate decisions

•
Previous experience leading and mentoring experienced engineers, supporting their career goals, and unlocking their potential.

Compensation

This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:

•
United States: $190,500 USD annually

•
United Kingdom: £134,600 GBP annually

•
Canada: C$253,500 CAD annually

•
Europe/Rest of World: €157,350 EUR annually

In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

OurTeam Member Support Guide (https://duckduckgo.com/assets/hiring/team_support_guide.pdf) explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire (https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-hire).

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.

Please note that:

•
You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

•
Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

•
While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

•
A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

•
By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles:

•
Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy (https://duckduckgo.com/static-assets/files/pages/careers/DuckDuckGo-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-effective-September-30-2025.pdf). We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

•
Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

•
Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at careers@duckduckgo.com. Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

title: Director of Product Marketing
description:
Proof (https://jobicy.com/company/notarize) is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof operates identity infrastructure for high-consequence transactions. Built on a WebTrust-audited certificate authority and PKI-anchored verifiable credentials, Proof helps more than 8,000 businesses, from financial institutions and mortgage lenders to insurers and wealth managers, verify who is on the other side of a transaction. Having created the online notarization category, we're now extending into portable digital identity with our Verifiable Digital Credential (VDC) for banks, and into authorization for AI agents.

As Director of Product Marketing, you'll turn that technical foundation into positioning that a bank's Chief Risk Officer, head of digital, and compliance team all understand and act on. Day to day, you'll work across Product, Sales, and Marketing to shape messaging, lead launches, equip Sales to win, and make sure the market sees Proof as the trusted identity layer. You'll also lead and develop the product marketing function, starting with the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager.

What you’ll do as the Director of Product Marketing at Proof:

• Positioning and messaging: Own product and solution positioning and the messaging architecture (value propositions, proof points, and differentiation) across the VDC, identity verification, eSign/eNotary, and agentic authorization, tailored by segment (banking, mortgage, insurance, wealth) and buyer persona.

• Launches and go-to-market: Run the launch process for new products and major features, from tiering and readiness through announcement, enablement, an post-launch measurement. Shape use-case plays such as account opening, high-value money movement, title and closing, and agent-initiated transactions with Revenue Marketing and Sales.

• Sales enablement: Build and maintain the core sales toolkit, including pitch decks, solution briefs, discovery guides, business-case and ROI tools, objection handling, and demo narratives. Run ongoing enablement for Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and partners.

• Market and competitive insight: Lead win/loss analysis, customer interviews, persona and buying-committee research, and competitive intelligence across identity verification, digital credentials, eSignature, and fraud prevention vendors, including maintained battlecards.

• Product partnership: Partner with Product on pricing, packaging, and roadmap priorities. Track regulatory developments (CIP/KYC, digital identity, and eNotary legislation) and translate them into market opportunities and messaging.

• Cross-functional content: Supply product and roadmap content for analyst briefings (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, Liminal, Celent, Datos Insights) with the Director of Communications, and product inputs for demand programs, content, and events.

• Team leadership: Manage and develop the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager and grow the product marketing team over time, so that product, partner, and customer messaging stay aligned.

What we're looking for:

• 10+ years of B2B product marketing experience at a SaaS, fintech, identity, security, or infrastructure company, including 3+ years leading product marketing teams and launches end to end

• Experience marketing technical or API-driven products to regulated enterprise buyers, ideally financial institutions.

• A record of creating positioning for a new or emerging category, with launches that measurably improved pipeline and win rates.

• Enough technical fluency to understand PKI, cryptographic credentials, identity verification, and fraud concepts, and to explain them simply and accurately.

• Excellent writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage executives, customers, and analysts.

You’ll really stand out if you have:

• Familiarity with digital identity standards (W3C Verifiable Credentials, ISO mDL, NIST 800-63) or KYC/AML compliance.

• Experience marketing AI or agentic products and the trust and authorization questions they raise.

• Experience with developer- or platform-led motions alongside enterprise sales.

Position logistics:

Travel: This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process.

Our Proof Pillars:

• Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.

• Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.

• Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.

• Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

Here are some of our great benefits:

• Medical, dental, and vision benefits

• Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage

• 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date

• Unlimited Sick and Vacation time

• 14 paid company holidays

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment

• Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation

• Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit

• Monthly work from home stipend

• Professional development credit

• Monthly reimbursement for Wellness

• And more!

Compensation

This is the expected total cash compensation range for this position. The salary offered within this range will be determined based on factors including but not limited to skills, qualifications, experience and location. The total compensation package for this role includes base pay, discretionary bonus typically paid annually, the benefits listed above, and equity.

summary:
Proof (https://jobicy.com/company/notarize) is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof operates identity infrastructure for high-consequence transactions. Built on a WebTrust-audited certificate authority and PKI-anchored verifiable credentials, Proof helps more than 8,000 businesses, from financial institutions and mortgage lenders to insurers and wealth managers, verify who is on the other side of a transaction. Having created the online notarization category, we're now extending into portable digital identity with our Verifiable Digital Credential (VDC) for banks, and into authorization for AI agents.

As Director of Product Marketing, you'll turn that technical foundation into positioning that a bank's Chief Risk Officer, head of digital, and compliance team all understand and act on. Day to day, you'll work across Product, Sales, and Marketing to shape messaging, lead launches, equip Sales to win, and make sure the market sees Proof as the trusted identity layer. You'll also lead and develop the product marketing function, starting with the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager.

What you’ll do as the Director of Product Marketing at Proof:

• Positioning and messaging: Own product and solution positioning and the messaging architecture (value propositions, proof points, and differentiation) across the VDC, identity verification, eSign/eNotary, and agentic authorization, tailored by segment (banking, mortgage, insurance, wealth) and buyer persona.

• Launches and go-to-market: Run the launch process for new products and major features, from tiering and readiness through announcement, enablement, an post-launch measurement. Shape use-case plays such as account opening, high-value money movement, title and closing, and agent-initiated transactions with Revenue Marketing and Sales.

• Sales enablement: Build and maintain the core sales toolkit, including pitch decks, solution briefs, discovery guides, business-case and ROI tools, objection handling, and demo narratives. Run ongoing enablement for Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and partners.

• Market and competitive insight: Lead win/loss analysis, customer interviews, persona and buying-committee research, and competitive intelligence across identity verification, digital credentials, eSignature, and fraud prevention vendors, including maintained battlecards.

• Product partnership: Partner with Product on pricing, packaging, and roadmap priorities. Track regulatory developments (CIP/KYC, digital identity, and eNotary legislation) and translate them into market opportunities and messaging.

• Cross-functional content: Supply product and roadmap content for analyst briefings (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, Liminal, Celent, Datos Insights) with the Director of Communications, and product inputs for demand programs, content, and events.

• Team leadership: Manage and develop the Partner & Customer Marketing Manager and grow the product marketing team over time, so that product, partner, and customer messaging stay aligned.

What we're looking for:

• 10+ years of B2B product marketing experience at a SaaS, fintech, identity, security, or infrastructure company, including 3+ years leading product marketing teams and launches end to end

• Experience marketing technical or API-driven products to regulated enterprise buyers, ideally financial institutions.

• A record of creating positioning for a new or emerging category, with launches that measurably improved pipeline and win rates.

• Enough technical fluency to understand PKI, cryptographic credentials, identity verification, and fraud concepts, and to explain them simply and accurately.

• Excellent writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage executives, customers, and analysts.

You’ll really stand out if you have:

• Familiarity with digital identity standards (W3C Verifiable Credentials, ISO mDL, NIST 800-63) or KYC/AML compliance.

• Experience marketing AI or agentic products and the trust and authorization questions they raise.

• Experience with developer- or platform-led motions alongside enterprise sales.

Position logistics:

Travel: This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process.

Our Proof Pillars:

• Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.

• Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.

• Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.

• Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

Here are some of our great benefits:

• Medical, dental, and vision benefits

• Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage

• 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date

• Unlimited Sick and Vacation time

• 14 paid company holidays

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment

• Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation

• Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit

• Monthly work from home stipend

• Professional development credit

• Monthly reimbursement for Wellness

• And more!

Compensation

This is the expected total cash compensation range for this position. The salary offered within this range will be determined based on factors including but not limited to skills, qualifications, experience and location. The total compensation package for this role includes base pay, discretionary bonus typically paid annually, the benefits listed above, and equity.

title: Director of Brand and Creative
description:
Proof (https://jobicy.com/company/notarize) is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof's brand has to signal two things at once: the rigor of a WebTrust-audited certificate authority that banks can rely on, and the simplicity of an identity people can verify once and reuse anywhere. As Proof expands from the online notarization category we created into portable digital identity and agentic authorization, our brand needs to grow with us.

As Director of Brand and Creative, you'll own Proof's brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, and creative output across every touchpoint, including proof.com, campaigns, events, sales materials, and executive presence. Day to day, you'll set creative direction, lead design production, and build a brand that earns trust from regulated institutions and stands out in identity and fintech.

What you’ll do as the Director of Brand and Creative at Proof:

• Brand strategy and architecture: Define and steward Proof's brand platform (purpose, personality, voice, and the promise of trust in high-consequence transactions), and develop brand architecture for the platform, VDC, notarization, and agentic authorization with the Director of Product Marketing. Lead brand evolution or refresh work as needed.

• Visual and verbal identity: Own the brand system and guidelines, including logo, color, typography, iconography, illustration, photography, motion, and data visualization. Partner with the Head of Demand Content and Director of Communications on tone-of-voice guidelines.

• Brand hub and templates: Build a self-serve brand hub and template library so Sales,
Marketing, and the wider company stay on brand.

• Campaign and launch creative: Lead creative concepting and execution for
campaigns, product launches, and brand moments with Revenue Marketing and Product Marketing.

• Design across touchpoints: Oversee design for proof.com, digital advertising, sales collateral, presentations, video, social, and event environments, including booth and experiential design with the Event Marketing Manager.

• Creative operations: Run intake, prioritization, and review and approval workflows, and manage creative budgets, agencies, and freelancers.

• Brand health and governance: Establish brand health metrics and research
(awareness, consideration, perception among target buyers), govern consistency across marketing, sales, partners, and co-marketing, and work with Product Design so the product and marketing brand feel like one company.

What we're looking for:

• 10+ years in brand and creative, including 4+ years leading brand or creative teams at a B2B technology, fintech, or security company, or senior agency experience on comparable brands.

• A portfolio showing brand systems and campaigns that made complex or trust-centric products clear and distinctive.

• Experience leading a brand refresh or new brand architecture during a company's category expansion.

• Strong creative direction across design, copy, video, and motion, and the ability to get hands-on when needed.

• Ability to align executives on creative decisions and explain the business rationale behind brand choices.

You'll really stand out if you have:

• Experience building brands for financial services, payments, or identity companies.

summary:
Proof (https://jobicy.com/company/notarize) is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!

Proof's brand has to signal two things at once: the rigor of a WebTrust-audited certificate authority that banks can rely on, and the simplicity of an identity people can verify once and reuse anywhere. As Proof expands from the online notarization category we created into portable digital identity and agentic authorization, our brand needs to grow with us.

Day to day, you'll set creative direction, lead design production, and build a brand that earns trust from regulated institutions and stands out in identity and fintech.

What you’ll do as the Director of Brand and Creative at Proof:

• Brand strategy and architecture: Define and steward Proof's brand platform (purpose, personality, voice, and the promise of trust in high-consequence transactions), and develop brand architecture for the platform, VDC, notarization, and agentic authorization with the Director of Product Marketing. Lead brand evolution or refresh work as needed.

• Visual and verbal identity: Own the brand system and guidelines, including logo, color, typography, iconography, illustration, photography, motion, and data visualization. Partner with the Head of Demand Content and Director of Communications on tone-of-voice guidelines.

Marketing, and the wider company stay on brand.

• Campaign and launch creative: Lead creative concepting and execution for
campaigns, product launches, and brand moments with Revenue Marketing and Product Marketing.

• Design across touchpoints: Oversee design for proof.com, digital advertising, sales collateral, presentations, video, social, and event environments, including booth and experiential design with the Event Marketing Manager.

• Creative operations: Run intake, prioritization, and review and approval workflows, and manage creative budgets, agencies, and freelancers.

• Brand health and governance: Establish brand health metrics and research
(awareness, consideration, perception among target buyers), govern consistency across marketing, sales, partners, and co-marketing, and work with Product Design so the product and marketing brand feel like one company.

• 10+ years in brand and creative, including 4+ years leading brand or creative teams at a B2B technology, fintech, or security company, or senior agency experience on comparable brands.

• Experience leading a brand refresh or new brand architecture during a company's category expansion.

• Strong creative direction across design, copy, video, and motion, and the ability to get hands-on when needed.

• Ability to align executives on creative decisions and explain the business rationale behind brand choices.

title: Strategic Core Account Executive
description:
SLSQ427R1034

Candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role:

• Remote - Washington D.C.

As a Enterprise Account Executive at Databricks, you are a sales professional experienced in leading go-to-market campaigns in Fortune 500 accounts, specificlaly in the TELCO space. You know how to sell innovation and change through customer vision expansion and can guide deals forward to compress decision cycles. You love understanding a product in depth and are passionate about communicating value to Customers and System Integrators.

Databricks operates at the leading edge of the Unified Data Analytics and AI space. Our customers turn to us to lead the accelerated innovation that their businesses need to gain first mover advantage in today’s ultra-competitive landscape. As we continue our rapid expansion, we are looking for a creative, execution-oriented Enterprise Account Executive to join the Databricks team and maximize the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for Databricks.

Reporting to our Director of Enterprise Sales, you will map to enterprise clients under the CMEG umbrella (Telco orgs).  You will come with an informed point of view on Big Data, Advanced Analytics and AI which will help to guide your successful execution strategy and allow you to provide genuine value to the client

The impact you will have:

• Build relationships with CIOs, IT executives, LOB executives, Program Managers, and other important partners.

• Drive value-based growth within the account.

• Expand the Databricks footprint into new business units and use cases.

• Exceed activity, pipeline, and revenue targets.

• Track all customer details including use case, purchase time frames, next steps, and forecasting in Salesforce.

• Use a solution-based approach to selling and creating value for customers.

• Promote Databricks' Data Intelligence Platform powered by Apache Spark™ and Delta Lake

• Prioritize opportunities and leverage appropriate resources.

• Build a plan for success internally at Databricks and externally with your account

What we look for:

• You have previously excelled in an early-stage company -- you know how to navigate and be successful with limited oversight

• Previous field sales experience within big data, Cloud, SaaS, and a consumption selling motion

• Prior customer relationships with CIOs, program managers, and essential decision makers at local accounts

• The ability to simplify a technical capability into a value-based benefit

• 7+ years of Enterprise Sales experience exceeding quotas in larger accounts

• Managing a small set of enterprise accounts rather than a broad territory

• Bachelor's Degree

title: Enterprise Account Manager, SLED
description:
Headquarters: Remote Chicago, IL | Remote Detroit, MI | Remote Columbus, OH | Remote Indianapolis, IN

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

Identify, generate, qualify, and close new business for customers and prospects in a defined territory.  Responsible for managing the full sales lifecycle, building the go-to-market plan (including direct and indirect business).

LOCATION: This is a remote role but due to accounts/territory covered candidates need to reside in the Great Lakes region (IL, MI, OH, IN, WI) ideally near an airport for ease of travel.

Customer Segment: Higher Education (Public Sector)

What You’ll Do

• Develop new and existing accounts within defined territory. Prior SLED experience required.

• Establish and deliver a sales strategy which outlines a roadmap to quota attainment

• Sales forecasting, lead generation, prospecting, and strategic relationship development

• Upsell ‘New Product’ to existing customers.

• Work with assigned Account Executive – Enterprise Assist’s to intelligently cover and proactively hunt for Add-on opportunity within territory.

• Maintain whitespace for all focus customers.

• Partner closely with Vice President, SE’s, PM’s and wider POD to deliver strategic goals

• Algin with Channel team and Channel Partners to deliver value to our customers and BeyondTrust wherever possible

• Align with SDR team to proactively cover your total addressable market (focus and non-focus territory accounts)

• Attend corporate trade shows and events

• Maintain sales pipeline activity in Salesforce

• Schedule and conduct product demonstrations and detailed presentations to prospects, customers and partners

• Lead RFP responses for your accounts

What You’ll Bring

• Must be located in the territory covered

• Bachelor’s degree

• 8+ years’ sales experience with a demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual quota

• Experience with enterprise software, IT services, SaaS, IoT or related managed services sales to global organizations

• Experience with Salesforce

• Able to command sales message and sale

• Experience leveraging the channel to drive business

• Excellent communication skills

• Ability to travel within region

Nice To Have

• Prior experience selling PAM software solutions

• Completed 2 professional sales training courses (Sandler, SPIN, DISC, TAS, or Miller)

• Strategic Account Management

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com (http://www.beyondtrust.com/).

#LI-JC1

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/beyondtrust-enterprise-account-manager-sled-1

title: Enterprise Account Manager, SLED
description:
Headquarters: Remote South Carolina | Remote North Carolina | Remote Tennessee

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

Identify, generate, qualify, and close new business for customers and prospects in a defined territory.  Responsible for managing the full sales lifecycle, building the go-to-market plan (including direct and indirect business).  Territories you will be managing are: North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee for State and Local government entities.

What You’ll Do

• Develop new and existing local and state accounts within defined territory.

• Establish and deliver a sales strategy which outlines a roadmap to quota attainment

• Sales forecasting, lead generation, prospecting, and strategic relationship development

• Upsell ‘New Product’ to existing customers.

• Work with assigned Account Executive – Enterprise Assist’s to intelligently cover and proactively hunt for Add-on opportunity within territory.

• Maintain whitespace for all focus customers.

• Partner closely with Vice President, SE’s, PM’s and wider POD to deliver strategic goals

• Algin with Channel team and Channel Partners to deliver value to our customers and BeyondTrust wherever possible

• Align with SDR team to proactively cover your total addressable market (focus and non-focus territory accounts)

• Attend corporate trade shows and events

• Maintain sales pipeline activity in Salesforce

• Schedule and conduct product demonstrations and detailed presentations to prospects, customers and partners

• Lead RFP responses for your accounts

What You’ll Bring

• Must be located in the territory - Tennessee or South Carolina

• Bachelor’s degree

• 8+ years’ sales experience with a demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual quota

• Experience with enterprise software, IT services, SaaS, IoT or related managed services sales to global organizations

• Experience with Salesforce

• Able to command sales message and sale process

• Experience leveraging the channel to drive business

• Excellent communication skills

• Ability to travel within region regularly

Nice To Have

• Prior experience selling PAM software solutions

• Completed 2 professional sales training courses (Sandler, SPIN, DISC, TAS, or Miller)

• Strategic Account Management

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com (http://www.beyondtrust.com/).

#LI-JC1
