URL: https://www.trmlabs.com/

About the Role

When a protocol is drained, or an exchange is compromised, our customers need to know within minutes or hours which addresses to block and where the funds are going. You will own TRM's answer to that, end-to-end.

As a Senior / Staff Threat Intelligence Analyst, you will lead TRM's hacks category: the metrics, the system that hits them, and the small contractor team that keeps it running around the clock. We align on the outcome; the approach is yours.

The impact you will have

•
Take command when a big hack breaks and act as a leader. Run the response: triage, coordination across teams, internal and customer communications, and the incident report afterwards.

•
Get every major hack into TRM fast. Make sure every major hack is visible to customers within hours of the first credible public report, around the clock.

•
Keep TRM's hack data complete and accurate. Every hack, at any size, is recorded with its entity, theft addresses, date, amount, and hack type.

•
Follow the money at scale. Design the system, with our Data Science and engineering teams, that carries hack-specific attribution downstream as stolen funds move.

•
Build the machine with AI. Leverage AI to build the tools and agents to automate key parts of hacks analysis and response, while ensuring human quality control over every output.

•
Explain how it happened. Root-cause the most important hacks and publish best-in-industry technical analysis that makes TRM the first source cited.

•
See the next one coming. Build approaches that spot vulnerable contracts before they are exploited, and get them into our product.

What we're looking for

•
5+ years of professional experience in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, cyber threat intelligence, incident response, or a closely related field.

•
Has owned incident response in a high-stakes environment (exchange, security firm, incident response, or CTI team): war rooms, incident reports, communications under pressure.

•
Strong blockchain tracing across major chains (BTC, EVM, TRON, Solana), including bridges, cross-chain swaps, and mixers.

•
Understands how DeFi, bridge, and exchange exploits work, and how attackers behave after the theft.

•
Applied AI fluency. We expect you to already be building AI-assisted or agentic workflows in your daily analytical work, to be able to show how you validate their outputs and where they fail, and to treat AI as a force multiplier.

•
Experience managing contractors or leading a small team.

•
Writes and briefs clearly, from technical deep-dives to executive summaries.

•
Hands-on and highly accountable: does the hardest work, not only coordinates it.

Nice to have

•
Smart-contract reverse-engineering (Solidity).

•
Experience at a security auditor or blockchain analytics firm.

•
Experience following specific well-known hacker groups.

About the Team

The hacks function sits within TRM's Primary Intelligence organization, alongside the Facilitation & Money Laundering (F&ML) pod. You will work closely with the Nation States, Cyber Threat Intelligence, and Global Investigations teams, as well as with Data Science and Engineering on automation, and with Marketing on publications.

Team Operating Rhythms

•
Monthly metrics review with your manager.

•
Weekly operating sync with your team.

•
Regular syncs with your team across time zones.

•
A war room, run by you, whenever a major hack breaks.

•
On-call responsibilities

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

•
Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

•
Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

•
First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

•
Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

•
References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

•
Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

•
Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

•
Accelerate repeatable workflows

•
Structure and solve problems

•
Improve output quality

•
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

•
Priorities and targets to change quickly

•
Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

•
A high level of personal ownership and accountability

•
Close collaboration across teams and functions

•
Frequent, high-touch communication

•
Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

•
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

•
Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

•
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

•
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote

About the Team

Netlify is a product-led growth company, and Revenue Operations owns the systems, data, and infrastructure that turn that growth into revenue.  With a large volume of people discovering and signing up for Netlify every day, Marketing Operations is critical to understanding those users, connecting activity across our systems, and creating scalable ways to engage them throughout their journey.

As Senior Marketing Operations Manager, you’ll own the operational foundation behind that work. You’ll connect HubSpot, Salesforce, product data, and analytics, build the systems and lifecycle infrastructure that turn signals into action, and give Marketing and our GTM partners trusted visibility into performance. Reporting to the Senior Director of Revenue Operations, you’ll translate the Marketing Operations vision into a roadmap and independently drive it forward while partnering closely with Growth, RevOps, Data, Product, and other GTM teams.

What You’ll Do

• Execute on the Marketing Operations roadmap, translating broader Marketing and GTM priorities into scalable systems, processes, and programs.

• Own our marketing automation platform end to end, including workflows, lifecycle stages, segmentation, forms, lists, email operations, data hygiene, deliverability, governance, and documentation.

• Build and maintain the connection between marketing automation, Salesforce, product data, and analytics so we can understand and engage users throughout the customer journey.

• Establish reliable attribution and measurement across marketing and product-led journeys, including UTM governance and connections between campaigns, signups, activation, conversion, and revenue.

• Build reporting and self-service dashboards that give Marketing and GTM partners a trusted view of performance and support weekly, monthly, and executive-level decision-making.

• Partner with Growth to operationalize lifecycle programs across email, in-product experiences, and sales-assist triggers, turning customer and product signals into scalable journeys from signup through activation and conversion.

• Build experimentation infrastructure that allows marketers to launch, measure, and learn from tests without requiring engineering support for every experiment.

• Own the operational health of the MarTech stack, including integrations, data flows, governance, vendor relationships, and periodic assessments of what we should keep, retire, consolidate, or integrate.

• Establish scalable practices for high-volume email operations, including audience management, domain and inbox health, deliverability, and safeguards that protect the customer experience.

• Turn large and sometimes ambiguous datasets into actionable recommendations, identifying points of friction or drop-off and partnering with Marketing, Growth, Product, Data, and RevOps on opportunities to improve conversion.

• Own the Marketing Operations portion of the broader Marketing budget and evaluate technology investments based on business value, scalability, and ROI.

• Explore emerging capabilities in AI-enabled marketing operations and AI visibility measurement, helping the team establish useful workflows and baselines as the space develops.

What You’ll Bring

• 7+ years of experience in Marketing Operations or a closely related discipline, with experience operating independently in a complex B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment.

• Deep experience with marketing automation platforms and CRM systems such as HubSpot, Marketo, Eloqua, and Salesforce, including lifecycle stages, campaign architecture, attribution, lead or account routing, and data governance.

• Experience working with high-volume customer or prospect datasets and designing segmentation, lifecycle, and operational approaches that remain reliable at scale.

• Significant experience operating high-volume email programs, with a practical understanding of deliverability, domain and inbox reputation, audience management, warming strategies, and the risks that emerge at large sending volumes.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate complex datasets, identify meaningful patterns, question the quality of the underlying data, and turn findings into recommendations.

• Experience building or operating lifecycle, nurture, or in-product engagement programs tied to measurable activation or conversion outcomes.

• Systems thinking and experience designing integrations across marketing automation, CRM, product, analytics, and data systems.

• Experience building measurement and experimentation infrastructure that enables other teams to operate and learn independently.

• Strong GTM fluency and an understanding of how Marketing Operations, Growth, Sales, RevOps, Product, and Customer Success connect to customer experience and revenue.

• Comfort using AI-enabled tools and workflows to accelerate your work while applying judgment to validate outputs and determine where automation is (and isn’t) appropriate.

• Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Amplitude and experience with emerging AEO or AI-visibility tooling is helpful.

• Experience working with contractors, agencies, or distributed partners is helpful but not required.

• Familiarity with developer tools, web platforms, or another high-volume PLG business is useful, but we value relevant operating experience over category-specific expertise.

This Role Is a Great Fit If

• You enjoy building the foundation, not just operating what someone else has already built. You’re energized by taking an imperfect system and creating something scalable, measurable, and trusted.

• You’re comfortable moving between architecture and execution. You can define how a system should work and then get into the details yourself when necessary to make it work.

• You thrive with significant autonomy. Given a goal and context, you investigate the problem, weigh tradeoffs, make a recommendation, and drive the work forward without needing a detailed playbook.

title: (Solidity / Rust) – Remote
description:
Headquarters: Miami

URL: https://moonshot.com

Smart Contract Engineer — Moonshot
Remote · $150K + equity

About Moonshot
Moonshot makes trading simple. Our mobile-first app gives more than 2 million users access to the latest tokens, tokenized stocks, and leverage trading, with over $4B in volume processed since launch in 2024. Every trade, auto-sell, and fee flow runs on-chain, and the contracts behind them have to be fast, safe, and correct.

The Role
You’ll own the on-chain programs that power Moonshot’s trading products on Solana and EVM chains. You’ll take each contract from spec through audit to production, and help design how we expand to new chains and products. We’re a small team, so you’ll join early and ship real code fast. Expect your first production deployment within your first two weeks.

What You’ll Do

Own core trading programs, including order execution, auto-sell, fee routing, and token launch, from specification to deployment and audit
Design cross-chain and settlement paths alongside our protocol engineers
Build and maintain a thorough test suite using Anchor tests, Foundry, and property-based fuzzing
Work directly with our security auditors on each release cycle

You Might Be a Fit If You

Have shipped production programs on Solana (Anchor) or an EVM L2, ideally securing more than $10M in TVL or volume
Can debug at the bytecode level when something breaks at 2 a.m.
Value the unglamorous work: testing, fuzzing, formal verification, and audits
Have delivered at least one end-to-end cross-chain integration (bridges, oracles, or settlement)
Understand trading mechanics such as slippage, MEV, and transaction ordering on Solana

Compensation & Benefits

$150K base salary plus meaningful early-stage equity
Full health, dental, and vision coverage (US-based hires)
$2,000 annual learning budget

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/moonshot-solidity-rust-remote

title: Marketing Automation Manager - Canada, Spain, India
description:
Headquarters: Remote

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

Storyblok is hiring a Marketing Automation Manager to own the top of funnel systems and the campaigns that run through them: Pardot, the forms on the Storyblok website, list uploads, Clay, and the nurture programs, sequences and webinar flows built in Pardot. The role sends the campaigns, loads the lists and builds the forms day to day, and turns that repeat work into templates and automations so more of the week goes to lead scoring, routing, data quality and reporting. Sitting within Revenue Operations, this role works across Demand Generation, Events, Content, Partner Marketing, Sales Development, Sales Operations and Analytics, in a lean data team where the person pulls their own numbers and builds their own reports.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Campaign operations

• Build and send list emails and sequences in Pardot and Knak: webinar invites and follow ups, quarterly enterprise and marketer sequences, review asks, partner and event emails.

• Build and run the nurture programs in Engagement Studio (welcome, post webinar, gated content, re-engagement), each by segment and lifecycle stage, and rebuild them as results come in.

• Set up webinars end to end: registration form, Zuddl to Pardot sync, campaign IDs, reminders and follow up. Build form handlers, autoresponders and landing page forms on the Storyblok website.

• Load lead lists from events, content syndication and paid social with the right campaign, source and consent, and run the request board: intake, SLA, QA before launch.

• Run optimization: Test subject lines, send times and content on every sequence, and personalise by segment, industry and stage.

• Marketing systems and integrations

• Administer Pardot and its Salesforce sync: users, connectors, field mapping, campaign member status.

• Own the links between Pardot, Salesforce, the website, Zuddl, Knak, Meta and Google Ads, and keep them documented.

• Run Clay: enrichment waterfalls, list building, and the signal tables that feed BDR routing.

• Evaluate, buy and renew the marketing tools.

• Lead flow, scoring and routing operations

• Own lead scoring and grading, reviewed each quarter against what converts.

• Own lifecycle stages (MQL, SAL, SQL) and the handoff rules to BDRs and AEs.

• Bring self serve signups and product usage into scoring and lifecycle, so PLG and enterprise leads run through 1 flow.

• Data quality and reporting

• Own the sync between the warehouse, Pardot and Salesforce in both directions: enrichment and usage in, campaign results out.

• Keep the database clean: dedupe, normalise country, industry and title, suppression lists, GDPR consent by region.

• Own the campaign taxonomy and UTM standard across the team and agencies.

• Write your own SQL and Salesforce reports; build the funnel and pipeline by source reports in the BI tool. Watch deliverability: domain health, bounce and spam rates.

• Automation, process and cadence

• Template the repeat request types (list uploads, list emails, form handlers, webinar setups), then automate them with Clay, LLM tools (Claude) and a workflow builder such as n8n or Zapier, each with QA and a fallback.

• Write the playbooks and train marketers to self serve where it is safe.

• Own and report monthly on speed to lead, MQL to SQL and form to meeting rates, request turnaround and share automated, database coverage and accuracy, and email deliverability and engagement.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 4+ years in marketing operations or marketing automation, ideally in B2B SaaS.

• Pardot administration: Salesforce connector, Engagement Studio, form handlers, campaign sync. Salesforce fluency: campaigns, lead and contact fields, reports and dashboards.

• Built nurture programs and can show what they did to conversion.

• Ran a request queue at volume and cut the time per request with templates and automation; shipped automations with a workflow builder and LLM tools and kept them running.

• Lead scoring, lifecycle and routing experience, with results.

• Working SQL, and hands on with an enrichment tool such as Clay, ZoomInfo or Apollo.

• Knowledge of GDPR and consent management across regions.

• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES

• Operating discipline: runs a high volume request queue on an SLA with QA before every launch.

• Systems thinking: sees how Pardot, Salesforce, the website, Clay and the warehouse connect, and keeps the data flowing cleanly between them.

• Data fluency: pulls own numbers, defines fields and builds reports without an analyst in between.

• Automation mindset: templates repeat work, then builds the automation that removes it.

• Attention to detail: a wrong list or a broken form reaches thousands of people.

• Testing habit: runs tests on every sequence and changes the program based on results.

• Cross-functional coordination: aligns Demand Gen, Events, Content, Partner Marketing, Sales Development and Sales Ops around 1 lead flow.

• Communication: writes clear playbooks and guidance that marketers follow without a meeting.

Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. title: Head of Member Growth (B2B2C)
description:
Headquarters: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)

Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:

• TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)

• Fortune Change the World (2024)

• CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)

• Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)

• Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)

• Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)

• Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the Role:

Maven is looking for a Head of Member Growth to own one of the most important numbers in the company: enrollments. This role is directly accountable for driving member enrollment into Maven's programs across our core business — and, by extension, the revenue those enrollments generate. You will own the enrollment engine end to end, from awareness through activation, turning eligible lives into engaged members.

Enrollment is not a single-team problem. It sits at the intersection of nearly every function at Maven, and this role is built for someone who thrives there. You'll partner daily with Client Success (who own the client relationships that unlock eligible populations), Marketing (member acquisition and lifecycle), Product (enrollment experience and funnel), Finance (targets, forecasting, and unit economics), Data (measurement, segmentation, and attribution), and Clinical and Operations teams. Because so many teams touch enrollment, a core part of the job is holding those cross-functional partners accountable to their piece of the machine — the engine only works when every team delivers its part.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead a small, high-caliber team while remaining deeply hands-on yourself every day. Although it carries a Senior Director title, it is explicitly NOT a leaned-out management position for someone who wants to direct a team from a distance. This is a hard requirement: the person in this seat reads the data themselves, pressure-tests the funnel, drafts the plan, and does the work alongside the team. We are looking for a builder and operator who also develops people — not a manager who has stepped away from the work.

We're also looking for someone who can expand the definition of the job. A great deal of enrollment optimization work is already underway, but there is not enough strategic thinking about fundamentally new ways to drive enrollments — approaches that don't simply depend on securing permission to communicate with a client's employees. This role is expected to find and open those new avenues, not just optimize the existing ones.

What You'll Do:

• Own member growth for the Core Business: Be directly accountable for enrollment targets across Maven's core business and for the revenue those enrollments drive. Set the strategy, build the plan, and act as a control tower across all cross-functional teams driving revenue to deliver the results quarter over quarter.

• Build and run a scalable enrollment engine: Own the full journey from eligible population to enrolled, activated member — spanning client launches, member acquisition and messaging, the enrollment product experience, and re-engagement of eligible-but-not-enrolled members.

• Expand the playbook and deliver new strategies to drive sustainable member growth: Think strategically and from first principles about new ways to grow enrollments beyond today's optimization work — including partnerships and approaches that don't rely solely on permission to communicate with a client's employees. Identify, size, and open avenues that expand the team's purview and unlock new growth.

• Optimize relentlessly around data: Build and consistently iterate on the funnel, and create systems that enable quick diagnoses of opportunities. Build operational metrics that act as leading KPIs for each team contributing to enrollments and bring quantitative rigor into how teams execute against targets.

• Hold the cross-functional machine accountable: Partner daily with Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Payer, Sales, and Operations — and hold each team accountable to its operational KPIs in the enrollment process. Serve as the connective tissue that keeps every part of the engine delivering.

• Operate as a player-coach: Lead and develop a small, high-performing team while staying in the execution and details. Set the bar for rigor and hands-on execution by doing the work, coaching through it, and multiplying the team's impact rather than stepping back from it. This is a role that comes with an expectation that you directly execute on the work.

• Instrument and forecast: Partner with Data and Finance to build the measurement, segmentation, attribution, and forecasting needed to know exactly what is and isn't working, and to forecast enrollment and revenue with confidence.

What You'll Bring:

• 10+ years of experience driving growth, enrollment, acquisition, or revenue outcomes, with a track record of personally owning and hitting a number — ideally in healthcare, benefits, marketplaces, consumer subscription, or another environment with a complex funnel and multiple stakeholders.

• A hands-on player-coach. You are energized by being in the details daily — the data, the funnel, the plan, the execution — and you lead a small team as a way to multiply your own hands-on impact, not to step back from the work. This is a hard requirement for the role.

• Elite quantitative ability as a core competency. You can build and interrogate a funnel model yourself, size opportunities, design experiments, and instinctively optimize around data rather than intuition. Strong quant is non-negotiable.

• Strategic range. Beyond optimizing what exists, you can spot and pursue fundamentally new approaches to enrollment that expand the team's purview — not just incremental improvements to current channels.

• Cross-functional leadership and accountability. Proven ability to align and mobilize many teams — Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Operations — around a shared goal without direct authority over most of them, and to hold each accountable to its operational commitments.

title: Director Corporate Strategy, Ads
description:
Headquarters: New York, NY, US; Remote, US

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility (https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-life/pinflex/) to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here (https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-philosophy-on-ai-in-hiring/).

The Corporate Strategy team sits at the center of Pinterest within the Strategy & Growth organization, helping to shape and communicate the company's multi-year growth strategy. We serve as the connective tissue between key product, engineering, sales, marketing and other cross-functional teams to accelerate Pinterest innovation and business growth.

This is a rare opportunity to join a company undergoing rapid transformation in a high-impact role, working on the most critical company-wide efforts. The Director of Corporate Strategy will stand up a new team from the ground up, carving out a new muscle for Pinterest that brings clarity and alignment around the existing strategy, shapes future strategic investments and identifies net new business growth opportunities for Pinterest.

What you’ll do:

• Define the Multi-Year Advertising Strategy: Lead the 3- to 5-year strategic vision for Pinterest’s global advertising business, identifying and prioritizing the most important growth opportunities across upper-funnel brand advertising and lower-funnel performance and shopping solutions.

• Identify and Evaluate New Revenue Opportunities: Assess and prioritize opportunities for market expansion across Pinterest’s first-party and third-party advertising businesses. Partner closely with Business Development and Corporate Development to evaluate build, buy, and partner pathways.

• Lead Competitive Intelligence for the Ad Tech Landscape: Drive ongoing analysis of the competitive and industry landscape, synthesizing key market trends, competitor performance, and external benchmarks into actionable insights for senior leadership.

• Own Strategic Communications for Pinterest’s Advertising Vision: Develop compelling strategic narratives, executive presentations, and board-level materials to communicate Pinterest’s advertising strategy and key initiatives to the Head of Advertising, Chief Product Officer, and Board of Directors.

What we’re looking for:

• Data driven and highly skilled in identifying and synthesizing game-changing insights

• Excellent (verbal, written, visual) communication skills, with proven ability to develop and present compelling narratives to broad audiences

• Strong business judgment, with an owners’ mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity

• Experience in building trusted relationships and influencing senior stakeholders

• Ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization; including getting into the details to “become the expert” on an area of focus, then upleveling and clearly articulating the “so what” for others.

• Curious and knowledgeable about the ads, ecommerce, and broader technology industry

• Self-starter and excited about the prospect of building a team/function from the ground up

• Multiple years of experience in Corporate Strategy, Finance, or a comparable role in high-growth tech companies

• Proven ability with navigating a global organization structure and building strong collaborative relationships with cross-functional teams and stakeholders

• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, or equivalent experience.

Relocation Statement:

•  This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex (https://www.pinterestcareers.com/pinflex/) page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

#LI-NM4

#LI-REMOTE

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here (https://www.pinterestcareers.com/pinterest-life/).

US based applicants only

$192,929—$397,206 USD

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form (https://forms.gle/sS24D4WboEKUZMQK6) for support.

By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pinterest-director-corporate-strategy-ads

title: Director of Ad Sales - West
description:
Headquarters: Remote - California

Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

Read our blog (https://blog.duolingo.com/?utm_source=greenhouse.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=generalblog_gh_091224) to learn more.

About the role...

Join us to build Duolingo Ads, Duolingo’s direct ad business. Most learners use our free, ad‑supported app—so great ads are core to our mission. We’re hiring a Head of West Coast Sales to open and scale our West Coast region. You will set regional strategy, build and lead a high‑performing team, and own revenue outcomes across priority verticals and agency holding companies. As a player/coach, you’ll cultivate senior‑level relationships, shape pricing and packaging with leadership, and close high‑impact deals that both delight learners and drive revenue while leading a team of sellers. This is a high‑ownership, early‑stage opportunity to help define how ads show up for hundreds of millions of learners while building a repeatable, data‑driven go‑to‑market.

You will...

• Own West Coast revenue targets and forecasting; build a healthy, predictable pipeline across named accounts and agency groups, and deliver against quarterly goals.

• Develop and execute the regional go‑to‑market strategy, including territory design, vertical focus, pricing/packaging inputs, and coverage plans as we scale.

• Hire, coach, and lead a small team of sellers over time; establish operating rhythms, deal reviews, and CRM hygiene standards that improve forecast accuracy and execution.

• Build and deepen senior relationships at brands and agencies; open new logos and expand strategic accounts with clear commercial narratives that map Duolingo’s unique strengths (design, IP, native formats) to client objectives.

• Lead complex deals end‑to‑end—from prospecting and positioning through negotiation, close, renewal, and expansion—partnering tightly with Account Management and Ad Ops for flawless delivery.

• Share actionable market feedback with sales and product leadership to inform pricing, packaging, measurement, and ad experiences while protecting the learner experience.

• Operate with speed and rigor in a startup‑like environment, building repeatable sales motions, outreach cadences, and team practices that scale from 0→1 and 1→N.

You have...

• 8+ years of direct digital ad sales experience with a consistent track record of hunting, closing, and renewing in premium mobile or consumer app environments.

• Success selling video and native/custom formats and structuring innovative agreements with top‑tier advertisers and agencies.

• Proven ability to engage senior decision makers while rolling up your sleeves to build collateral, troubleshoot issues, and drive revenue personally.

• Strong understanding of ad tech and mobile app ecosystems, with skill using data to assess performance and inform pricing and packaging.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, and comfort operating with ambiguity at high velocity.

⭐  Exceptional candidates will have...

• Established relationships across West Coast brand and agency decision makers.

• Experience introducing or scaling a new ads product from 0→1 within a publisher or platform environment.

• Experience shaping regional GTM, sales process, or coverage models beyond an individual book of business.

• Familiarity partnering with Account Management and Ad Ops on native/custom programs and live‑campaign storytelling to drive renewals.

• Vertical expertise in Entertainment, Gaming, Streaming, or Tech that accelerates early traction.

The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!

Salary Range:

$183,200—$274,800 USD

Benefits: Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here (https://careers.duolingo.com/#benefits).

Job Alerts: Sign up for job alerts here (http://my.greenhouse.io/users/sign_in?job_board=duolingo).

Accommodations: We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com.

Equal Employment Opportunity: Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Fraud Warning: Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we’ll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double-check these details before sharing any information.

By applying for this position your data will be processed as per theDuolingo Applicant Privacy Notice (https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vTX9GKeRMOMA9Vtm0vfGibrYPYz8ysl0Dg8KSXgj_PxeT5ChsdnNZZWtpxu4t7xillTPGnngnKCjIbV/pub).

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/duolingo-director-of-ad-sales-west

title: Repossession Coordinator (R14323)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

As part of the Collections team, the Repossession Coordinator manages key activities across Oportun’s repossession and remarketing process, supporting members with delinquent accounts while coordinating timely, accurate actions with internal partners and third-party vendors. Success in this role means maintaining strong operational controls, clear communication, accurate account and inventory reviews, and adherence to applicable lending regulations and Oportun policies.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

• You'll provide support and guidance to members with delinquent accounts who may be eligible for repossession, ensuring clear and respectful communication throughout the process.

• You'll coordinate repossession and remarketing activities with members, internal business partners, and third-party vendors to support timely and accurate execution.

• You'll complete required account reviews, letters, scrubs, and other operational steps associated with repossession and remarketing.

• You'll monitor repossession and remarketing inventory and account status, identifying issues and escalating or routing them accurately to the appropriate partners.

• You'll communicate and collaborate effectively with business partners to resolve workflow issues and keep repossession and remarketing activities moving.

• You'll maintain current knowledge of applicable lending regulations and Oportun policies and apply them consistently in day-to-day work.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

• You're detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a regulated operational environment.

• You solve problems thoughtfully, communicate clearly with members and partners, and know when an issue needs to be escalated.

• You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward.

• You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

• You'll have 5–7 years of collections experience.

• You'll have 5–7 years of repossession experience.

• You've demonstrated strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• You communicate effectively and collaborate with members, business partners, and third-party vendors. You bring working knowledge of applicable lending regulations and the ability to follow established policies and procedures.

Nice to Have

• Bilingual communication skills.

• Experience supporting vehicle remarketing processes.

• Familiarity with tools or systems used to manage collections, repossession, remarketing, or inventory workflows.

• You've used AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to improve your own productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

US Benefits

• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

• 401(k) including company match

• Flexible PTO and Parental Leave

• Company-paid Life & Disability Insurance

• Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers.

The US hourly range for this full-time position is $24.51 - $36.77.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects a national minimum and maximum range for new hire salaries for this position.

Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range that meets your criteria during the hiring process.

Please note that the compensation range listed in this posting reflects only the base salary for this position and does not include other compensation elements or benefits. #LI-REMOTE #LI-RR1

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/.

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-repossession-coordinator-r14323

title: Principal Experience Designer - Visual Design & Design Systems
description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: https://www.workiva.com/latam/

Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system. Unify powers the components, patterns, templates, accessibility standards, and shared experiences used across Workiva’s B2B platform.

This is a dual-focus principal role. Roughly 60–70% of your time will be spent leading Unify’s visual design direction: evolving its visual language, shaping token architecture, and creating the reference designs and guidance that help teams build consistently. The remaining 30–40% will focus on high-visibility visual work for major conferences, marketing partnerships, and executive audiences. That work is not separate from the system, it’s part of the broader ecosystem of design in which Unify lives.

You will bring exceptional visual craft, strong systems thinking, and a practical point of view on how design systems need to evolve for AI-assisted design and prototyping.

What you’ll do

• Define and evolve Unify’s visual language across typography, color, spacing, iconography, motion, and brand expression.

• Partner with the components sub-team and the patterns and templates sub-team to ensure visual design is applied consistently and intentionally across every asset.

• Partner with product design, product mgmt and engineering teams to ensure product experience decisions translate faithfully from system to production.

• Maintain a scalable, semantic token architecture that supports consistent experiences across products and over time.

• Create and maintain a library of reference designs, full-screen examples that demonstrate how Unify should be applied in real product experiences.

• Own visual usage guidance and documentation that make intended use, constraints, and quality standards clear for designers, engineers, and AI-assisted workflows.

• Establish ongoing evaluation of AI-generated designs and prototypes, using what you learn to strengthen tokens, examples, and guidance before inconsistencies reach product teams.

• Lead visual design for select high-stakes moments, including major conferences, executive presentations, product vision work, and marketing partnerships.

• Coach designers and influence cross-functional partners through high-quality feedback, clear principles, and strong visual storytelling.

What you’ll need

Minimum Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in product design, visual design, UX, or related fields, including significant work on platform or enterprise products.

• Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field (or 8 years of experience and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 6 years of experience).

Preferred Qualifications

• A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and the ability to translate a visual point of view into scalable product systems.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows, with a clear perspective on their opportunities and limitations.

• Experience defining or evolving a design system’s visual language, including tokens, components, patterns, and documentation.

• Strong ability to create compelling product narratives for senior leaders and high-visibility audiences.

• Experience partnering closely with engineers and working through the tradeoffs between design intent, system health, and implementation.

• A track record of influencing and coaching teams without relying on formal authority.

• Experience building reference sites, design-system documentation, or machine-readable design guidance.

• Experience with semantic or multi-tier token systems, motion design, presentation design, or event experiences.

• Background in front-end development, developer tools, cross-platform systems, or highly regulated industries.

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

• Up to 20-25% travel required to meet with teams, partners, and customers

• Reliable internet connection required for remote or hybrid work environments

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $190,000.00 - $315,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

title: CRM Retention Junior
description:
Headquarters: Malta, MT

URL: http://bullfinchrecruitment.com

Bullfinch Recruitment is partnering with one of our clients to find a Junior CRM & Retention Specialist to join their team.

This role is designed for a professional who is eager to transition into the world of player engagement and marketing automation. This position is for someone who is operationally disciplined, data-curious, and ready to be trained into a CRM Ops specialist.

You will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of campaigns that keep our players engaged and active, working at the intersection of technology, data, and creativity.

What you'll be doing:

• Through a combination of structured training and hands-on experience, you will learn to:
Execute Campaigns: Build and schedule retention journeys and look into marketing automation workflows using platforms such as Bloomreach and Builder.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Content, Design, Loyalty, and Customer Support teams to ensure all retention activities align with broader brand campaigns.

• Troubleshoot Campaigns: Assist in troubleshooting CRM workflows and identifying process enhancements to improve overall operational efficiency.

• Customer Service: Work closely with the CS team to help improve the customer experience for those asking for additional rewards.

What we are looking for:

We are seeking a candidate who demonstrates the potential to grow into a high impact specialist. Ideally, you bring:

A Technical Mindset: You may not be a CRM expert yet, but you have a high level of comfort with new software and the ability to quickly learn new platforms.

• Operational Excellence: You are detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and consistency in your work.

• Strong Communication: An effective communicator who can work independently while collaborating across different departments.

• Proactive Mentality: A self-starter attitude with a drive to identify opportunities for improvement and make a real impact in a high-growth environment.

Why you will love it:

This is a brand-new role where you'll build the retention function from the ground up. You'll have real ownership over CRM operations, design best practices that shape our growth, and enjoy high visibility with senior leadership. Every workflow you create and metric you improve directly impacts our mission of delivering extraordinary gaming experiences to millions of players worldwide.

Equal Opportunities

We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas—nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking.

Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bullfinch-recruitment-crm-retention-junior

title: Core Protocol Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Ritual

Ritual is building a sovereign, execution layer for AI, with our private testnet already live and running. The Ritual chain is the first blockchain custom-built to support AI-native operations, designed from the ground up to enable a new class of applications at the intersection of crypto and AI. Our first product, Infernet, is pioneering new ground as the first solution to enable developers to access AI models both on-chain via smart contracts and off-chain, demonstrating our commitment to bridging these transformative technologies.

About the role

We're seeking a Core Protocol Engineer with deep expertise with Ethereum execution clients to help us extend the EVM for next-generation compute capabilities. You'll work on expanding the execution layer to support novel precompiles, implement parallel execution patterns, and design systems for heterogeneous compute orchestration.

• Design and implement extensions to EVM clients (Geth/Reth) for supporting stateful precompiles

• Implement novel mechanism design primitives, collaborating with our research team, into the execution layer

• Develop and optimize transaction processing pipelines for heterogeneous workloads

• Research and implement solutions for state access conflicts

• Contribute to core protocol development and EIP implementations

• Collaborate with the research team on protocol specifications and mechanism design improvements

• Design and implement robust testing frameworks for execution client modifications

About you

• Deep understanding of EVM internals and Ethereum execution clients (Geth/Reth)

• Strong experience implementing and optimizing precompiles

• Expertise in Go and/or Rust for systems programming, and Solidity

• Thorough knowledge of Ethereum's roadmap and active participation in protocol discussions

• Experience with parallel execution patterns in blockchain systems

• Strong understanding of consensus mechanisms and blockchain architecture

• Ability to read, understand, and implement EIPs and protocol specifications

• Proven track record of shipping production-grade blockchain systems

• Ability to act quickly under high pressure scenarios and context switch at a high frequency

• A high level of end-to-end ownership and self-direction, with excellent communication skills

• Hungry, high-energy and ability to work within and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Nice to have

• Knowledge of mempool dynamics, transaction ordering and the mev-boost implementation

• Background in mechanism design or market systems

• Deep knowledge of proof systems and their trade-offs around prover time, verifier time, and proof size

• Experience optimizing proof generation and verification pipelines

• Experience with cross-chain bridges or interoperability protocols

• Contributions to Ethereum client codebases

• Background in distributed systems and concurrent programming

Why join us

• Join a passionate group of engineers, researchers, and operators on a mission to build the next generation of AI infrastructure

• Highly competitive compensation package, including annual discretionary bonus & optimized tax structure compared to the vast majority of web3 startups

• Top 1% of benefits across the web3 startup space

• 100% of premiums covered on highest quality healthcare

• Aggressive company 401k match

• Fully remote and/or hybrid, up to you!

• Participate in virtual and in-person events

• Much much more!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ritual-core-protocol-engineer

title: Law Enforcement Liaison, Kansas
description:
Headquarters: Remote

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Law Enforcement Liaison (Kansas), you’ll develop and advance strategic law enforcement and safety relationships with special focus on law enforcement, while also supporting internal platform safety efforts that elevate the Roblox safety ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be a versatile, self-driven, team-player who enjoys context-switching across high-profile initiatives, and is uniquely motivated by Roblox’s mission of connecting a billion people with optimism and civility. From serving as an external representative of Roblox with state and local law enforcement agencies, to collaborating cross-functionally with our Legal & Advocacy, Civility, Safety, Product, and Communications teams (among others), you will have a diverse set of responsibilities in furtherance of assisting law enforcement, educating external stakeholders such as parents and educators on digital safety, and ultimately helping keep users safe on Roblox.

This position is remotely based in Kansas and will report to the Senior Manager of US Public Policy.

Please note: This role requires On-Call support during weekends and holidays, and is expected to include frequent travel. The scope may also require reviewing graphic, controversial, and offensive content in accordance with Roblox’s handling policies.

You Will:

• Develop and advance strategic law enforcement relationships with special focus on law enforcement in the State of Kansas, and Midwestern region, while assisting with global outreach as needed.

• Coordinate with federal, state, and local law enforcement, including with the Kansas Attorney General’s Office

• Plan and execute educational programs for law enforcement agencies and other key external stakeholders (i.e. parent groups and educators) regarding Roblox’s platform safety efforts, including our law enforcement response policies and NCMEC CyberTip initiatives.

• Proactively identify, monitor, analyze, and internally advise on law enforcement developments affecting Roblox in the State of Kansas and Midwestern region.

• Seek to understand and empathetically respond to regional law enforcement concerns, while helping internally codify and scale resultant learnings.

• Listen to and understand the concerns of Kansas parents, caregivers, and educators regarding the safety of Roblox. You will provide guidance and education that empower these audiences and build confidence in Roblox’s emphasis on product and policy safety, which keeps users safe and healthy.

• Forge a deep subject-matter expertise of Roblox’s internal and external safety practices, so as to identify, advocate for, and help implement strategic safety enhancements.

• Draft professional work product – for both internal and external audiences – supported by clear, concise, and multi-sourced platform safety investigations.

• Collaborate and build strong internal relationships across our Legal & Advocacy, Safety, Product, and Communications teams (among others) to help address law enforcement emergencies, platform safety escalations, and comprehensive Roblox undertakings.

You Have:

• 10+ years of work experience in law enforcement, intelligence, government, trust and safety, or an adjacent field.

• Detailed knowledge of the law enforcement community and related policymakers in the State of Kansas, and Midwestern region, along with current trends and challenges in online safety and policy (particularly child safety and regional-specific considerations).

• Enthusiasm for and a demonstrated track record of stellar public speaking, short-notice travel, building and maintaining constructive relationships, defining your own work processes, and adding organizational value no matter how small or large the task.

• Outstanding communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

• Agility to navigate ambiguity, resilience to overcome obstacles, and the internal drive to concurrently manage multiple high-profile, time-sensitive initiatives in a dynamic environment.

• Unwavering integrity, collegiality, and grit.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/roblox-law-enforcement-liaison-kansas

The ideal candidate will be a versatile, self-driven, team-player who enjoys context-switching across high-profile initiatives, and is uniquely motivated by Roblox’s mission of connecting a billion people with optimism and civility. From serving as an external representative of Roblox with state and local law enforcement agencies, to collaborating cross-functionally with our Legal & Advocacy, Civility, Safety, Product, and Communications teams (among others), you will have a diverse set of responsibilities in furtherance of assisting law enforcement, educating external stakeholders such as parents and educators on digital safety, and ultimately helping keep users safe on Roblox. This position is remotely based in Kansas and will report to the Senior Manager of US Public Policy. Please note: This role requires On-Call support during weekends and holidays, and is expected to include frequent travel. The scope may also require reviewing graphic, controversial, and offensive content in accordance with Roblox’s handling policies. You Will: Develop and advance strategic law enforcement relationships with special focus on law enforcement in the State of Kansas, and Midwestern region, while assisting with global outreach as needed. Coordinate with federal, state, and local law enforcement, including with the Kansas Attorney General’s Office Plan and execute educational programs for law enforcement agencies and other key external stakeholders (i.e. parent groups and educators) regarding Roblox’s platform safety efforts, including our law enforcement response policies and NCMEC CyberTip initiatives. Proactively identify, monitor, analyze, and internally advise on law enforcement developments affecting Roblox in the State of Kansas and Midwestern region. Seek to understand and empathetically respond to regional law enforcement concerns, while helping internally codify and scale resultant learnings. Listen to and understand the concerns of Kansas parents, caregivers, and educators regarding the safety of Roblox. You will provide guidance and education that empower these audiences and build confidence in Roblox’s emphasis on product and policy safety, which keeps users safe and healthy. Forge a deep subject-matter expertise of Roblox’s internal and external safety practices, so as to identify, advocate for, and help implement strategic safety enhancements. Draft professional work product – for both internal and external audiences – supported by clear, concise, and multi-sourced platform safety investigations. Collaborate and build strong internal relationships across our Legal & Advocacy, Safety, Product, and Communications teams (among others) to help address law enforcement emergencies, platform safety escalations, and comprehensive Roblox undertakings. You Have: 10+ years of work experience in law enforcement, intelligence, government, trust and safety, or an adjacent field. Detailed knowledge of the law enforcement community and related policymakers in the State of Kansas, and Midwestern region, along with current trends and challenges in online safety and policy (particularly child safety and regional-specific considerations). Enthusiasm for and a demonstrated track record of stellar public speaking, short-notice travel, building and maintaining constructive relationships, defining your own work processes, and adding organizational value no matter how small or large the task. Outstanding communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Agility to navigate ambiguity, resilience to overcome obstacles, and the internal drive to concurrently manage multiple high-profile, time-sensitive initiatives in a dynamic environment. Unwavering integrity, collegiality, and grit. Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted). title: Interior Designer
description:
Headquarters: Egypt

URL: http://prospexcrm.xyz

About the Role

We're looking for a talented Interior Designer to join our team — fully remote, work from home, based in Egypt.

You'll own the full design process end-to-end, from initial concept all the way through to final renders. This is a purely design-focused role — no vendor or contractor coordination required. If you're passionate about design in all its depth and want to focus entirely on your craft, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do

• Develop interior design concepts and mood boards based on client briefs

• Produce detailed floor plans, space planning layouts, and construction drawings

• Design full electrical layouts including lighting plans and switch/socket placement

• Create plumbing and sanitary layout drawings where required

• Select and specify materials, finishes, furniture, and fixtures

• Produce photorealistic 3D renderings and walkthroughs

• Prepare complete design packages and technical documentation

• Incorporate client feedback and revise designs accordingly

• Stay current with interior design trends, materials, and software

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field

• 2+ years of professional interior design experience

• Strong proficiency in AutoCAD for technical drawings and layouts

• Proficiency in 3ds Max, V-Ray, Lumion, or similar rendering software

• Experience with SketchUp, Revit, or equivalent modeling tools

• Ability to produce electrical and plumbing layout drawings as part of a full design package

• Adobe Photoshop / Illustrator for presentation and mood board work

• A strong portfolio covering concept through to rendered output

• Excellent communication in Arabic and English

• Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently

What We Offer

• 100% remote — work from anywhere in Egypt

• Flexible working hours

• Creative and supportive team environment

• Diverse and interesting projects

• Competitive compensation based on experience

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/prospex-crm-interior-designer

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship - Warp Speed
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Warp Speed
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. FDSEs on Warp Speed work directly with customers from the factory floor to the board room to understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions using data.
 
As Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the most important industries and institutions globally!
 
The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer 
At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.
 
FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
As an FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. You’ll work in small, agile teams and own the end-to-end execution and implementation of high-stakes projects, including:
 
• Collaborating with fellow engineers on architecture and design decisions
• Wrangling massive-scale data and using AI to accelerate and enhance critical operations
• Developing custom applications tailored to customer needs
• Engaging directly with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives
• Shaping team strategy and driving projects from ideation to deployment, increasing your pain threshold to deliver real value

description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac (https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/), Windows (https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/), iOS (https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/), and Android (https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/), our search engine (https://duckduckgo.com/), and the DuckDuckGo subscription (https://duckduckgo.com/pro).
