title: Deployment Strategist, Internship - Warp Speed
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


What We're About
 
At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around using data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.
 
The Role
 
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. The Warp Speed Deployment role centers around using data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to manufacture high-quality products is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into a reality.
 
As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most exciting problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into an understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.
 
You'll immerse yourself in our customers' most intricate workflows. You'll partner with customer teams and explore the data, and plunge into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll seek will require a curious and analytical approach, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user insight to ultimately empower our customers to improve decisions.

Benefits • Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance • Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance • Commuter benefits • Relocation assistance • Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based • 2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs) • 10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year • Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events • Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents • Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation • Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child • Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan Life at Palantir We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process , please reach out and let us know how we can help. title: Senior Finance Manager Management Accountant
description:
Position : Senior Finance Manager / Management AccountantÂ

Salary : PHP 90,000 - PHP 110,000 /month

Working Hours & Conditions: Observing AU business hours

Holidays : Observing AU holidays

ROLE OVERVIEW:

Our client is an end-to-end B2B SaaS platform delivering specialized workforce management software designed for operational precision across scheduling, compliance, time tracking, invoicing, and payroll. Operating in a high-volume, multi-entity environment undergoing rapid international expansion and strategic acquisitions, the organization is bringing its core finance operations fully in-house to support scalable long-term growth. Working closely with executive leadership, this critical role goes beyond traditional accounting to take complete ownership of financial consolidations, month-end close optimization, SaaS performance metrics, and commercial analysis. We are seeking a proactive leader with a Financial Controller mindset who can independently challenge assumptions, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and bring clear financial visibility to strategic executive decisions.Â

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Financial Close, Reporting & Multi-Entity Consolidation:

• Take end-to-end ownership of the month-end close cycle, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and consolidated financial reporting.

• Lead the strategic transition of financial close and reporting activities from external advisers to the internal finance function.

• Audit and streamline close workflows to significantly reduce month-end closing timelines from 2â3 weeks.

• Prepare accurate, consolidated profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports across multiple domestic and international entities while maintaining audit-ready documentation.

• Management Accounting & Commercial Analysis:

• Deliver monthly management accounts supported by deep, commercially relevant commentary on business performance and profitability drivers.

• Perform budget-versus-actual and month-on-month variance analyses, actively investigating root causes rather than merely reporting numbers.

• Develop, maintain, and refine annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and multi-entity cash flow projections.

• Partner with executive leadership to evaluate operational margins, identify financial risks, and translate complex financial data into actionable growth strategies.

• SaaS Performance Metrics & Revenue Recognition:

• Track, analyze, and report on key SaaS metrics, including MRR, ARR, churn, customer retention, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and customer lifetime value (LTV).

• Reconcile complex subscription, recurring billing, and usage data with core management accounts in full alignment with revenue recognition principles.

• Acquisitions & Process Transformation:

• Support post-acquisition financial integrations, harmonizing accounting policies, chart of accounts, and financial frameworks across acquired businesses.

• Audit existing financial workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and implement modern automation tools and robust internal controls.

• Coach and uplift existing bookkeeping and operational finance team members, establishing clear procedures, responsibilities, and reporting deadlines.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience: Minimum 7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including substantial senior management accounting, finance manager, or financial controller responsibilities.

• Industry Background: Proven experience operating within a B2B SaaS, subscription-based technology, or recurring revenue software business.

• Core Technical Competencies: Demonstrated ownership of financial consolidations, multi-entity accounting, month-end close streamlining, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

• SaaS Expertise: Deep working knowledge of subscription billing models, revenue recognition standards, and core SaaS unit economics (MRR/ARR/Churn).

• Education & Skills: Bachelorâs degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline; advanced Excel skills for complex financial modeling; and exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for senior stakeholder management.

DESIRED (NOT REQUIRED):

• Professional qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent.

• Direct reporting experience to a CFO, Finance Director, or senior executive.

• Exposure to Australian accounting standards, tax compliance, and business frameworks.

• Practical experience navigating fast-paced technology businesses undergoing mergers and acquisitions (M&A) or international expansion.

• Familiarity with integrated SaaS billing engines, ERP platforms, and automated reporting systems.

Position : Senior Finance Manager / Management Accountant 
Salary : PHP 90,000 - PHP 110,000 /month
Working Hours & Conditions: Observing AU business hours
Holidays : Observing AU holidays

ROLE OVERVIEW:
Our client is an end-to-end B2B SaaS platform delivering specialized workforce management software designed for operational precision across scheduling, compliance, time tracking, invoicing, and payroll. Operating in a high-volume, multi-entity environment undergoing rapid international expansion and strategic acquisitions, the organization is bringing its core finance operations fully in-house to support scalable long-term growth. Working closely with executive leadership, this critical role goes beyond traditional accounting to take complete ownership of financial consolidations, month-end close optimization, SaaS performance metrics, and commercial analysis. We are seeking a proactive leader with a Financial Controller mindset who can independently challenge assumptions, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and bring clear financial visibility to strategic executive decisions. 

RESPONSIBILITIES:
* Financial Close, Reporting & Multi-Entity Consolidation:

* Take end-to-end ownership of the month-end close cycle, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and consolidated financial reporting.
* Lead the strategic transition of financial close and reporting activities from external advisers to the internal finance function.
* Audit and streamline close workflows to significantly reduce month-end closing timelines from 2–3 weeks.
* Prepare accurate, consolidated profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports across multiple domestic and international entities while maintaining audit-ready documentation.

* Management Accounting & Commercial Analysis:

* Deliver monthly management accounts supported by deep, commercially relevant commentary on business performance and profitability drivers.
* Perform budget-versus-actual and month-on-month variance analyses, actively investigating root causes rather than merely reporting numbers.
* Develop, maintain, and refine annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and multi-entity cash flow projections.
* Partner with executive leadership to evaluate operational margins, identify financial risks, and translate complex financial data into actionable growth strategies.

* SaaS Performance Metrics & Revenue Recognition:

* Track, analyze, and report on key SaaS metrics, including MRR, ARR, churn, customer retention, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and customer lifetime value (LTV).
* Reconcile complex subscription, recurring billing, and usage data with core management accounts in full alignment with revenue recognition principles.

* Acquisitions & Process Transformation:

* Support post-acquisition financial integrations, harmonizing accounting policies, chart of accounts, and financial frameworks across acquired businesses.
* Audit existing financial workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and implement modern automation tools and robust internal controls.
* Coach and uplift existing bookkeeping and operational finance team members, establishing clear procedures, responsibilities, and reporting deadlines.





QUALIFICATIONS:
* Experience: Minimum 7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including substantial senior management accounting, finance manager, or financial controller responsibilities.
* Industry Background: Proven experience operating within a B2B SaaS, subscription-based technology, or recurring revenue software business.
* Core Technical Competencies: Demonstrated ownership of financial consolidations, multi-entity accounting, month-end close streamlining, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* SaaS Expertise: Deep working knowledge of subscription billing models, revenue recognition standards, and core SaaS unit economics (MRR/ARR/Churn).
* Education & Skills: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline; advanced Excel skills for complex financial modeling; and exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for senior stakeholder management.



DESIRED (NOT REQUIRED):
* Professional qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent.
* Direct reporting experience to a CFO, Finance Director, or senior executive.
* Exposure to Australian accounting standards, tax compliance, and business frameworks.
* Practical experience navigating fast-paced technology businesses undergoing mergers and acquisitions (M&A) or international expansion.
* Familiarity with integrated SaaS billing engines, ERP platforms, and automated reporting systems.

title: Animator Intern
description:
Headquarters: Abu Dhabi, UAE; APAC - Remote

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Responsibilities

•
Create and edit high-quality video and motion content from brief to final delivery.

•
Animate typography, graphics, product visuals, UI elements, and campaign assets.

•
Edit videos with strong attention to pacing, transitions, music, sound design, and storytelling.

•
Work confidently across After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Figma.

•
Use AI creative tools for ideation, storyboarding, asset generation, video generation, and creative experimentation.

•
Collaborate with designers, creative leads, and other team members to bring ideas to life.

•
Respond to feedback efficiently and maintain a consistently high standard of execution.

What We’re Looking For

•
Strong practical skills in both animation and video editing.

•
Proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Adobe Premiere Pro.

•
Ability to work with and animate designs created in Figma.

•
Strong visual judgment across typography, composition, timing, movement, and transitions.

•
Good understanding of storytelling and the ability to build a complete video, not only individual scenes.

•
Familiarity with modern AI creative tools and workflows.

•
A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating both editing and animation capabilities.

•
Proactive, detail-oriented, adaptable, and comfortable working independently within creative direction.

Ideal Candidate

An early-career multidisciplinary creative who is already technically proficient, visually strong, and ready to contribute immediately.

You should be confident across editing, animation, design, storytelling, and AI-assisted creative workflows, while continuing to develop through collaboration, feedback, and creative direction from the team.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-animator-intern

title: Accounting Operations
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. Weâre dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaidâs network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Role Overview

You will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow.

You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaidâs growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way.

Responsibilities

• Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity and cost allocations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analysis.

• Prepare and maintain intercompany and consolidation entries across Plaidâs entities, including cost-plus arrangements and FX revaluation and elimination.

• Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood.

• Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness.

• Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests.

Qualifications

• 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big 4 public accounting, with a deep understanding of US GAAP; CPA preferred.

• Experience at a public company or with IPO readiness

• Familiarity with SOX compliance and the ability to produce audit-ready workpapers;

• Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency accounting;

• Proficiency with NetSuite, Zip, T&E and close management platforms is a plus

• Problem solver and first-principles thinker with a bias for action, creativity, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches.

• Curious, fast learner with a growth mindset who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

• Hands-on, can-do attitude, willing to roll up their sleeves, dive into details, and own execution.

• Proven change agent with a track record of improving processes, leveraging technology, and scaling operations.

• Strong communicator and collaborator who can effectively engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here (https://plaid.com/legal/#candidate-privacy-notice).

Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.Role OverviewYou will be a key contributor to Accounting Operations and own the accounting for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity, and cost allocations. This includes preparing and reviewing journal entries, reconciling accounts, analyzing balances and trends, and ensuring these areas are complete and accurate each month, quarter, and year-end. You will be the point of contact for your areas during the close and the annual audit. Over time, your responsibilities may expand into other areas of the close as the business and team grow.You will also help build scalable, efficient processes that support Plaid’s growth and public readiness. This includes documenting and strengthening controls in your areas, shortening the close, improving the quality and consistency of supporting documentation, and identifying opportunities to automate manual work. You will partner with the broader Accounting team, FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and external auditors along the way.Responsibilities* Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for accruals, investments, leases, intercompany activity and cost allocations, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analysis.
* Prepare and maintain intercompany and consolidation entries across Plaid’s entities, including cost-plus arrangements and FX revaluation and elimination.
* Partner with FP&A, Strategic Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Marketing, and vendors to ensure spend is accrued completely and accurately and that balances are well understood.
* Identify and implement process, automation, and control improvements in your areas to shorten the close and support SOX 404 readiness.
* Serve as the primary contact for your areas during the annual audit, preparing support and responding to auditor requests.

Qualifications* 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including Big 4 public accounting, with a deep understanding of US GAAP; CPA preferred.
* Experience at a public company or with IPO readiness
* Familiarity with SOX compliance and the ability to produce audit-ready workpapers;
* Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency accounting;
* Proficiency with NetSuite, Zip, T&E and close management platforms is a plus
* Problem solver and first-principles thinker with a bias for action, creativity, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches.
* Curious, fast learner with a growth mindset who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Hands-on, can-do attitude, willing to roll up their sleeves, dive into details, and own execution.
* Proven change agent with a track record of improving processes, leveraging technology, and scaling operations.
* Strong communicator and collaborator who can effectively engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
